title: Senior Director of Digital Communications
description:
About Reproductive Freedom for All (Formerly NARAL Pro-Choice America)

For more than 55 years, Reproductive Freedom for All and its chapters have fought to protect and expand reproductive freedom —including access to abortion and contraception — for everybody. We are powered by our more than 4 million members from every state and congressional district in the country, representing the 8 in 10 Americans who believe every person should have the freedom to make the best decision for themselves about if, when, and how to raise a family.

Reproductive Freedom for All centers diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice in our organization and our work. Continuously learning from our history, we hold ourselves accountable to achieve reproductive freedom with equitable access for everybody. As the oldest and largest national membership organization primarily focused on advocating for abortion access, we organize and mobilize, galvanizing millions of people to take action to defend reproductive freedom, and shining a spotlight of accountability on bad actors who work to impose their ideological agenda on others. We also work to elect champions for reproductive freedom and advance state and federal legislation to safeguard it. For more information on Reproductive Freedom for All, please visit our website.

About the role:

Reproductive Freedom for All is looking for a tested digital communications leader to build and lead one of the most ambitious digital communications programs in politics.

We're looking for someone whose expertise has been built through robust experience—someone who knows what exceptional digital communications looks like, exercises strong judgment in fast-moving environments, and is driven to keep learning as platforms, technology, and audience behavior evolve.

This is not a role for someone who thinks digital communications is simply about posting content. We are looking for a leader who understands that every post, every video, every podcast, and every campaign is an opportunity to mobilize our more than 4.5 million members, engage the 8 in 10 Americans who support reproductive freedom, reach new audiences, shape culture, build political power, elect reproductive freedom champions, and hold anti-abortion politicians accountable at the ballot box.

As our Senior Director of Digital Communications, you will set the vision for Reproductive Freedom for All's digital communications program—leading our social media presence, creative operation, podcast ecosystem, YouTube strategy, creator partnerships, executive digital communications, and the talented team responsible for bringing that vision to life. You'll build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team committed to setting the standard for digital excellence in the reproductive freedom movement, creating a culture where creativity, experimentation, thoughtful feedback, collaboration, and continuous learning are expected every day.

You’ll understand that digital doesn’t just raise our profile—it’s a critical part of our strategy. You’ll build relationships across teams and execute strategies integrated with our communications, government relations, political, and organizing teams. Your goal is not just more clicks and follows, it’s electing reproductive freedom champions, holding politicians accountable, and defending and expanding reproductive freedom policies.

You'll know when to move quickly and when to slow down. You'll understand that factual doesn't have to mean boring. Serious doesn't have to mean stale. You'll know how to communicate complicated issues with clarity, humanity, urgency, and creativity.

You'll constantly ask:

"Will this stop someone's scroll?"

"Will this reach someone new?"

"Will this make someone care?"

You'll stay laser focused on impact—not vanity metrics—measuring success by whether our work mobilizes members, reaches new audiences, shapes the national conversation, and helps build the power needed to protect reproductive freedom.

You'll help establish Reproductive Freedom for All as the premier digital hub for creators, influencers, celebrities, and trusted messengers in the reproductive freedom movement, while elevating the digital voices of our organization's leaders and expanding our influence far beyond our own channels.

Most importantly, you'll be the kind of leader people want to work for—someone who develops talent, inspires teams, welcomes feedback, raises the creative bar every day, and believes exceptional digital communications doesn't just tell stories. It builds movements, grows political power, and helps secure reproductive freedom for future generations.

Location: Hybrid in Washington, DC

Reports to: Senior Vice President of Communications and Digital Strategy

Positions Directly Reporting to this Position: Deputy Director of Social Media

This Position Is: Full Time, Exempt, Non-Union

Salary: $165,000 - $205,000



Responsibilities:

Strategy

  • Lead Reproductive Freedom for All's digital communications program, setting the vision and raising the standard for how the organization shows up across every digital platform;
  • Lead the organization's creative vision across social media, video, podcasts, graphics, photography, and digital storytelling, ensuring content is compelling, factual, thoughtful, emotionally resonant, and built to perform;
  • Develop digital strategies rooted in performance, audience behavior, and platform expertise—understanding that every post, video, graphic, and campaign is an opportunity to mobilize our members, reach new audiences, strengthen our movement, and build the political power necessary to protect and expand reproductive freedom;
  • Establish clear goals, performance benchmarks, and reporting systems that measure meaningful impact, using data and insights to continually improve creative execution, audience growth, engagement, and organizational influence;
  • Lead the strategic vision, production, promotion, and long-term growth of My Body. My Pod., expanding its reach while identifying new opportunities across YouTube and other long-form storytelling platforms;
  • Shape how the organization's leaders show up online, building executive digital platforms that expand our influence while positioning Reproductive Freedom for All as the leading digital voice in the reproductive freedom movement.

People Management

  • Build, lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of digital strategists, content creators, designers, and communicators—creating a culture of creativity, collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability where people are empowered to do the best work of their careers;
  • Work collaboratively across Communications, Government Relations, Political, Organizing, Development, Digital Marketing, and Campaigns to ensure integrated messaging, cohesive storytelling, and coordinated digital execution across the organization.

Content & Platforms

  • Lead the organization's social media ecosystem across Instagram, TikTok, Threads, X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging platforms, ensuring every channel works together to grow our movement, mobilize our members, and advance organizational priorities;
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, encouraging the team to test new ideas, embrace emerging platforms and formats, learn from analytics, and continually evolve as the digital landscape changes;
  • Build and manage a best-in-class content operation that consistently delivers creative work people choose to watch, share, and engage with—not content produced simply to fill a publishing calendar;
  • Develop and manage a comprehensive YouTube strategy that extends the organization's storytelling, grows subscribers, and creates new opportunities to engage audiences through video;
  • Manage rapid response digital communications during key political moments, ensuring the organization moves quickly without sacrificing accuracy, creativity, or strategic discipline;
  • Stay relentlessly curious about the evolving digital landscape, emerging platforms, creator culture, audience behavior, and new technologies—bringing fresh ideas, proven best practices, and a commitment to continuous learning into every aspect of the team's work;
  • Travel as needed to capture content, support campaign moments, major events, endorsements, podcast recordings, and other opportunities that elevate the organization's visibility and impact.

Partnerships & Vendor management

  • Establish Reproductive Freedom for All as a premier digital and creative partner for creators, influencers, celebrities, and trusted messengers in the reproductive freedom movement—building a best-in-class partnership program that expands our reach, strengthens campaigns, and creates new opportunities for cultural and digital storytelling;
  • Build and manage Repro For All’s creator, influencer, celebrity, and cultural partnership strategy, cultivating long-term relationships and developing opportunities for collaboration, amplification, and original content;
  • Partner closely with National Organizing, Government Relations, Political, Campaigns, and other teams to translate existing organizational relationships and programmatic work into compelling digital storytelling and amplification opportunities, with clear ownership and coordination across teams;
  • Serve as the digital and creative lead on cross-functional partnerships, bringing expertise in audience, platforms, content, production, and distribution while respecting functional ownership of relationships with elected officials, movement partners, advocates, and grassroots leaders;
  • Develop systems and infrastructure for identifying and activating trusted messengers across campaigns—including creators, cultural figures, advocates, elected leaders, storytellers, and organizational partners—so that teams across RFA can more effectively leverage digital voices to advance shared goals;
  • Manage agency partners, production vendors, freelancers, and consultants, ensuring high-quality creative work is delivered on time, on budget, and aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Additional duties may be assigned consistent with the responsibilities and qualifications in this job description.



Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital communications within political campaigns, advocacy organizations, mission-driven nonprofits, government, or related organizations, with a demonstrated track record of building high-performing digital programs that drive measurable impact;
  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams of strategists, creatives, designers, content producers, and digital communicators, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning;
  • Deep expertise in digital communications, audience growth, and platform strategy, with a demonstrated understanding of how compelling storytelling builds movements, mobilizes supporters, shapes public narratives, and drives political action;
  • Significant experience leading integrated digital communications across social media, video, podcasts, creative, and emerging platforms, with exceptional editorial judgment and storytelling instincts;
  • Experience managing podcast, video, or other recurring digital storytelling products from concept through production, promotion, and distribution;
  • Experience developing and managing relationships with creators, influencers, celebrities, media partners, agencies, or other external collaborators to expand reach and strengthen campaigns;
  • Deep understanding of the intersection of politics, advocacy, culture, and digital communications, with experience navigating fast-moving news cycles, rapid response, and high-profile public campaigns;
  • Demonstrated ability to lead in ever-changing, high-pressure environments, exercising sound judgment while balancing speed, accuracy, creativity, and strategic decision-making;
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to provide thoughtful feedback, build consensus, and communicate effectively with colleagues, senior leadership, external partners, and public-facing principals;
  • Experience managing complex projects, budgets, vendors, consultants, and competing priorities while consistently delivering high-quality work on deadline;
  • A collaborative and empowering leadership style grounded in humility, curiosity, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Welcomes different perspectives and feedback, creates space for people to contribute and thrive, invests in developing others, and inspires teams to do their best work;
  • Demonstrated ability to connect with people across diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences—and to translate those experiences into authentic, compelling storytelling. Brings a commitment to elevating voices and stories that have too often been overlooked or unheard;
  • Passion for advancing reproductive freedom and a commitment to the mission and values of Reproductive Freedom for All;
  • Demonstrated commitment to Reproductive Freedom for All’s mission, values and goals;
  • Demonstrated commitment to contributing to a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion is valued and centered in their work in general;
  • Readiness and enthusiasm to make connections with people of different lived experiences; success in managing teams of individuals with diverse backgrounds; Experience working with underrepresented communities;
  • Demonstrated deep commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of leadership and decision-making, specifically.

OPTIONAL: Nice-to-haves (or excited-to-learns):

  • Familiarity with the reproductive freedom landscape, including abortion access policy, movement dynamics, and the broader political context shaping the fight;
  • Established relationships with progressive podcasts, digital creators, or nontraditional media outlets, or demonstrated ability to build and navigate those spaces.

Reproductive Freedom for All does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, socioeconomic status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or political affiliation.
Candidates with backgrounds, identities, and experiences that are historically underrepresented in reproductive freedom non-profits are encouraged to apply.

Reproductive Freedom for All does not permit staff to work from a country outside of the United States.

title: Test goedkeuring Regieverpleegkundige nierdonatie en niertransplantatie

Functie

Ben jij een regieverpleegkundige die energie krijgt van het begeleiden van niertransplantatiepatiënten en nierdonoren tijdens een bijzonder en ingrijpend traject? In deze functie ben je gedurende het gehele donatie- en transplantatietraject betrokken bij een donor danwel een nierontvanger. Je bent hun vaste aanspreekpunt, coördineert het zorgproces en zorgt voor een goede afstemming tussen alle betrokken zorgverleners. Daarbij heb je oog voor de persoonlijke en psychosociale impact van nierdonatie bij leven en het ontvangen van een donornier.

Naast de begeleiding van donoren en ontvangers heb je een actieve rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van de nierdonatie- en transplantatiezorg. Je draagt bij aan de afstemming en planning rondom transplantaties, signaleert verbetermogelijkheden binnen zorgprocessen en neemt deel aan relevante regionale en landelijke werkgroepen.

Je werkt binnen reguliere kantoortijden. De maandag en dinsdag zijn in ieder geval jouw vaste werkdagen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit het:

  • Zelfstandig voeren van poliklinische en telefonische spreekuren.
  • Hebben van de regie over de zorgtrajecten van nierdonoren en niertransplantatiepatiënten.
  • Coördineren van onderzoeken, afspraken en behandeltrajecten.
  • Afstemmen van zorg met verschillende disciplines binnen en buiten het Radboudumc.
  • Verzorgen van de OK-planning rondom niertransplantaties en het afstemmen hiervan met de betrokken disciplines.
  • Deelnemen aan multidisciplinaire overleggen.
  • Bieden van psychosociale begeleiding aan nierdonoren, niertransplantatiepatiënten en hun naasten, met specifieke aandacht voor de medische, psychosociale en ethische vraagstukken die kunnen spelen rondom donatie en transplantatie.
  • Onderhouden van contacten met verwijzende ziekenhuizen en andere transplantatiecentra.
  • Bijdragen aan kwaliteitsverbetering, Evidence Based Practice en de verdere ontwikkeling van de nierdonatie- en transplantatiezorg.

Je bent een hbo-verpleegkundige (niveau 6) of regie gecertificeerde verpleegkundige met een geldige BIG-registratie.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen een ziekenhuis.

  • Goede digitale vaardigheden en ervaring met een patiëntensysteem (bij voorkeur EPIC).
  • Affiniteit met complexe zorgtrajecten.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je bent enthousiast, communicatief sterk, en makkelijk benaderbaar voor anderen. Daarbij stel je je verantwoordelijk op in zorg voor onze patiënten en bent in staat zelfstandig te werk te gaan.

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen wanneer de situatie daar om vraagt en durft initiatief te nemen. Daarbij hou je van een dynamische werkomgeving en denkt actief mee in het verbeteren van kwaliteit van zorg.
  • Je vindt psychosociale begeleiding van patiënten en hun naasten interessant en ben in staat een luisterend oor te bieden. Dit vraagt ook om empathisch vermogen.
  • Naast goed zelfstandig te werk kunnen gaan, kun je ook goed samenwerken met collega’s en andere betrokken disciplines. Hierbij neem je een proactieve en collegiale houding aan.
  • Je bent bereid om in de toekomst de 1-jarige opleiding tot transplantatieverpleegkundige te volgen.

Herken jij jezelf in bovenstaand profiel en ben jij klaar om ons team te komen versterken? Dan kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie.

title: Security Analyst, Attack Surface Management
description:
Job Title: Security Analyst, Attack Surface Management

Summary

The Attack Surface Management team owns what happens after a vulnerability is found. Findings arrive from red team pentests, adversary simulations, external bug bounty submissions, and scanning coverage. This role validates them, determines real impact, and drives them to closure with the engineering teams that own the affected assets. Critical findings route to Incident Response. Everything rated High and Medium is this team's responsibility until it is patched or a compensating control is in place and documented.

This is not a patch operations role. Separate teams apply fixes. This role decides what matters, why it matters, and holds the line until it is resolved.

Responsibilities

  • Triage and validate inbound Bugcrowd submissions: reproduce the reported issue, confirm or reject it, deduplicate against known findings, and determine payout-relevant severity.
  • Independently assess impact rather than accepting a submitter's or a scanner's rating. Factor in exploitability, asset exposure, data sensitivity, authentication requirements, and existing controls.
  • Track High and Medium findings from red team engagements and adversary simulations through remediation, including retest and closure verification.
  • Evaluate and document compensating controls where a fix is not immediately viable, and set expiry conditions rather than leaving exceptions open indefinitely.
  • Write remediation guidance that an application or platform engineer can act on without further translation.
  • Escalate Critical findings to Incident Response with the reproduction detail and blast radius assessment they need to act.
  • Partner with application owners and product teams on remediation timelines, and raise risk acceptance decisions to leadership when timelines slip.
  • Maintain visibility into externally exposed assets and flag newly surfaced attack surface for assessment.

Required Qualifications

  • Two or more years in application security, vulnerability management, penetration testing, or bug bounty work.
  • Working proficiency in web application and API penetration testing. You should be able to independently reproduce a submitted finding, escalate it if the submitter undersold it, and prove it is a false positive if it is one.
  • Practical knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10, including what remediation actually looks like for each class of issue.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK techniques and the ability to connect a finding to how an attacker would chain it.
  • Severity determination beyond a CVSS calculator. You can explain why a High-scoring finding on an isolated internal asset may matter less than a Medium on an internet-facing authentication flow.
  • Hands-on experience with Burp Suite and standard web and API testing tooling.
  • Clear written communication. Much of this role is convincing an engineering team that a finding is real and worth their sprint capacity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated bug bounty track record on Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or Intigriti.
  • Experience triaging submissions from the program side.
  • Cloud security exposure across AWS or Azure, particularly identity and storage misconfigurations.
  • Certifications such as BSCP, OSWA, OSCP, CPTS, or PNPT. A public bug bounty profile carries equal weight.

Scripting in Python for reproduction harnesses and finding automation.

title: Credit Associate
description: Job Title - Credit Associate Reports To - Credit Analyst/Head, Credit Employment Type - Internship Location - Maryland Job Summary The Credit Associate will support the credit team in assessing loan applications, conducting credit checks, reviewing customer information and documentation, and monitoring loan portfolios. Key Responsibilities 1. Credit Assessment & Analysis * Review and assess loan applications in line with the company's credit policy and approval criteria. * Analyse applicants' financial information, transaction history, income, cash flow, repayment capacity, and other relevant data. * Conduct credit checks and review available credit bureau reports and other relevant verification reports. * Identify potential credit risks, inconsistencies, red flags, and signs of fraudulent activity. * Prepare clear credit assessments and recommendations for review and approval. * Ensure all credit decisions are supported by relevant data and documentation. 2. Loan Processing & Documentation * Review submitted loan documents to ensure they are complete, accurate, and valid. * Verify customer information and supporting documents where required. * Ensure approved loans meet all pre-disbursement conditions before escalation for disbursement. * Follow up on outstanding documentation and conditions precedent to disbursement. * Maintain accurate and up-to-date credit records. 3. Portfolio Monitoring * Monitor assigned loan accounts and identify accounts showing early signs of delinquency or increased credit risk. * Track repayment performance and flag overdue accounts to the appropriate team. * Support the preparation of portfolio reports and credit performance updates. * Monitor key credit indicators, including repayment behaviour, delinquency, and portfolio quality. * Escalate unusual account activity or emerging risks promptly. 4. Collections & Recovery Support * Support the collections team with relevant customer and loan information required for recovery activities. * Review delinquent accounts and provide insights that may support recovery strategies. * Follow up on agreed repayment arrangements and update relevant records. * Escalate persistent or high-risk delinquent accounts in line with the company's escalation process. 5. Risk & Compliance * Ensure all credit activities comply with the company's credit policies, procedures, and approval limits. * Maintain confidentiality of customer and financial information. * Identify and report suspected fraud, misrepresentation, or policy breaches. * Ensure proper documentation and audit trails are maintained for all credit decisions. * Stay informed about changes to internal credit policies and applicable regulatory requirements. 6. Reporting & Administration * Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly credit reports as required. * Maintain accurate records of loan applications, approvals, rejections, and disbursements. * Support the Credit Manager/Analyst with portfolio analysis and other credit-related reports. * Participate in credit review meetings and provide relevant updates on assigned accounts. * Perform other credit-related duties assigned by the supervisor. Qualifications & Experience * Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline. * 0–2 years of experience in credit, lending, financial services, banking, fintech, or a related field. * Fresh graduates with strong analytical and numerical skills are encouraged to apply. * Relevant professional certifications or ongoing certification in credit, finance, accounting, or risk management will be an advantage.

title: Product & Distribution Specialist
description:
WARE WHOLESALE

Warehouse Delivery Driver

Ware Brands, Inc.

Position Type: Full-Time, 36-40 Hours per Week

CDL Required: No

Department: Ware Wholesale

Classification: Delivery / Warehouse


Position Summary

Ware Wholesale is seeking a dependable, safety-conscious, and customer-focused Warehouse Delivery Driver to join our team. This position is responsible for safely and efficiently delivering products to our customers while also assisting with warehouse operations as needed.

Our delivery drivers are an important part of the customer experience and represent Ware Wholesale while making deliveries. The ideal candidate will be reliable, organized, attentive to detail, and committed to providing professional and friendly service to our customers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Safely operate a company delivery vehicle on assigned delivery routes.
  • Deliver customer orders accurately, safely, and in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Load and unload products from the delivery vehicle.
  • Verify orders and ensure products are properly loaded and secured to prevent shortages, breakage, or damage.
  • Provide friendly and professional service when interacting with customers.
  • Maintain assigned route expectations and communicate delays, delivery issues, customer concerns, or other problems to warehouse staff or management.
  • Complete required paperwork and documentation related to deliveries.
  • Maintain accurate records regarding vehicle condition, mileage, and other required information.
  • Conduct required vehicle inspections and promptly report maintenance, mechanical, or safety concerns.
  • Keep the interior and exterior of the company vehicle clean and organized.
  • Assist with receiving, stocking, picking, packing, organizing inventory, and other warehouse duties as needed.
  • Follow company safety procedures, applicable transportation requirements, and Ware Wholesale policies and procedures.
  • Maintain effective communication and positive working relationships with customers, coworkers, and management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory driving record required. A valid driver's license is required because operating a company vehicle and making customer deliveries are essential functions of this position.
  • No CDL is required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Previous delivery, route driving, warehouse, or related experience preferred but not required.
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and accountable.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Ability to perform basic math and accurately complete delivery documentation.
  • Friendly and professional demeanor with strong customer service skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to follow established safety procedures and work practices.

Physical Requirements

This position requires regular physical activity associated with warehouse and delivery work, including standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, loading, and unloading merchandise.

The employee must be able to routinely lift and carry 40–60 pounds and occasionally lift up to 80 pounds.

The employee must also be able to safely enter and exit the delivery vehicle throughout the workday and perform delivery and warehouse duties in varying working and weather conditions.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time position averaging 36-40 hours per week. Most workdays are approximately eight hours; however, the length of the workday may vary depending on delivery routes, customer needs, workload, traffic, weather, and other operational needs. Some workdays may be longer or shorter than eight hours.

Employees must be able to work the schedule necessary to complete assigned delivery routes and warehouse responsibilities.

Benefits

Eligible full-time employees may participate in company-sponsored benefit programs, including paid time off, health insurance, and the company's 401(k) plan, subject to the terms and eligibility requirements of each benefit program.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include:

  • Background check
  • Drug screening
  • Review of driving history

Equal Employment Opportunity

Ware Brands, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

3. Ensure compliance with organizational policies, safeguarding, and humanitarian principles.

vi. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and data management tools.

title: Field Outreach Specialist
description:
Title: Field Outreach Specialist

Reports To: Homeless Outreach Supervisor

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Status: Full-time

Supervisory Responsibility: Not Applicable

Who we are?

CHOICE is an agency that takes pride in providing case management and advocacy services for our clients with mental health or physical health illnesses. We specialize in providing quality coordination of care, referrals, peer support, groups, and other related services in a friendly environment.

Purpose of the Role:

The Street Outreach Specialist is part of a coordinated outreach team that identifies and

engages people living in unsheltered locations, such as in cars, parks, abandoned buildings, encampments, and on the streets. To include outreaching shelter homeless individuals and those at risk of becoming homeless.

The outreach team reaches people who might not otherwise seek assistance or come to the attention of the homelessness service system.

Through its work, the team ensures that people’s basic needs are met while supporting

individuals along pathways toward housing stability and quality of life improvements. The Outreach Specialist is responsible for conducting outreach, providing information and

referrals, completing assessments, intakes, performing short-term case management, and

delivering concrete services.

Essential Functions of the Role:

  • Identify and build relationships with organizations and individuals in places such as, but not limited to hospitals, shelters, partner agencies, medical care clinics, mental health providers, soup kitchens, food pantries, associations dedicated to helping marginalized people, etc., promoting and building awareness regarding CHOICE, its mission and services.
  • Respond to calls/requests from the community (public agencies, businesses, libraries,

hospitals, family members, etc.) regarding homeless individuals and those experiencing crisis

  • Co- respond to crisis calls with local government agencies
  • Outreach identified “hot spots” at times when individuals are most likely to be found (early morning including some evenings)
  • Establish rapport and reduce harm by providing critical, life-saving resources such as

food, water, clothing, blankets, and other necessities.

  • Using a trauma-informed approach, provide crisis intervention, harm reduction, and culturally Responsive competent engagement techniques.
  • Meet one-on-one with a person needing services, screen to determine eligibility.
  • For persons eligible to receive benefits and become a client of CHOICE, remain in close partnership with them, monitoring the enrollment process, until intake has been completed.
  • Act as a support partner to a potential client, assisting them with their essential care relationships through the completion of the enrollment
  • Review with Outreach Supervisor (or appointed staff person) for final approval, persons that have been identified as a potential client and can benefit from CHOICE.
  • Complete street outreach assessment (VI-SPDAT) as requested by HOW Supervisor
  • Document all outreach efforts in HMIS (Homeless Management Information System), Relevant and Awards database.
  • Attend meetings, as necessary, at the Department of Community Mental Health, to review client cases.
  • Attend and participate in community events.

Proactively report to Outreach Supervisor trends, relationships and developments in the field; track activity, clients and outcomes.

For all fieldwork:

  • Conduct daily street outreach and respond to calls for assistance
  • Conduct a minimum of 20 intakes per a week
  • Proactively report to the Homeless Outreach Supervisor all trends, relationships, and developments in the field.
  • Track activities and outcomes.

title: Case Planning Supervisor
description:
The Case Planning Supervisor provides oversight, supervision, and guidance to a team of intensive preventive Case Planners and Community Based Support Specialists serving families referred by the Oneida County Department of Family and Community Services (OCDFCS), who may be at risk of being placed into foster care. The Supervisor ensures high-quality, strengths-based, family-centered case planning services that promote child safety, permanency, and well-being. They monitor compliance with meeting all regulatory standards and documentation, while supporting the professional development of their staff. This role acts as the primary link between direct service staff and program management, fostering collaboration across systems and promoting positive outcomes for children and families.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide regular supervision to assigned Case Planners and Community Based Support Specialists, reviewing caseloads, progress, and challenges; offering guidance and support in case management, crisis intervention, and service coordination.
  • Ensure Case Planners deliver services consistent with the agency’s mission, vision, and values; promoting a strengths-based, family-centered, and culturally responsive approach in all case planning activities.
  • Monitor and review the progress of care across Case Planners’ caseloads to ensure services are responsive to family needs, aligned with program standards, and advance permanency planning goals (including preventing foster care placement, expediting reunification, and reducing re-entry into care, etc.).
  • Participate in recruitment, selection, and training of Case Planners.
  • Ensure Case Planners meet all OCDFCS, agency, state, and federal contact requirements, including monthly home visits, mandated face-to-face contacts, service plan reviews, family group conferences, and other casework contacts as outlined in program requirements.
  • Review and approve case plans, progress notes, and documentation to ensure adherence to agency, local OCDFCS, federal, and state standards.
  • Track data, documentation, and compliance metrics to ensure program performance and address gaps in service delivery.
  • Monitor service delivery of assigned Case Planners to ensure compliance with agency and regulatory body requirements.
  • Coordinate with Program Manager, OCDFCS, schools, service providers, and community agencies to support staff and family needs, reduce barriers, and strengthen cross-system collaboration.
  • Attend meetings as required.
  • Provide reports and updates to the Program Manager on caseload activity, challenges, and successes.
  • As needed, provide direct support to staff and/or families in the field, including attending family group conferences, home visits, court appearances, or crisis situations.
  • Review and report incidents according to agency policy.
  • Promote a safe and supportive environment for staff and families, encouraging reflective supervision, professional growth, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Travel primarily within Oneida County with occasional travel in New York State as required.]Additional duties may be assigned, on an as needed basis.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Services or related field with a minimum two years of experience working with youth and their families.
  • Management and supervisory experience working in child welfare setting preferred.
  • A valid NYS Driver's License is required.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Summary

We are seeking a motivated Junior Network Engineer with 0-2 years of experience to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will support the design, deployment, and maintenance of diverse network infrastructures, including LAN, WAN, MAN, and wireless systems. Your contributions will be essential in ensuring reliable connectivity, optimizing performance, and safeguarding our digital assets. You will work across various domains such as ISP operations, cloud connectivity, and security management, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive network efficiency and support business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy scalable network architectures, including local, wide, and metropolitan area networks, alongside wireless solutions.
  • Install, configure, and maintain critical networking hardware such as routers, switches, firewalls, and access points.
  • Manage core network services including IP addressing, VLANs, routing protocols, DNS, DHCP, and VPN configurations.
  • Continuously monitor network health, analyze traffic patterns, and generate performance reports to identify and mitigate potential issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve network faults, hardware failures, and connectivity incidents to minimize system downtime.
  • Provision and manage internet services for customers, including CPE configuration and service activation in compliance with SLAs.
  • Oversee wireless infrastructure, optimizing signal quality and managing Point-to-Point or Point-to-Multipoint links.
  • Support fiber-optic and broadband networks, including GPON and FTTH maintenance, and coordinate with field teams for installations.
  • Implement bandwidth management strategies, including Quality of Service (QoS) and traffic prioritization to prevent congestion.
  • Configure security appliances, intrusion detection systems, and access control protocols to protect against cyber threats.
  • Facilitate server and cloud connectivity, supporting hybrid environments and virtualization platforms.
  • Provide technical support to customers, resolving connectivity issues and offering guidance on network usage.
  • Conduct site surveys, perform equipment installations, and document all field activities and maintenance records.
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, asset inventories, and compliance documentation while adhering to safety and regulatory standards.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assist in capacity planning for future network growth and disaster recovery.
  • Collaborate with software developers, security teams, and project managers to support infrastructure planning and implementation.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
The News Literacy Project

Chief Technology Officer

Full time • Virtual (U.S.) • Reports to the President and CEO

Who we are

The News Literacy Project, founded in 2008, is a nonpartisan, nonprofit organization building a national movement to ensure that all students are guaranteed to be skilled in news literacy before high school graduation, giving them the knowledge and ability to participate in civic society as well-informed, critical thinkers. NLP is the country's leading provider of news literacy education and works with districts and educators in all 50 states, primarily through our signature e-learning platform, Checkology®, and weekly educator newsletter, The Sift®. To read more about the organization and our plans, visit our website.

Where you fit in

The News Literacy Project empowers educators to teach middle and high school students how to sort fact from fiction in the digital age. We are at an exciting inflection point for our work, and we are making critical investments to rapidly scale our growth and impact. To that end, we are seeking the organization's first Chief Technology Officer to lead technology and product functions under NLP’s strategic vision as we scale Checkology's reach nationwide. This is a great opportunity for you to shape the technology foundation of a national movement and directly expand access to news literacy education for hundreds of thousands of students. We're looking for someone who can have an immediate and meaningful impact on our work.

This position reports to the President and CEO.

About the position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) serves as the organization's senior technology leader, responsible for technology vision, platform delivery, digital innovation, operational reliability and technology governance across the organization. The CTO ensures technology investments advance mission impact, support sustainable growth and meet the security, privacy and compliance expectations of K-12 school districts and institutional partners.

The CTO serves as a member of the Executive Team and partners closely with the CEO, COO and functional leaders to translate strategy into technology priorities and measurable outcomes.

Specifically, in this job, you will:

Technology Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and execute a multi-year technology strategy aligned with organizational and programmatic and product priorities.
  • Establish technology principles, governance processes and investment priorities across product and enterprise systems, including annual roadmaps and technology operating and capital budgets tied to organizational outcomes.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on technology opportunities, risks, infrastructure and digital transformation.
  • Chair the internal AI Committee, setting the organization's AI vision, enablement strategy and governing policies.
  • Ensure technology governance processes account for and support the organization's data strategy, in partnership with data leadership.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where innovation meaningfully advances mission and user value.

Product Leadership

  • Oversee the Product team through its senior leader, ensuring strong product strategy, roadmaps and execution.
  • In collaboration with the VP of Product, align architecture, platform investments, and engineering capacity to enable the product roadmap.
  • Balance innovation, user needs, technical feasibility and organizational capacity across all digital offerings.

Cybersecurity, Privacy & District Compliance

  • Establish organization-wide cybersecurity strategy and risk management practices, including incident response planning, business continuity and disaster recovery.
  • Own technology compliance requirements associated with serving K-12 school districts, including policies and controls for student data privacy and security obligations.
  • Oversee district technology approvals, security reviews, vendor questionnaire and procurement-related technical documentation, and maintain readiness for audits and compliance reviews.
  • Ensure systems support district requirements including identity management, rostering, integrations, accessibility and data governance.
  • Maintain security controls, access governance and security awareness programs, and develop policies governing technology use and information security.
  • Monitor organizational technology risk and report regularly to executive leadership.

Technology Operations, Architecture & Vendor Management

  • Lead strategy and performance management of the managed IT services partner, defining service expectations, SLAs, escalation process and accountability mechanisms.
  • Oversee internal technology operations including devices and collaboration tools; identity management, networking and help desk effectiveness, ensuring staff have reliable, secure and scalable technology support.
  • Partner with data leadership to build and maintain the infrastructure that enables organizational measurement, reporting and impact analysis, ensuring responsible use of organizational data.
  • Establish standards for architecture, integrations, technical quality and platform sustainability, and oversee application lifecycle management, technical debt prioritization and platform reliability.
  • Guide build-versus-buy decisions and oversee technology vendor selection, contract negotiation, performance management and ROI evaluation.
  • Drive modernization and operational efficiency across enterprise systems.

This full-time position is virtual. Highly qualified candidates who live in, and are authorized to work in, the United States are encouraged to apply.

About you

This position will directly impact many thousands of educators and hundreds of thousands of students in schools across the country and plays a pivotal role in shaping and achieving our organizational strategy. As the Chief Technology Officer, you will partner with the President and CEO to build the technology vision and infrastructure that powers our next chapter of growth. While we do not expect candidates to meet all qualifications, the successful candidate will have all or most of the following:

Your Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Ten to 12 years of experience with at least seven to ten years of leadership experience in technology, product management, engineering or digital transformation, including at least five years leading cross-functional technology teams.
  • Experience leading technology strategy fora school district, SaaS company, EdTech company or similar, particularly in organizations between 25 and 200 employees.
  • Demonstrated success leading product functions through senior product leaders to deliver customer-centered digital products.
  • Experience overseeing outsourced technology partners, managed service providers, software vendors and technology budgets, contracts and investment decisions.
  • Experience serving on an executive leadership team and contributing to organizational strategy.
  • Mission-driven leader with a passion for improving education through technology and a commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of modern software development, cloud infrastructure, systems architecture, APIs, data integration and enterprise technology.
  • Experience designing and deploying security frameworks aligned with regulatory and compliance regimes.
  • Experience implementing and managing enterprise productivity platforms, CRM systems, learning technologies, analytics platforms and business applications.
  • Working knowledge of AI technologies, automation and emerging technology trends, with the ability to evaluate appropriate organizational applications.

Education Technology & Compliance

  • Experience supporting K-12 school districts or education organizations strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of student data privacy requirements and technology compliance frameworks, including FERPA, COPPA, SOPIPA, state student data privacy laws and accessibility standards such as WCAG.
  • Experience managing district technology reviews, security questionnaires, procurement requirements and integrations such as single sign-on, rostering and learning management systems is preferred.
  • Experience leading security compliance readiness, audits, and the organizational change needed to achieve and maintain certification.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinker who balances long-term vision with operational execution and leads effectively through change.
  • Strong product mindset with a focus on user experience, customer outcomes and measurable impact.
  • Exceptional communicator who translates complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences, executive leadership and the Board of Directors.
  • Demonstrated success building, developing and retaining high-performing teams.
  • Excellent judgment in prioritizing competing organizational needs and allocating resources effectively.

Compensation and benefits

The starting salary for this position is $225,000, but negotiable depending on the candidate's qualifications, experience and our organizational budget. NLP also offers outstanding perks and benefits, including health, vision and dental insurance, a 401(k) plan match, unlimited PTO, flexible work environment and more. For an overview of our generous benefits package, check it out on our Careers page.

Applications

To apply, upload a cover letter, work samples and a résumé at https://bit.ly/NLPJobs. The application deadline is 12 a.m. ET on Tuesday, Aug. 11, 2026. We hope to hire as quickly as possible for a start date around Nov. 1, 2026. Preference will be given to candidates who reside in the following states: CA, CT, DC, FL, GA, HI, IL, IA, LA, MD, MA, MN, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TX, VA, WA, and WV.

Work Samples

As part of your application, please upload two to three work samples that demonstrate your experience in the following areas. A single sample may cover more than one area.

  1. Technology or product roadmap. A roadmap you developed and executed, along with the context, how you prioritized competing needs and what outcomes resulted.
  1. Data privacy and compliance. An example of how you worked through a data privacy agreement, district security review or similar compliance process, such as a policy you authored, a review response or a summary of your approach and its outcome.
  1. AI leadership. An artifact showing how you led an organization, district or company through AI adoption or governance, such as an AI policy, committee charter, enablement strategy for board presentation.

For each sample, please include a short summary (a few sentences) telling us what we're looking at, which area or areas it addresses and your specific role in creating it.

Please remove or redact confidential information, including organization names, before submitting. A sanitized excerpt or a one-page written summary of your approach is acceptable where the original work product cannot be shared. Samples will be evaluated on clarity of thinking, judgment and communication rather than visual polish.

NOTE: To ensure the integrity and fairness of our anonymized evaluation process in making the initial assessment of candidates based on skills and experience, staff members do not respond to individual inquiries about employment with NLP. Please visit our website for more information.

Our hiring process

Candidates selected to participate will be invited to an initial phone screen and up to three rounds of virtual interviews, conducted with pairs and small groups of NLP leaders and stakeholders.

Finalists will be asked to provide references.

The News Literacy Project welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We offer equal opportunity in employment for all qualified persons and prohibit discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including sexual orientation and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, age, veteran status, disability unrelated to job requirements, genetic information, military service or other protected status.

We deeply value diversity in the workplace and strongly believe that a diverse team enriches our organization and strengthens our ability to realize our mission (read/print NLP's Organizational Values and Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion).

title: Principal Product Manager, Experimentation Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Manager, Experimentation Platform based in United States.

This is a senior product leadership role focused on building the shared foundations that enable experimentation at scale.
You will shape the strategy and roadmap for an experimentation platform supporting product, engineering, analytics, and machine learning teams.
The role combines technical product management, quantitative decision-making, and platform strategy to improve how teams test, learn, and innovate.
You will help establish common experimentation standards, abstractions, and guardrails that increase rigor while reducing fragmentation.
Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will expand capabilities across randomized experiments, model deployments, feature flags, and emerging experimentation patterns.
You will also help create a center of excellence that enables teams across the organization to adopt stronger and more consistent experimentation practices.
This is a remote, digital-first opportunity for an experienced product leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems and influencing teams across a distributed organization

Accountabilities:

  • Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for the experimentation platform, balancing immediate business priorities with a scalable long-term vision that supports emerging and agentic product experiences.
  • Partner closely with Machine Learning, Analytics, Engineering, Product, and other technical teams to develop shared experimentation capabilities, including randomized experiments, model deployment, feature flags, measurement, and emerging experimentation approaches.
  • Establish common abstractions, standards, and guardrails that reduce fragmentation, improve experimentation quality, and make it easier for product and engineering teams to test ideas and learn with confidence.
  • Build and guide a center of excellence for experimentation by defining best practices, strengthening methodological rigor, and enabling teams throughout the organization to adopt effective experimentation practices.
  • Work with stakeholder groups across Growth, Servicing, Capital, and other business areas to understand needs, identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and drive adoption of shared platform capabilities.
  • Shape the organization’s experimentation technology strategy by evaluating external vendors, internal development opportunities, and the right balance between third-party solutions and internally built capabilities.
  • Influence technical and product decisions across multiple teams, connecting experimentation infrastructure and capabilities to broader product priorities and business outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, combined with 7+ years of product management experience.
    • Proven experience owning strategy and roadmaps for technically complex software, platform, infrastructure, data, or developer-facing products.
    • Strong experience partnering with Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Analytics teams on technical architecture, product tradeoffs, prioritization, and delivery.
    • Demonstrated ability to apply quantitative methods such as statistics, experimentation, analytics, or data science to product development and decision-making.
    • Experience developing platforms that support Machine Learning or AI workflows, particularly around deployment, measurement, or experimentation.
    • Preferred experience building or leading an experimentation platform product within a consumer technology environment or an experimentation technology provider.
    • Strong knowledge of experimentation methodologies, including randomized experiments, feature flags, model experimentation, metric design, and statistical evaluation.
    • Ability to translate shared technical capabilities into platform strategies that support broader organizational and product priorities.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and quantitative concepts to engineers, data scientists, product teams, and senior leaders.
    • Proven ability to build alignment across multiple product and technical teams, establish shared practices, and influence stakeholders within a distributed organization.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote position available across the United States, with the team operating across East Coast and West Coast time zones.
      • Anticipated U.S. base salary range of $187,900–$260,000, with actual compensation determined by geographic location, skills, experience, education, and training.
      • Target bonus opportunities and annual equity grants that vest quarterly.
      • 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually in the U.S.
      • Employee Stock Purchase Plan with discounted stock purchase options for eligible U.S. employees.
      • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and wellness coverage, plus Health Savings Account contributions for eligible U.S. plans.
      • Life insurance and disability coverage for additional income protection and financial security.
      • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays in accordance with applicable requirements.
      • Paid family and parental leave, along with family-centered support for fertility, parenthood, and caregiving.
      • Employee Assistance Program providing mental health support and additional life resources.
      • Financial wellness resources, including financial planning tools and access to a financial concierge service for U.S. employees.
      • Annual wellness allowance supporting physical, emotional, and personal development priorities.
      • Annual productivity allowance to help employees invest in tools and resources that support effective remote work.

location: Greater Minneapolis/St. Paul, MN [partial in-office requirement]
description:
Location: Minneapolis, MN
Hires local to the Twin Cities Metro-Area can anticipate an in-office component of 1-2 days a week, employed with Bold Orange. If this position lists, “Open to Remote”, hires outside of the metro area can anticipate travel to our Minneapolis, MN office on an as-requested basis. We value human connection and some travel is anticipated.
About Bold Orange:
Bold Orange (BOCO) is a customer experience company. We believe authentic human connections are the single most important driver of business and societal progress. We exist to create these connections across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition to engagement to retention. Our culture is one of curiosity, collaboration, proactivity and always bringing the outside, future focused perspective to our clients.
Position Summary:

Bold Orange is seeking a curious, versatile, and business-minded Associate Strategy Director to help our clients solve complex customer and growth challenges.

Strategy at Bold Orange sits at the intersection of business, brand, customer experience, data and technology. Our strategists help define the problem, determine the right approach, develop the strategy, and stay connected through execution. Our work spans the end-to-end customer lifecycle from awareness to conversion to retention, which means you might be shaping a value proposition or go-to-market strategy on one engagement and designing a customer journey, CRM strategy or experience roadmap on another.

At the Associate Director level, you’ll independently lead strategy engagements from ambiguous client questions through actionable recommendations. You’ll facilitate senior client conversations, guide other strategists, collaborate closely with Creative, UX, Analytics, Technology and Client Services, and remain hands-on in the development of the work.

We’re especially interested in strategists who have worked across both upstream business, brand and go-to-market challenges and downstream customer experience, CRM and lifecycle challenges. You don't need to be a MarTech implementer, but you should understand how data, audiences, platforms, channels, and journeys come together to create connected customer experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Lead the end-to-end development of strategy projects like: brand creation and value prop development; campaigns and go-to-market plans; experience mapping and journey design, messaging hierarchy and content strategy, developing near and long-term roadmaps.
  • Work collaboratively with client services/account management to intake client business challenges and opportunities and translate them into a well-defined approach or project plan that delivers against the objectives.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Creative, Design, UX, Analytics, and Technology, to gather requirements upfront—and stick around to ensure the strategic vision is executed seamlessly.
  • Facilitate senior-level client conversations related to how we approach and deliver our work, giving them the “why” behind the “what.”
  • Translate research, industry trends, competitive analysis, and data insights into compelling strategic recommendations.
  • Map, audit, and analyze customer journeys and experiences, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization, and building the roadmap to deliver them.
  • Conduct and analyze qualitative and quantitative research, including stakeholder interviews, surveys, 3rd-party tools like SEMRush or MRI Simmons, Hotjar, Persado, etc.
  • Advocate for user-centered design methodologies and incorporate a human-centered POV into strategic planning.
  • Stay ahead of emerging industry trends, digital innovations, and marketing technology advancements to bring forward strategic recommendations.
  • Create and deliver compelling presentations and strategic storytelling in PowerPoint, Miro, and other tools.
  • Manage and mentor early career strategists, fostering professional growth and development.

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or equivalent certifications/work experience.
  • 8+ years relevant work experience in digital marketing, customer experience, brand strategy or content strategy roles. Agency or consultancy experience is required.
  • Working knowledge and experience with martech strategy and platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Braze, AEM) including the creation or modification of journeys, segments, campaigns, etc.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional teams that require deep collaboration with designers, analysts, developers, marketers, and more.
  • Ability to synthesize data and research findings that tease out insights beyond simple reporting; we are the storytellers that paint the picture and design the roadmap.
  • Experience in a “lead” role on an account or with a client, encompassing strategic leadership at both the project and account level.
  • Experience designing and architecting projects and scopes of work.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Like turning messy questions into structured problems.
  • Have strong opinions, loosely held.
  • Are as comfortable in a working session as you are in a polished presentation.
  • Can zoom from business strategy to the details of a customer journey.
  • Get energy from collaborating with people who know things you don't.
  • Are willing to challenge the brief when you think we're solving the wrong problem.
  • Enjoy making other strategists better, not just doing great work yourself.
  • Are curious about what is changing outside the walls of the agency and bring it back to clients.

Benefits That Matter:

Our benefits are designed to support life’s many stages—expected and unexpected. Eligible employees can access:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Virtual mental health support

• Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts (including dependent care)

• Infertility and critical illness benefits

• 401(k) with generous 6–10% employer contribution

• Paid parental leave

• Tuition reimbursement

• Free parking and commuter support

Note: Some benefits apply only to full-time employees.

Who We Are:

Our tone is professionally sassy. We embrace meat raffles, hot seats, and the occasional Jell-O shot. We like staff meetings that are informative, educational, and at times, damn funny. We believe in no hierarchy, no bullshit, no politics. Just honest, hard work and great fun.

Important to note: While we value AI as a tool, AI is not invited to Bold Orange interviews. We want to meet the wonderfully talented human you! Any suspected use of AI to inform or assist, while actively in an interview with Bold Orange, will result in exclusion from consideration for the role to which you applied or were referred.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of nondiscrimination in employment on any basis including race, color, creed, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, national origin, marital status, familial status, ancestry, status as a veteran, status with regard to public assistance and any other characteristic protected by law. Bold Orange does not and will not discriminate against employees, prospective employees, clients, or vendors.

title: OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
description:
The Operations Executive is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across the Company's manufacturing, supply chain, warehouse, logistics, procurement, and distribution functions. The role ensures efficient utilization of resources, cost optimization, regulatory compliance, continuous improvement, and timely delivery of quality products while supporting the Company's growth objectives.


Key Responsibilities

1. Operational Strategy and Planning

• Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with the Company's strategic plan.
• Prepare annual operational plans, budgets, and departmental objectives.
• Monitor operational performance and implement corrective actions where necessary.
• Lead operational improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and productivity.

2. Production Oversight

• Oversee production planning to ensure customer demand is met.
• Ensure efficient utilization of labour, machinery, and raw materials.
• Monitor production performance, downtime, and waste reduction initiatives.
• Collaborate with the Production Manager to improve manufacturing efficiency.

3. Supply Chain and Procurement Management

• Oversee procurement planning to ensure uninterrupted production.
• Maintain effective supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
• Ensure timely procurement of raw materials, packaging materials, and operational supplies.
• Monitor procurement costs and identify cost-saving opportunities.

4. Warehouse and Inventory Management

• Ensure accurate inventory control and stock accountability.
• Oversee periodic stock counts and inventory reconciliations.
• Minimize inventory losses, expiries, and stock variances.
• Ensure optimum stock levels to support business operations.

5. Logistics and Distribution

• Ensure efficient distribution of finished goods to customers and distributors.
• Monitor delivery performance and customer service standards.
• Optimize transport utilization and distribution costs.
• Ensure compliance with transportation and safety requirements.

6. Financial and Cost Management

• Prepare and manage the operations budget.
• Monitor operational expenditure against approved budgets.
• Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs without compromising quality.
• Support profitability through operational efficiency initiatives.

7. Quality, Food Safety, and Compliance

• Ensure compliance with food safety, quality assurance, OSHA, and regulatory requirements.
• Promote adherence to Company policies, SOPs, and industry standards.
• Support internal and external audits and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.

8. Leadership and People Management

• Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to the operations team.
• Set departmental KPIs and monitor employee performance.
• Identify training and development needs within the operations function.
• Promote teamwork, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.

9. Risk Management

• Identify operational risks and implement mitigation measures.
• Ensure business continuity plans are maintained and regularly reviewed.
• Monitor operational incidents and ensure timely corrective action.

10. Reporting and Performance Monitoring

• Prepare monthly and quarterly operational performance reports.
• Present operational updates and recommendations to the CEO and Executive Management.
• Analyze KPIs and implement action plans to improve operational performance.


Requirements

Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics Management, or a related field.
• A Master's Degree is an added advantage.

Experience

• Minimum of 3 years' progressive experience in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics.
• At least 2 years in a supervisory or management position.
• Experience in the FMCG or food manufacturing industry is highly desirable.

title: Data Scientist, Research, Reliability Analytics
description:
The Reliability Analytics Team is on a mission to improve decisions and systems in Platform Reliability Engineering (PRE) through data and data science. We address a broad spectrum of reliability problems where data-driven approaches can be applied, combining subject matter expertise with statistical, predictive, and generative AI/ML methods to improve reliability in ways that truly matter to Google's users and customers.

In this role, you will design statistical and machine learning tools, influencing engineering priorities and roadmaps in key areas like software rollouts and change management. You will have a direct impact on Google Cloud Platform reliability, gaining deep knowledge of relevant engineering infrastructure and data assets to solve complex issues.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

  • Design and build statistical, machine learning, and AI tools, alongside investigative data pipelines, for integration into existing or new reliability infrastructure.
  • Apply data science to improve Google Cloud Platform reliability in partnership with the Platform Reliability Engineering (PRE) organization, focusing on change supervision and rollouts.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to build and improve reliability tools according to engineering priorities.
  • Gain deep knowledge of relevant engineering infrastructure and data assets to influence engineering roadmaps and priorities.
  • Contribute to team-wide learning forums and broader data science initiatives.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 3 years of work experience with a PhD degree.
  • Experience with Python, SQL, and statistical modeling.
  • Experience working with generative AI agents.

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
  • Experience in software development and source control methodologies.
  • Experience working with cloud computing or distributed computing environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to build investigative tools and data pipelines for infrastructure integration.
  • Proven track record of influencing engineering priorities and roadmaps.

title: Office Administrator
description:
BIS Safety Software is a SaaS company on a mission to change how organizations manage safety, learning, and compliance. We sell safety software to businesses and online safety training to the people who need it, and we are looking for an Office Administrator to keep our workplace running: the space, the systems, and the day-to-day details that keep everyone else moving.

About the role

This role isn't about waiting for a task list. It's about being the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen.

You'll own the building and the office: supplies, equipment, repairs, maintenance, and the vendors and contractors behind all of it. You'll handle purchasing across the company. And you'll be the person our sales team counts on for trade show logistics and travel, which is a steady and genuinely fun part of the role.

Done well, this job looks like things getting handled before anyone else has to think about them. When something needs fixing, you'll be the one bringing three quotes and a recommendation. You'll have the autonomy to use your judgment and the trust to act on it.

We're hiring for the person as much as the resume. If you have a track record of taking things on and seeing them through, we'd like to meet you.

This is an in-person role based out of our Sherwood Park, Alberta office.

In this role, you'll be expected to:

  • Facility Management: Taking the lead on all all office/building needs, including the coordination of needed supplies and equipment, arranging repairs and maintenance, managing assets and ensuring the necessary insurance and service contracts are in place
  • Purchasing: own the acquisition of the materials and services the business needs, with a close eye on cost and quality.
  • Sales and trade show support: manage trade show logistics and the moving parts that come with supporting a busy sales team.
  • Travel and administration: book flights and travel, coordinate couriers and deliveries, and handle the day-to-day details that keep our operation running.
  • Vendor and Contractor Coordination: Establish and maintain productive relationships with vendors and maintenance contractors. Oversee work to ensure quality and timeliness, and manage any disputes or concerns.
  • Logistics and Equipment: Collaborate with the IT department for the procurement, installation, and maintenance of office equipment and technology.
  • Project Coordination: Collaborate with various departments to facilitate the smooth execution of ongoing projects. Ensure that all departmental needs are met in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Employee Engagement and Culture: Play an active role in organizing and executing employee engagement and culture building activities. Assist in planning and coordinating company events, workshops, and meetings.
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate records and files related to office operations, vendor contracts, and maintenance schedules. Prepare reports on office expenditures and recommend cost-saving strategies.
  • SharePoint Management: Update and manage SharePoint content, ensuring training documents and team resources are current and accessible. Provide or coordinate training for team members on how to effectively use SharePoint for collaboration and information sharing.

You might be the right fit if you are:

  • Operating like an owner, spotting what needs to happen and handling it without being asked twice.
  • Staying meticulous about details and organization when the day gets away from you.
  • Working comfortably across departments and keeping a lot of moving pieces on track.
  • Thriving in ambiguity and enjoying the process of learning new systems, software, and skills.
  • Listening well and solving problems instead of passing them along.
  • Communicating clearly in writing and in conversation, with a sharp eye for proofreading and editing.
  • Working confidently in Microsoft Office, including SharePoint, Excel, Word, and Teams, and picking up new tools quickly.
  • Bringing a positive approach to the work and ideas for how things could work better.

Qualifications

  • Background in office administration, office coordination, or a similar role. We care more about how you work than how many years you've done it.
  • Must be strong with Microsoft Office (e.g., SharePoint, Excel, Word, Teams).
  • Comfort working with vendors, suppliers, and purchasing.
  • Self-starting with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Positive in your approach to work and eager to share ideas for improvement.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance and disability insurance
  • Health spending account
  • Flexible working hours
  • On-the-job training and growth opportunities
  • Free on-site parking

About BIS:

BIS Safety Software has been headquartered in Sherwood Park, Alberta, since 2006. We build software that helps organizations manage safety training, learning, and compliance - and we’re growing!

A few things that make us different: we don’t use job titles internally - we value humility and contribution over hierarchy. We move fast, integrate new ideas quickly, and give people real ownership of their work. And through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), you have the opportunity to own a piece of the company you’re helping build.

How to apply:

Visit our Careers Page for more information. We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us
