NY Green Bank is a sustainable infrastructure investment fund and a division of the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). NY Green Bank is a State-sponsored, specialized financial entity that works with the private sector to increase investments into New York’s clean energy markets, creating a more efficient, reliable and sustainable energy system.


As a green bank, it uses public capital to mobilize private investment to address and alleviate specific gaps and barriers in current clean energy capital markets, with the goal of enabling private investors to expand their sustainable infrastructure portfolios over time.


NY Green Bank’s mission is to work in collaboration with the private sector to animate financing markets through innovative transactions that accelerate clean energy investments, combat climate change, and equitably deliver both economic and environmental benefits to all New Yorkers.


As a leader in advancing New York’s energy transition, NYSERDA is a credible, objective and trusted partner in energy planning and in deploying new innovative technologies to build an affordable, abundant, reliable, and clean energy system. NYSERDA works with stakeholders including residents, business owners, developers, community leaders, local government officials, universities, utilities, investors, entrepreneurs, and more, to develop, invest, and foster conditions that:

  • Attract the private sector capital investment needed to expand New York’s clean energy economy.
  • Advance solutions for using clean energy at a large-scale in New York.
  • Enable New York’s communities and residents to benefit equitably in the clean energy transition.


Job Overview

The Vice President will report to the Head of Business Development & Innovation and be responsible for leading NY Green Bank’s (NYGB) efforts to develop new and innovative financial products and solutions that address market barriers in New York’s clean energy markets. These solutions will complement and enhance NYGB’s product offerings – addressing market barriers – with the potential to be replicated and adopted more broadly over time by the private sector investment community. The VP will work closely with NYGB investment and portfolio managers, risk and legal colleagues as well as externally with project developers, sponsors, capital providers, and other stakeholders to develop product innovations and enhancements that address market barriers and drive the financial market transformation outcomes at the core of NYGB’s mission and purpose.

Primary Responsibilities


Financial Product Innovation

  • Develops innovative financial products, solutions, and strategies that address market barriers identified by NYGB through market feedback gathered from continuous dialogue with capital providers, developers, sponsors and from stakeholder engagement at NYGB-hosted events and industry conferences.
  • Leads the internal approval process for the development, financial modeling, structuring, launch, and promotion of such new products.
  • Applies established project and real estate finance principles to product innovations to optimize adoption and replication by the private sector investment community.
  • Leverages NYGB’s relationships with existing and prospective borrowers, developers, and sponsors to socialize product innovations and incorporate such feedback to establish confidence that proposed product innovations are adequately addressing identified market barriers.
  • Leads product innovation outreach, promotion, and business development efforts to ensure that anticipated update and demand is achieved post product launch.

Market & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Stays informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, regulatory shifts, and market barriers through continuous engagement with project developers and sponsors, capital providers, utilities, NYSERDA colleagues, other NYS agencies and authorities, and other market participants.
  • Fosters strong relationships with the broader NYSERDA organization through regular contact and maintains up to date knowledge of programs administered by NYSERDA and other New York entities to identify synergistic opportunities to address market barriers and drive financial market transformation outcomes.
  • Develops, maintains, and fosters new relationships with developers, sponsors, and capital providers. Actively utilizes NYGB’s CRM system to record and track such relations and engagement.

Organization Leadership

  • Works closely with the Head of Business Development & Innovation to develop annual strategic product innovation plans, cross-functional initiatives, and team/organization goals on a prioritized basis with established goals, objectives, and key results.
  • Oversees work quality and ensures professional development of junior members of the team through coaching, training, and feedback.
  • Perform all job responsibilities with respect, fairness, consistency, and inclusion consistent with NYSERDA’s Core Values.
  • Performs other responsibilities as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and five years’ clean energy finance work experience.
  • First-hand experience in leading the execution of clean energy project finance transactions.
  • Effective negotiator and persuasive communicator who can creatively structure solutions to complex financing problems, embodying a collaborative approach.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple parallel workstreams under tight deadlines.
  • Proactive, self-directed professional who takes ownership and follows through on obligations.
  • Unwavering professional ethics, discretion, and judgment in handling sensitive issues.
  • Passion for clean energy, sustainability, public service, economic development, and a mission driven organization.
  • Embodies and promotes respect, inclusion, and fairness in all interactions.
  • Strong knowledge of communications, coupled with outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex issues to stakeholders, both internally and externally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration and four years’ related work experience.
  • Knowledge of real estate finance

description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Project Manager is responsible for the project management services ECRS provides for Point-of-Sale rollouts to ensure that the customer implementation process runs efficiently and meets expectations. The Project Manager works as a liaison between the ECRS Sales, Deployment, Support, Services, Development, and Marketing departments and the customer. The Project Manager coordinates all installation-related activities for new and existing customers that require on-site and remote management including, but not limited to, database construction, credit card processing setup, register area preparation, and networking and power management.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Organize introductory meetings with the Sales Executive and customer to understand and review the project once a signed contract and deposit are received.
  • Work with assigned customer accounts to determine goals and objectives.
  • Create and assign project issues with clear goals and associated target dates for each implementation task. These issues must be monitored and updated on a regular basis providing pressure and/or information as needed.
  • Create ECRS Support Desk issues as needed and monitor communication and updates until resolved during the installation process.
  • Schedule and coordinate meetings with the customers on a regular basis. Each meeting will require an agenda outlining the topics to be discussed as well as detailed action steps captured during the meeting and communicated prior to ending the meeting.
  • Work with the Deployment and Inventory departments to ensure that the equipment is pulled and staged in accordance with customer’s requirements prior to shipment.
  • Assist with documenting specific customer requirements when new product enhancements are required.
  • Work with the Development and Sales teams to prepare estimates and specifications following the Contractual Commitment Corporate Policy. Manage timelines for contractual commitments and keeps customer informed.
  • Manage phased rollouts for multi-store sites that require multiple on-site visits for installation and training. Create projects plans in conjunction with Customer expectations.
  • Schedule onsite and/or remote resources to meet the implementation schedule. Update and report on project installation schedules on a weekly basis to reduce resource conflicts.
  • Conduct post-implementation project summary meetings with customers to review the process, project results, and customer satisfaction level with the project execution prior to closing each project.

  • Two-year degree or equivalent prior experience.
  • Business or IT courses are a plus.

  • Planning and project management experience.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

title: Medewerker klantcontactcentrum
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe omgeving waarin jij jouw klantgerichtheid en communicatieve vaardigheden optimaal kunt inzetten voor onze patiënten? Zorg jij ervoor dat de planning van afspraken optimaal verloopt voor onze poliklinieken en patiënten? Dan is onze functie van medewerker klant contact centrum de baan van je leven!

Het Klant Contact Centrum (KCC) van het Reinier de Graaf Ziekenhuis is onderdeel van het Facilitair Bedrijf. Op ons KCC behandelen we het telefoonverkeer een aantal poliklinieken. Het is een afdeling die nog volop in ontwikkeling en aan het groeien is. Ons uiteindelijk doel is om onze dienstverlening in te zetten voor alle poliklinieken van het ziekenhuis. Klantvriendelijkheid en kwaliteit staan bij ons hoog in het vaandel dus zowel voor onze patiënten als richting onze poliklinieken. Daarom verloopt het proces van uitbreiding stap voor stap, zodat we onze kwaliteit en klantgerichtheid optimaal kunnen houden en kunnen borgen.

Als medewerker KCC ben jij de schakel tussen de polikliniek en onze patiënten. Je beantwoordt vragen, checkt en registreert de patiëntgegevens en daarnaast voer je alle werkzaamheden uit omtrent afspraken voor een polikliniekbezoek en handel je dit op de juiste manier af. Aan de hand van duidelijke scripts doorloop je samen met de patiënt het afsprakenproces en zo zorg je ervoor dat de planning van de polikliniek optimaal verloopt voor zowel onze zorgverleners als de patiënten.

Ben jij een ervaren klantenservicemedewerker met affiniteit met de zorg en wil je jouw kennis en vaardigheden inzetten in een betekenisvolle omgeving? Krijg jij er energie van om onze patiënten zo goed mogelijk te helpen en houd jij je hoofd koel in een hectische omgeving? Kun jij goed prioriteiten stellen en zorg jij ervoor dat de dag voorspoedig verloopt voor jou en je collega’s. Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou!

Wij vragen

  • Je beschikt over een diploma op minimaal MBO-4 niveau;
  • Je hebt ervaring als medewerker klantenservice bij bijvoorbeeld een verzekeraar, alarmcentrale of vergelijkbaar;
  • Werkervaring binnen een ziekenhuis is een pre.

De procedure

Solliciteren naar de vacature van medewerker klantcontactcentrum (KCC)? Upload jouw cv en motivatiebrief via de solliciteer button t.a.v. Michelle Bossers-Doeve, senior recruiter.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Corrie Kloosterman, medewerker klantcontactcentrum (015 260 47 93 (ma-wo-vrij van 13:00-16:30 uur)) helpt je graag!

Vragen over de procedure? Bel of stuur een WhatsApp bericht naar Michelle via 06 - 82 306 407.

Solliciteren kan tot en met 10 september aanstaande. De eerste gesprekken staan gepland op vrijdag 18 en maandag 21 september in de ochtend.

Let op: Bij een overweldigend aantal reacties kan het zijn dat we de vacature toch eerder sluiten dan de genoemde sluitingsdatum. Wacht dan ook niet met solliciteren tot de sluitingsdatum.

title: Regional Director North Texas- 2025858
description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?

If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.

At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.
ORGANIZATION SUMMARY
World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.

Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:
The Regional Director at World Relief is a key leadership position responsible for overseeing and managing multiple sites within a specific region. In addition to providing strategic direction and operational oversight, the Regional Director is actively involved in cultivating relationships with donors, foundations, and other funding sources to secure financial resources necessary for regional/state sustainability and growth. This role provides strategic direction, operational oversight, and effective management of programs and resources across various locations. The Regional Director plays a crucial role in ensuring the successful implementation of World Relief's mission and objectives, while also fostering collaboration and synergy among the different sites. This position requires a strong ability to lead and inspire teams, build and maintain relationships with stakeholders, and ensure high-quality program delivery in alignment with World Relief's standards and best practices. The Regional Director serves as a representative of World Relief in the region, advocating for refugees and immigrants, the organization's vision and values, and promoting positive change and impact in the communities served.
This is a hybrid role- 4 days in office/1 work from home.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsible for the health and sustainability of all offices in the region. Lead the Site Managers/Site Directors in the region by:
• Communicating the mission, vision, values, and strategic directions of World Relief to regional offices and all staff.
• Providing leadership to direct reports by developing strategic plans for growth, sustainability and stabilization, and providing thorough communication, encouragement, prayer support, and accountability.
• Encouraging and assisting Site Manager/Site Directors in financial stability, church and community outreach and engagement.
• Leading regional fundraising efforts, cultivating regional and state relationships with important community partners and stakeholders while ensuring compliance with reporting requirements.
• Collaborating with the development and advocacy teams to meet financial targets and sustain and expand opportunities to serve refugees and immigrants for greater region/statewide impact.
• Engage regional and state stakeholders to expand quality resettlement and immigrant programming in the region/state. This includes seeking state-wide (public and private) funding opportunities and maintaining a strong connection with the State Refugee Coordinator’s office.
• Develop, grow and lead a cohesive network of services, that leverages regional efficiencies across multiple offices to serve our constituency in the designated region and ensure good stewardship of resources.
• Contribute to the US Leadership Team and provide vital Field perspective to Senior Leadership through long-term and short-term planning in all areas as relevant to US Service Ministries such as:
  1. Strategy (development and implementation)
  2. Leadership training
  3. Marketing support
  4. Finance support
  5. Human Relations support
  6. Organizational efficiencies and appropriate stewardship of resources
Essential Functions:
• Direct supervision of Site Directors, Site managers, and other regional staff including individual performance management, maintaining scheduled routine communication (including on-site visits)
• Facilitate and/or provide program evaluation and new program development in terms of mission, vision, values, and strategic directions.
• Oversight of any potential church-based programs and/or new offices in the region.
• Monitor budget/spending for all offices in region and provide initial consultation and actions to address overspending.
• Provide consultative assistance to Site Directors/Managers in evaluating mission/strategic fit, financial cost/benefit in funding opportunities.
• Review organizational and personnel changes from all sites.
• Act as the primary collaborator with Home Office by attending appropriate network-wide meetings, cascading relevant updates and information, and providing feedback to the Senior Leadership Team.
• Ensure the annual maintenance of Office Profiles and Site Security Plans.
• Keep abreast of security incidents in the region and assist in closing Incident Reports when necessary.
• Assist the US leadership in developing and maintaining US Ministries resources and documentation.
• Provide interim leadership for staff transitions in offices of your region.
  • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees, including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values, including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • Valid drivers license, access to reliable vehicle and ability to pass MVR standards
  • 5+ years management experience
  • Graduate degree in related field or demonstrated equivalent experience
  • Authorization to legally work in the US
  • Travel required – up to 50%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience managing multiple staff/departments and budgets over 1 million dollars
  • Experience managing multi-site operations preferred
  • Knowledge of US refugee and immigration policy and programming
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
  • Experience in team building and staff development
  • Experience managing state and federal grants, grant writing and fundraising
  • Cross-cultural experience: Experience with refugee populations preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Word and Excel, and web-based interfaces such as SharePoint
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time, Regular, employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.
***
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

title: Key Holder (Atlanta)

By maintaining strong relationships with farmers, cooperatives, and suppliers, the supervisor ensures timely and reliable supply while upholding stringent food safety, hygiene, and agricultural best-practice standards. The role also involves monitoring field productivity, managing operational challenges, and coordinating closely with production teams to align raw material availability with manufacturing schedules. Through effective supervision, training, and quality control, the Field Work Assistant contributes directly to the consistency, quality, and scalability of Varli Foods’ finished food products.

Responsibilities:
  • Assist in the supervision of all field operations including raw material sourcing, harvesting coordination, and quality inspection of plantain, cassava, and other crops
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with farmers, cooperatives, and external suppliers to ensure reliable and timely delivery of raw materials
  • Assist in overseeing post-harvest handling and transportation processes to minimize spoilage and preserve product quality
  • Enforce compliance with food safety, hygiene, and agricultural best-practice standards at the field level
  • Track and report on field productivity, supply volumes, and operational challenges to support strategic decision-making
  • Collaborate with production and processing teams to align raw material supply with manufacturing schedules
  • Assist in the supervision, and support of field staff and casual laborers to maintain operational efficiency and quality standards

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity

Team GSD is Fullscript’s internal AI and automation team. We build the shared infrastructure, integrations, and internal tools that help Fullscripters improve how work gets done across the company. We’re looking for a Staff Developer to help shape and build the technical foundation behind that work.

Our work starts with real business problems. We use AI and modern automation to reduce manual effort, connect fragmented workflows, and give teams practical tools they can rely on in production. We care about speed, but we also care about building systems that are secure, observable, maintainable, and able to scale.

This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role focused on internal products and infrastructure rather than Fullscript’s customer-facing platform. You will design and operate production systems that connect large language models with company data, tools, and workflows through technologies such as MCP, agentic systems, model gateways, and workflow orchestration.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy. Direction and business context will come from the GSD team and targeted conversations with business owners, but you will be expected to define the technical path, challenge assumptions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and carry meaningful work from an ambiguous problem through production. This is not a ticket-driven role.

At the Staff level, your impact will extend beyond the systems you personally build. You will help determine what GSD should tackle next, influence architectural decisions, act as a thought partner to other experienced developers, and raise the team’s technical capability through reviews, pairing, documentation, office hours, and engineering discussions.

This is how we like building software:. If you share our values, we’d be excited to talk with you.

What you'll do

  • Architect and build production-grade internal AI tools and shared platform capabilities used by teams across Fullscript.

  • Lead the technical design and delivery of complex AI integrations, including MCP-based tool use, agentic workflows, context layers, model gateways, and workflow automation.

  • Independently take ambiguous business problems from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, deployment, measurement, and ongoing operation.

  • Develop and maintain the infrastructure that connects approved models with Fullscript’s internal systems, data, APIs, and user workflows.

  • Own the reliability, scalability, observability, and security of production AI systems, including model routing, evaluation, access control, and the responsible handling of sensitive data.

  • Build internal experiences that are useful to people across the business, contributing across backend services, infrastructure, and user-facing interfaces where the problem requires it.

  • Work with GSD teammates, engineers, and business owners to understand high-value workflows and translate them into maintainable technical solutions without becoming dependent on heavy stakeholder oversight.

  • Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, and patterns through practical experimentation, then make clear recommendations about what Fullscript should adopt, adapt, or avoid.

  • Shape GSD’s technical roadmap by identifying reusable platform opportunities, challenging architectural assumptions, and connecting engineering investments to measurable business impact.

  • Act as a force multiplier through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, technical guidance, documentation, office hours, and active participation in the broader engineering community.

What you bring to the table

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including demonstrated impact as a technical leader on complex production systems.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-enabled applications in production, including strong familiarity with MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, agents, context management, and LLM integrations.

  • A track record of building internal tools, developer platforms, or enterprise systems that were adopted by real users and produced measurable operational impact.

  • Deep backend engineering expertise in Ruby, Python, or a comparable language, along with the ability to learn new languages and frameworks as the problem requires.

  • Strong systems-design fundamentals, including APIs, integrations, distributed systems, data flows, authentication, authorization, and pragmatic architectural trade-offs.

  • Practical cloud and DevOps experience operating reliable systems in AWS or a comparable environment, including CI/CD, containers, serverless infrastructure, observability, and infrastructure as code.

  • The ability to work independently through ambiguity, define your own path forward, and drive substantial initiatives to completion without waiting for detailed requirements or a queue of tickets.

  • Clear, credible communication and Staff-level influence, with the ability to explain decisions, challenge other experienced engineers constructively, share knowledge, and connect technical work to business outcomes.

Bonus if you have

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, or GraphQL and the ability to contribute to full-stack internal applications.

  • Experience with n8n, Temporal, or another workflow orchestration platform.

  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability platforms such as Langfuse.

  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Cloudflare Workers, or similar infrastructure and deployment tooling.

  • Experience building technology in healthcare or another regulated environment governed by standards such as HIPAA or SOC 2.

Technical Envionrment
  • Languages and frameworks: Ruby, React, TypeScript, Python, GraphQL, and SQL
  • AI and LLM: Multiple LLM providers, AWS Bedrock, AI gateway, MCP, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation and observability tooling
  • Infrastructure: AWS, EKS/Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Cloudflare, serverless services, and infrastructure as code
  • Data: Snowflake and PostgreSQL
  • Observability: Langfuse, Sentry, and Coralogix
What we can offer you

  • Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa, Toronto, or Calgary preferred for this role.

  • Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters

  • RRSP/401k match and competitive compensation packages to invest in your future

  • Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.

  • Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products

  • Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career

Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $170,000 and $190,000 (CAD). Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at accommodations@fullscript.com.

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

title: Systems Designer II

title: Logistics Officer
description:
Position Summary:
Logistics Officer is responsible for overseeing and managing logistics operations under bond, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, shipment schedules with suppliers, clearing and forwarding of containers, and optimizing the movement of goods within the manufacturing environment

Logistics Management:
  • Oversee and coordinate the logistics operations related to bonded manufacturing, including inventory management, transportation, and distribution of goods
  • Ensure that all logistics activities are carried out in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements, including those pertaining to bonded warehouses

Regulatory Compliance:
  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements related to bonded manufacturing and logistics
  • Ensure that all processes and documentation comply with customs, tax, and other regulatory standards

Inventory Control:
  • Monitor and manage inventory levels, including tracking bonded stock and ensuring accurate records of goods in transit and in storage
  • Coordinate with manufacturing and warehouse teams to ensure timely and accurate handling of goods

Documentation and Reporting:
  • Prepare and manage documentation related to bonded logistics, including import/export declarations, bond certificates, and compliance reports

Coordination and Communication:
  • Work closely with internal teams, including manufacturing, procurement, and finance, to ensure smooth and efficient logistics operations
  • Liaise with external stakeholders such as external suppliers, customs authorities, freight forwarders, and transport providers to manage and resolve any issues

Process Improvement:

Problem-Solving:

Desirable qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience:

  • Strong understanding of bonded manufacturing processes, customs regulations, and logistics management principles
  • Proficiency in logistics software and tools, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent organizational abilities
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with internal teams and external stakeholders
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail in managing documentation and ensuring compliance
  • Fluency in English and Kiswahili language.

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in visual design and PowerPoint, works well within defined processes, and is eager to build technical knowledge of CesiumAstro’s products through close collaboration with more senior designers and subject matter experts.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Format and produce presentation slides for business development, recruiting, marketing, and internal use, following established templates and brand standards.
  • Support the Senior Graphic Designer in designing and updating slide layouts, diagrams, charts, and icons for the presentation library.
  • Support rapid-turnaround design requests from Business Development and Marketing under general supervision.
  • Incorporate feedback from Marketing, Business Development, and Engineering stakeholders into slide revisions.
  • Deliver polished, accurate presentation materials on schedule, supporting a consistent and up-to-date presentation library.
  • Assist in organizing and maintaining CesiumAstro’s presentation library and slide repository.
  • Support version control and help ensure access to current, approved content.
  • Help archive outdated materials and identify opportunities to improve templates and systems for efficiency and consistency.
  • Design supporting marketing collateral, including one-pagers, digital graphics, and trade show materials, under the direction of the Senior Graphic Designer.
  • Build working knowledge of CesiumAstro’s products and technologies to support accurate visual communication.
  • Follow established content review processes to help ensure accuracy, branding, and confidentiality standards are met.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2–5 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree in presentation design, graphic design, or marketing communications.
  • Working knowledge of typography, layout, and visual storytelling principles.
  • Proficiency with PowerPoint for presentation design, information design, and content organization.
  • Ability to apply established brand and design standards consistently across all visual communications.
  • Basic understanding of how to translate technical or business content into clear visuals, with support from senior team members.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple design requests, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver polished, accurate work on schedule.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Business Development, and Engineering partners.
  • Initiative to identify and flag opportunities for improving templates, systems, and content organization.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Receptiveness to feedback and ability to incorporate revisions efficiently.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, government, technology, manufacturing, or highly regulated industries.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.

title: ENGINEER, PROJECT SR. - NUCLEAR
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Accountable to plan, direct, manage and coordinate all engineering functions related to design, and development of fluid flow components specifically exposure to valve design in nuclear industry and modifications of existing product line for manufacturing and customer requirements. Support design, production, planning, quality, delivery schedule and other company functions to enable successful production.

EDUCATION REQUIRED:

  • BSME with PE License.
  • Additional schooling – master’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred. Valve design and electrical component training is a definite plus.

EXPERIENCE AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIRED:

  • Five years’ design experience of fluid flow components including minimum three years of valve design in nuclear industry, with a demonstrated ability to design develop and prove new concepts and modification of existing products.
  • General knowledge of ASME Section III Codes, ASME/ASTM material for valves in Nuclear Industry and awareness with some military standards.
  • Familiar with ANSI B16.34, B31-1, and B31.3 valve design standards.
  • Strong understanding of geometric tolerance techniques based on ANSI Y14.5M.
  • Knowledge of CSA N285.0 Canadian standards.
  • Experience with commercial grade dedication (CGD), appendix-B, and part 21 for Nuclear Industry is required.
  • Basic knowledge of stress analysis and ASME code formula to prepare valve design reports.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail are must.
  • Mathcad software would be a benefit.
  • Acquainted with EPICOR system.
  • Working knowledge of PC based CAD system (by choice – SOLIDWORKS).

REQUISITE SKILLS REQUIRED:

  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Initiative-taker, excellent organizational skills and capable of working under pressure to meet deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and problem-solving abilities.
  • Highly responsible and dependable.
  • Ability to work cohesively as part of a team.
  • All work is performed under the minimum supervision of the Manager and/or Supervisor, as required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Review customer technical specification, Valve data sheet and select the valve model from exisitng valve data bank or design new valve. Is primary individaul responsible for technical performance of product.
  • Review and comment on customer requested design changes if they have any.
  • Assist and advise the Chief Engineer regarding technical information pertaining to customer specifications on new orders.
  • Prepare detail component drawings, bill of material, test procedure, test report, OMM and perform other support functions in order to meet deadlines, commitments and manufacturing. Whenever posssible, modify existing parts to speed process.
  • Prepare and release all the drawings and other documents required prior to formal release to production.
  • Produce operability calculations to ensure compliance with customer specifications/requests. This is accomplished by static analysis of the valve, keeping in mind force balance, considering pressure forces, spring forces, coil forces, and seismic forces.
  • Must have excellent analytical skills and be able prepare ASME code Design Report using Mathcad software.
  • Prepare and release commercial grade dedication (CGD) documents defining critical characteristics of valve components.
  • During the production stage, as required, provide support in such areas as MRR’s (material rejection report), repairs, assembly, and testing operations.
  • Perform liaison having to do with providing technical information to purchasing, production, and any other support departments on matters dealing with procurement of special material, specifications, available sources, subcontracting, and troubleshooting.
  • Support other engineers in groups, quality engineers, test engineers and production lab personnel on valve design so that they can become familiar with the design expectations and documentation of the unit.
  • Work within the team to ensure accurate and timely response to customer requirements.
  • Performs additional duties as needed.
  • Keep well informed on new developments in the engineering field through contact with educational institutions, professional societies, manufacturers and trade shows, perusal of texts, technical papers, journals, and periodicals.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Lifting up to 25lbs regularly and 50lbs occassionally, pushing, pulling, standing for long periods of time, manual dexterity, visual acuity, and typing.

All candidates must meet the US persons criteria.

Please note: The salary range is based on our market pay structure. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At Valcor Engineering, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 30+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; long term disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. Our leave programs include Vacation and PTO time off, paid holidays, as well as other types such as bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to these characteristics.

title: Client Advisor
description:
Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone’s contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business.

We are looking for a full-time Client Advisor for our Bicester Village store. As Client Advisor at Acne Studios you will work collaboratively with your team to establish and nurture loyal and engaging customer relationships, drive sales and positive business outcomes in which your service and attentiveness take center stage.

CULTURE OF COLLABORATION

We firmly believe that when you feel supported, included, and trusted, it enables you to enjoy your work and thrive in it. You will be a part of a team of colleagues with diverse roles and backgrounds, each with their unique skills and experiences.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your main contribution will be to care for our customers in the store but also through the whole customer cycle. To ensure your success in this role, we provide training and coaching in luxury sales, service, and clienteling, according to our cutting-edge approach to client experience. You take care of our valued customers at the store and will play a vital role in delivering an excellent customer experience by:

  • Managing and executing omni channel services
  • Welcoming and guiding customers through a smooth customer cycle tending to all details and providing them with the best-in-class client experience
  • Achieving sales, conversion, and clienteling targets
  • Upholding administrative procedures and skillfully managing our inventory

WHO YOU ARE

You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. You enjoy working as a team and you embrace feedback to develop yourself and others. You are curious and thrive in a dynamic environment. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow. If these qualities speak to you, we would love to have you on our team.

Specific personal qualities for this role:

  • Interpersonal and communication skills to provide excellent service and build strong relationships with customers
  • Ability to identify customer needs, cross-sell products, and close sales to achieve individual and store sales targets
  • Responsive with an ability to resolve customer concerns or issues in a professional manner

Specific experience and knowledge for this role:

  • Previous customer-facing role within the retail or hospitality industry
  • Proven ability to drive sales and exceptional customer service
  • Customer relationship management (CRM) and clienteling
  • Fluent in English, which is a prerequisite for this position (and additional languages based on the market requirements)

What matters most to us is not whether you master all the listed knowledge and skills. We are dedicated to recognising the potential in each individual. We embrace diversity of people as well as ideas and viewpoints and encourage everyone's individual expression of their own identity.

We may perform background checks for this position.

title: TRAINING OFFICER -L&D
description:
Role Summary

The Training Officer-L&D supports the planning, coordination, delivery, and evaluation of employee learning and development initiatives. The role involves assisting with training programs, analyzing learning data, preparing training reports, and providing field coaching support to improve employee capabilities and performance. The intern works closely with teams to identify skills gaps, track training effectiveness, and support continuous improvement of workforce development activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and implementation of training calendars and coordinate internal and external training programs.
  • Assist with employee induction, refresher training, technical training, soft skills development, sales training, and compliance training sessions.
  • Prepare and update training materials to ensure relevance and alignment with organizational needs.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze training data, including attendance records, assessment results, and performance indicators.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to training delivery, employee capability building, and performance enhancement.

title: Product Expert - Clinical Operations
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Operations (Clinical Trials) domain to drive customer success with our Veeva Clinical Operations products family in Europe.
As part of the European and broader Global Product Expert teams, your experience will play a key role in the Product organization. You will:
  1. Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly communicating with them in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value
  2. Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, with internal team education and at industry events – driving increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion
  3. As a Voice for the Customers, capture and relay their needs (and industry-specific learnings) to our Product Management team based across the US, helping them to inform product decisions and improve designs that ultimately create better Clinical Operations products that enable:
    • AI & Digital transformation
    • Risk-based decision making
    • Regulatory compliance
    • A culture of continuous improvement
    • Operational excellence across the pharmaceutical industry
  4. Develop rich relationships with key product users / influencers
  5. Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices (Good Vault Practice) and Veeva success!
This role is ideal for someone passionate about Clinical Operations and associated processes, eager to collaborate with customers, and excited to drive their success.

What You'll Do

  • Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva Clinical Operations products
  • Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI vision to effectively guide customers through their AI transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues). Stay up to date with the latest features, strategy and roadmap
  • Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva Clinical Operations product area
  • Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate product roadmap and vision
  • Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Operations customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality
  • Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations
  • Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication
  • Provide cross-functional product expertise to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support

Requirements

  • 5+ years working in the Clinical Operations (Clinical Trials) space, usually in Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles and with hands-on experience of associated software tools (e.g. CTMS, eTMF or Study Start-up) and associated operational processes
  • Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations – communicated to both business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content relevant for end users and business teams
  • Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations)
  • Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations)
  • A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve real-world clinical operations problems (including some exposure to AI in driving efficiencies in your existing role and/ or optimizing workflows)
  • Self-directed team player with a positive attitude
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%
  • Based in Europe (with ability to work across time-zones)

Nice to Have

  • Veeva Clinical Operations Products experience
  • Fluency in another European language
  • Creating engaging videos with familiarity with Video Recording software (e.g. Camtasia)
  • Experience with Risk Management in the Life Sciences domain

Note: Veeva will consider applicants from European countries where Veeva has representatives.

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

  • Total compensation: 80,000 - 160,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

title: CMC Project Leader
description:
Job Title

Associate Director / Senior Manager, CMC Project Management

Location

Boston area preferred (or ability to commute regularly)

Company Overview

Hongene Biotech is a global leader in nucleic acid manufacturing, supporting RNA therapeutics, mRNA vaccines, and molecular diagnostics. With a vertically integrated platform from raw materials to CDMO services, we enable our partners to accelerate development with efficiency and quality.

Position Overview

This role will report directly to the VP, Global Head of CMC & Regulatory and is critical in strengthening Hongene’s project management capabilities for its oligonucleotide contract manufacturing services.

Level and title will be determined based on experience. We are primarily targeting Senior Manager to Associate Director level. Exceptional candidates may be considered at Director level.

The Primary Job Responsibilities

1) Drive project management efforts associated with CMC activities to support oligonucleotide contract manufacturing projects at Hongene Biotech.

2) Support Head of CMC and Oligonucleotide team in developing and executing development and manufacturing strategy and tactical executional plans.

3) Bridge communication between Clients and the internal teams in support of multiple contract manufacturing projects for different clients, including participation in technical calls, tracking of action items and facilitating rapid decision making within the team to drive programs forward.

4) Coordination with AD/PD, manufacture, quality and BD team to build, and manage global clients’ project timelines, work with BD to generating RFP proposals and evaluate necessary resources and ensure RFP proposals are aligned with overall strategy and cost estimation. Proactively identify potential risks, resourcing constraints and conflicts that could impact project timelines; collaborate with the AD/PD, manufacturing, QA/QC teams to develop appropriate solutions.

5) Support projects with strategic partners in US.

The candidate must have strong communication skills and be capable of strategically communicating with internal and external stakeholders, as well as effectively communicating across functions and fluent speaking both English and Mandarin. Finally, the candidate must be comfortable with, and thrive in, a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.

Minimal Requirements

• B.S or M.S in Pharmaceutical Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related scientific discipline with 8+ years of applicable experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the discipline of project management. Experience with operating in a GMP environment and working in cross functional environments. Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgement and strategic thinking.

• Strong interpersonal skills and experience of managing cross-function projects.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on research and development environment.

• Adept at building strong relationships and collaborating with colleagues at all levels.

• Ability to discern paths forward within ambiguous environments.

• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills for communication with internal and external customers is essential.

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in project or program management at a biotechnology or pharmaceutical company with direct involvement in the CMC area

• Experience with project management tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet, Clarizen) and collaboration tools (BOX, SharePoint, MS Teams)

• Understanding of the different phases of drug development and cGMP requirements

• Experience in small molecules, oligonucleotides, or biologic drug development

• Located in US EST time zone

title: Spanish Translation Reviewer Editor Certifier
description:

What we are seeking – Spanish Linguists to support the federal and local law enforcement community by providing real time translation services in a fast-paced environment.

Job Summary:

Linguist is responsible for performing real-time translations or sensitive material from a foreign language into English; collecting, analyzing, identifying, and decoding of colloquialisms and slang terms; Extracting pertinent information and communicating that information to law enforcement agent(s). Linguist is responsible for transcribing and translating source documents and recordings from storage media, including but not limited to audio files, video files or digital media.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES​
  • Listens to oral intercepts in English or Foreign language and provides verbal and written synopsis. Linguist is responsible for relating all pertinent information to the Client.
  • Contribute to the master list of slang words and codes (used by that group/organization) for the duration of the project/case.

  • Ability to transcribe and translate a minimum of 18 - 22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8-hour day.

  • Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representing TE in a Professional manner.

  • Ability to translate/transcribe 18-22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8/hour day when performing Linguist duties.
  • Ability to type 45 WPM

CLEARANCE:

title: Joint SOF Program Analyst (JSPA)
description:
Job Title: JOINT SOF PROGRAM ANALYST (JSPA) Company: Sugpiat Defense

Reports To: Program Manager Location: Tampa, FL / Fayetteville, NC

FLSA Status: Exempt Salary: DOE

SUMMARY

Overview

Sugpiat Defense is committed to providing high-quality service to those who defend us. It ensures mission assurance and execution for customers and warfighters by providing intelligence, IT, cyber security, training, logistics, administrative, acquisition, and background investigation services.

Summary:

Sugpiat Defense is looking for JOINT SOF PROGRAM ANALYST (JSPA) personnel to support our DoD Client; we are focused on delivering innovative operations and solutions through proven successful methods. Qualified personnel are necessary to provide operational planning development and analysis, program coordination, and the implementation of procedures to accomplish JHQ/JTF support functions, including any support needed to personnel on-site or off-site. In addition, the contractor is responsible for assisting the government with all the management and administrative tasks associated with coordinating responsive support to JHQ/JTFs. SME must support JHQ/JTF planning, pre-deployment preparation, deployment, and re-deployment, supporting activities from design through implementation, including, but not limited to, the assessment of planning efforts and synchronization events. They must independently and proactively undertake the following tasks:

Essential Job Functions:

• Assist in developing operational-level plans in support of strategic USSOCOM initiatives.

• Evaluate and recommend improvements in JHQ/JTF performance-based operations.

• Evaluate and provide a phased support approach to achieve an optimal architecture and process, informed by prior lessons learned, for establishing and sustaining a uniquely adapted JHQ/JTF capability as directed by USSOCOM.

• Maintain and deliver an Executive-Level framework for the established JHQ/JTFs that captures how resource management decisions are supported by a common operating picture and enterprise-wide real-time data.

• Provide consultation and advice on complex issues requiring research and study to recommend management changes; alternatives must be Courses of Action (COAs) that may require presentation to General Officer level and Service-specific or Joint Service agencies for decision.

• Perform functions supporting JHQ/JTF Program Coordination and Implementation.

• Assist in managing projects, developing sustainment strategies, and conducting milestone planning and tracking.

• Provide administrative support to the government, coordinating meetings, preparing presentation materials, drafting minutes, and other similar tasks in facilitating and documenting JHQ/JTF-related activities.

• Assist in developing roadmaps, plans, and technical briefing materials in prescribed government formats, both hard copy and digital equivalent format, while aggregating such documents electronically per DoD policies and best practices to ensure government ease of access and record keeping.

• Understand and leverage knowledge of the strategic level environment, issues, atmospherics, dynamics, requirements, and processes used in the Joint Staff, OSD, the Interagency, National Security Council Staff, and subordinate Component Commands to achieve desired government outcomes.

• Prepare, edit, and review written orders, plans, briefings, and papers. Orally present analyses of these products effectively to senior leaders, including GO/FO and SES.

• Provide clear, concise, accurate, easily understandable, and technically correct information papers, memos, and briefings to inform and influence senior leader decision-making.

• Facilitate government-led seminars and small group discussions at staff development events to optimize how and when JHQ/JTF-related pre-deployment preparation, deployment, and redeployment activities are executed.

• Assist the government in analyzing DOD operations, plans, and strategies to identify JHQ/JTF key tasks, objectives, and plans for achieving strategic, operational, and tactical effects within its area of operations and greater area of influence.

• Assist the government in analyzing, evaluating, and assessing the impacts of external plans, policies, and guidance on USSOCOM’s employment of JHQ/JTFs – while also making recommendations for responding to external guidance, requirements, and other factors that may affect an existing JHQ/JTF capability or how such capability will be employed and sustained in the future.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in a relevant area of study (military studies, business, education, instructional design, et.al.), or combination of specialized training, education, and experience (including military service) equivalent to a degree may be acceptable.
  • At least one year of operational experience with high-tempo operations and activities directly supporting mission partners in a joint, combined, and/or interagency environment.
  • Minimum of two years’ experience as a staff officer within HQ USSOCOM, a Service HQ, or a CCMD HQ (4-Star military HQ)
  • Possesses knowledge of operational design, joint processes, systems analysis, and the like.
  • Recent and relevant experience providing strategic level planning and operational support for establishing and sustaining JHQ/JTF or rapidly deployable special mission units.
  • Current DoD Top Secret clearance and eligible for SCI access

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those that an employee must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required, sometimes for extended periods, to walk, stand, or sit. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. The employee is occasionally required to climb ladders or stairs; use hands to type, finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and get in and out of vehicles. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move small or large objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. While performing the outdoor field duties of this job, the employee will also be exposed to outside weather conditions and other conditions such as loud noises, fumes, odors, dust, etc. This position may require travel.

title: Production Generalist 1
description:
Production Generalist

Job Description V2024.01


Position Description

The Production Generalist is responsible for executing a variety of tasks surrounding pottery production. This position is responsible for the production and supporting tasks of the forming, glazing, kiln, and QC processes through the completion of daily and weekly make lists. The Production Generalist will be assigned to various roles within the Production Department as needs arise. Responsibilities may include operation of forming equipment, trimming/handling of pieces, glazing pieces, loading & unloading kilns, and sanding and inspecting finished pieces, while working closely with other team members. It is important that the Production Generalist enjoys and is comfortable working as a part of a team, has acute attention to detail, and works well with similar daily routines.


Responsibilities

  • Producing pottery as outlined in the weekly production schedule

  • Trimming, handling, finishing, or glazing pieces to according to East Fork’s standard operating procedures and quality standards

  • Measuring and recording process quality data at least once daily, and more often as needed

  • Entering accurate production data daily

  • Adhering to daily schedule and informing the Lead of any challenges or roadblocks that impeded workflow or required a shift in tasks

  • Preparing machines for the next day to adhere to production scheduling

  • Troubleshooting machines and processes when necessary

  • Communicating with the Sr. Operators regarding any issues, material needs, or questions regarding training or work assignments

  • Participating in daily production meetings and regular team meetings

  • Adhering to testing protocols, filling out routers appropriately and ensuring that routers follow wares through the production process as necessary

  • Maintaining a clean and sanitary work area daily

  • Effectively receiving and applying feedback

  • Able to flex to other work assignments as needed

  • Adherence to East Fork’s safety standards and protocols

  • Adherence to East Fork’s Attendance Policy

  • Professional & effective communication with all team members


Reports To

Production Manager


Collaborates With

Production Team


Direct Reports

None


Measured Metrics and Review Schedule - all forming teams

Your first review will be 90 days after your start date, then a six-month check-in and a development review annually for the duration of your employment. During each review, your performance and ability to achieve the following metrics will be evaluated.


  • Production requirements are met, and daily tasks are completed as assigned by the make lists

  • A consistent rate (pots per hour) in trimming, forming, and or glazing is maintained

  • Pieces are made and finished to East Fork’s standard of quality

  • Tool changes are conducted independently, with accuracy and consistency across runs

  • Formed weights and clay hardness are tested daily

  • Accurate production data is entered daily

  • Adherence to East Fork’s safety protocols

  • Adherence to East Fork’s Employee Attendance Policy


Classification

This position is full time, non-exempt.


Pay Rate/Grade

East Fork shall pay you $23.15 hourly at Grade 1


Estimated Weekly Hours

1st shift: 40+ hrs, Monday - Friday 8am-4pm


Qualifications

  • Promotes the culture and values of the company while maintaining a positive work environment

  • Strong preference for production / manufacturing experience

  • Positive attitude and ability to work as a part of a team

  • Ability to multitask while maintaining a calm and collected demeanor

  • Strong work ethic

  • Ability to problem solve and willingness to learn new skills

  • Willingness to work with flexibility and adjust to changing systems

  • Ability to learn to effectively operate production related equipment

  • Ability to keep accurate, ongoing logs

  • Ability to maintain attention to detail and craftsmanship

  • Ability to avoid third party feedback loops and siloed conversations

  • Works well with similar daily routines and tasks

  • Collaborates across cultural differences

  • Ability to respect and communicate across lines of cultural differences

  • Ability to address conflict by assuming positive intent and seeking to understand

  • Ability to embrace a mistake w/ out fault

  • A commitment to center the active process of self awareness


Physical Demands

Extensive physical exertions which includes but are not limited to:

  • Standing for extended periods

  • Ability to lift 50 lbs as needed

  • Repetitive bending, lifting, and hand/arm movements


Company Overview

East Fork is located in Asheville, NC, Washington DC, and Brooklyn, NY. At our heart we are makers: we produce every piece of ceramics we sell and source other objects for the home from near and far to offer a meaningful, beautiful, and personal collection of useful objects for the home.


What can we offer

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Paid Holidays

  • Sick Leave

  • Bereavement Leave

  • Paid Medical Leave

  • Employee Assistance Network

  • Court Activity Leave

  • Employee Discount

  • Employer funded $10k group life insurance plan

  • Employer Subsidized Health Insurance Plans

  • Voluntary Vision & Dental Plans

  • Employer matched 401(k)



Values at Work

Craft: Craft is not the things we make, it’s the way we make them. It’s the spirit in which we approach our work, to make it nice, to aspire to mastery, and it demonstrates our care about the person who will use the product of our work and how our work impacts their life.


Generosity: We work towards a model of shared prosperity, setting a bigger, more inclusive, more equitable table for everyone we meet - from our employees to the communities in which we live.


Consideration: We approach each other with focus, clarity, and kindness. We think deeply about the outcome and impacts of our actions, on our organization, the individuals within it, our customers, our environment, and our community.


Curiosity: We stay in our beginner's mind, humble, aware of how much we do not know, striving earnestly and open-heartedly towards our shared success.



Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

It is important that all prospective job candidates are aware of our company values and of our commitment to building an inclusive company culture. As a white-led organization, we acknowledge that the realities of white supremacy, hetero/cis-normativity, and patriarchy, work in tandem to oppress both people and planet; and that through our own proximity to power, we have benefitted from systemic inequity. We are committed to confronting and rectifying our privilege in service of co-creating an equitable workplace—a space where people can show up authentically in mind, body, and spirit. We honor the collective sum rather than a monolithic experience to reveal a path of excellency, yours and ours. As we continue to build momentum within our anti-racist work we pledge to be intentional in crafting actions that support diversity, equity and inclusion in our framework, and we invite all East Fork teammembers to contribute to this goal.

Levels for Role

Production Generalist



Level two

Production Generalist 2

  • At least 6 months spent in Level 1 Production Generalist role

Consistently meets individual and/or team metrics and output

  • Production requirements are met, and daily tasks are completed as assigned by the make lists

  • A consistent rate that regularly meets production goals in forming and or glazing is maintained in roles where it is required

  • Can conduct any tool changeover in primary department where required

  • Shows initiative in areas of process improvement, organization, and cleaning
