Help us shape the future of aviation while working with cutting-edge technologies that are changing the lives of our passengers.

JOB TITLE: Buyer/Analyst

DEPARTMENT: Procurement

REPORTS TO: Director of Procurement

FLSA STATUS: Exempt

POSITION SUMMARY

The Buyer/Analyst is primarily responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and managing parts, tooling, repairs, services, and supplies required to support the company’s fleet and maintenance operations. This position manages the procurement process from requisition through delivery, ensuring materials are available when required, purchased at competitive cost, and meet quality, traceability, and regulatory requirements.

The position also provides support for inventory and stockroom control by assisting with the receipt, issuance, storage, shipment, documentation, and reconciliation of materials. The Buyer/Analyst uses inventory, consumption, and demand information to make purchasing and stocking decisions and works closely with Maintenance, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, and vendors to maintain adequate material support.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Procurement & Inventory Planning — Primary

  • Provide adequate and timely material support to maintenance stations and company operations.
  • Create, issue, coordinate, and manage purchase and repair orders with approved vendors.
  • Coordinate with Maintenance Planning to ensure materials are purchased and staged in advance of scheduled maintenance.
  • Review material requisitions, inventory levels, station allocations, usage, and consumption data to determine appropriate stock coverage and reorder points.
  • Analyze demand, consumption, manufacturer data, and forecasts to establish appropriate inventory positions and purchasing requirements.
  • Source aircraft parts, tooling, MRO services, repairs, and other materials while identifying alternate sources and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Assist with RFPs, bids, supplier contracts, and annual/bulk purchasing agreements.
  • Conduct price and cost analysis and negotiate pricing, terms, conditions, specifications, and scopes of work with suppliers and contractors.
  • Manage removed cores and repair orders, including determining appropriate repair conditions, BER status, exchange options, and beneficial repair sources.
  • Monitor rotable and expendable spares and establish appropriate reorder points and inventory allocations.
  • Develop and maintain an Approved Supplier List and monitor supplier quality, delivery, pricing, and overall performance.
  • Process supplier warranty claims for failed, damaged, or lost components and coordinate resolution with vendors and internal departments.
  • Review and resolve purchasing and invoicing discrepancies in coordination with Finance.
  • Develop short- and long-term sourcing and inventory planning strategies.
  • Monitor industry changes, supplier capabilities, material availability, and alternate sources.
  • Identify and document cost savings and cost-avoidance opportunities.
  • Support surplus inventory sales and disposition activities. Inventory & Stockroom Support — Secondary
  • Support the stockroom in issuing parts and tooling and ensuring proper control and security of company inventory and assets.
  • Assist with receiving, inspecting, counting, identifying, locating, storing, staging, packing, and shipping parts and materials as required.
  • Review packing slips, certifications, traceability documents, and vendor documentation associated with received materials.
  • Verify incoming and outgoing materials and documentation and ensure transactions are properly recorded in the company’s systems.
  • Assist with cycle counts, physical inventory, inventory reconciliation, and investigation of discrepancies.
  • Identify damaged, defective, expired, excess, or obsolete materials and coordinate appropriate disposition.
  • Maintain awareness of aircraft parts certification, traceability requirements, material shelf life, and tool calibration requirements.
  • Assist in maintaining proper housekeeping, organization, security, and inventory control within assigned areas.
  • Ensure materials are handled, stored, and shipped in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Supply Chain Supervisor or Director of Procurement.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong purchasing, procurement, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of aviation MRO, aircraft parts, repair orders, component exchange programs, and warranties.
  • Knowledge of inventory control, demand planning, forecasting, and stock management.
  • Knowledge of aircraft parts certification and traceability requirements preferred.
  • General knowledge of regulatory requirements applicable to aviation purchasing, inventory, hazardous materials, and shipping.
  • Ability to analyze inventory, consumption, demand, and cost data and make sound purchasing decisions.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor-management skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proficient computer skills and ability to learn and utilize purchasing, inventory, and maintenance systems.
  • Ability to learn and adhere to the Company's General Maintenance Manual (GMM), applicable 14 CFR Part 135 requirements, and Dangerous Goods requirements under 49CFR Parts 171–180.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education Bachelor's degree preferred in Purchasing, Business, Supply Chain, Inventory Management, or a related field.
  • Professional certification such as CPIM/APICS is a plus.

Work Experience

  • Prior experience in the airline or aviation industry required.
  • Minimum four (4) years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain analysis, demand planning, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience in inventory forecasting and analysis required.
  • Aviation MRO purchasing and repair order experience preferred.
  • Warranty reclamation experience preferred.
  • Previous inventory or stockroom experience preferred.

MISCELLANEOUS REQUIREMENTS

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to work within a 24/7 operation, including weekends and holidays.
  • Ability to pass a 10-year background check and pre-employment drug screen as required by airline regulations and company policies.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an airport security badge for the assigned base.
  • At least 18 years of age.
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. in accordance with applicable law.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Must have sufficient vision and ability to safely perform the essential functions of the position.
  • Must be able to communicate through verbal, written, and electronic means.
  • Must be able to access filing cabinets, drawers, shelves, and inventory locations of varying heights.
  • Must be able to occasionally lift or move materials up to 50 pounds.
  • Must have sufficient physical dexterity to occasionally perform inventory and stockroom activities, including standing, walking, bending, stooping, reaching, lifting, packing, unpacking, and locating materials.

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable successful candidates to perform the essential

functions of the role.)

title: Project Development Lead
description:
Position

Project Development Lead

Location

Bloomington, MN

About Us

Geronimo Power develops, owns, and operates large-scale power and affiliated digital infrastructure projects throughout America's Heartland, including solar, wind, energy storage, and powered data parks. As a farmer-founded and community-focused business, Geronimo Power equips landowners and rural communities with sustainable revenue to ignite local economic growth. To learn more about Geronimo Power, visit www.geronimopower.com or follow the company on LinkedIn.

About This Role

The Project Development Lead is responsible for advancing multiple development assets within an assigned region or market by executing on project origination and key strategic milestones. This senior individual contributor role leads cross-functional development efforts across land, permitting, interconnection, stakeholder engagement, budgeting, scheduling, and risk management to deliver preconstruction projects void of fatal flaws and in alignment with Geronimo Power’s return expectations. This role does not require direct management of staff.

Responsibilities

  • Manage budget, schedules, and advancement of 4-10+ early to mid-stage projects across various technologies (solar, wind, battery energy storage, data center development, gas, etc.), support on approximately 1-2 late-stage projects. Annual development budgets vary depending on technology type with expected annual range approximately $3 million-$10 million.
  • Lead the company in targeting and evaluating markets to identify greenfield developments, Mergers & Acquisitions, and partnership opportunities in assigned area.
  • Championing solutions to project risks, management, and comprehensive understanding of how the risks impact development and constructability.
  • Work with the commercial and finance teams to prepare financial models, evaluate new technologies, and prepare compelling solutions for customers.
  • Represent Geronimo Power with federal, state, and local officials, regulators, utilities, transmission operators, and other stakeholders throughout the project development process, effectively managing and maintaining key stakeholder relationships necessary for projects to thrive.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, and/or land agents.
  • Lead land negotiations for purchase options, lease options, easements, extensions, and related agreements, including execution, while balancing key considerations across the project lifecycle, including operations, financial modeling, and constructability.
  • Coordinate with the Transmission department to site strategic Points of Interconnection, compile relevant application content, and support the process to ultimately obtain Generator Interconnect Agreements.
  • Work closely with the Permitting department to manage state, federal, and local permitting efforts, and approval processes for utility-scale electric generation projects.
  • Advanced ability to interface with the engineering and construction teams to ensure that projects are deliverable, considerate of site characteristics, and on budget.
  • Update internal data for reports and project schedules.
  • Obtain local tax abatements and other agreements as necessary to allow for construction of the projects.
  • Travel approximately 40% of the time.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of project development experience in renewable energy or a relatable industry (energy, real estate, commercial development, etc. ) w
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver on large scale utility energy development projects and/or data centers is required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of energy markets is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project budgets and schedules.
  • Willingness to work with and manage relationships with landowners and other stakeholders is required.
  • Experience with contract management and negotiation is strongly preferred.
  • Previous exposure to project financing is strongly preferred.
  • Intermediate to advanced understanding of project constraints and conceptual engineering is preferred.
  • Advanced understanding of real property interests is strongly preferred.
  • Intermediate understanding of projects models and prior exposure to project financing is strongly preferred.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Teams; SharePoint; Word; Excel; PowerPoint)
  • Experience with Procore.
  • Valid Driver’s License.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Accomplished project management skills and organization.
  • Strong written and verbal communications skills.
  • Ability to prioritize self-prioritize, plan work effectively, and work with competing deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Relationship management skills including but not limited to conflict resolution, negotiation, relationship building, stakeholder engagement, and emotional intelligence.
  • High aptitude for creative thinking and problem solving.
  • Demonstrated leadership.

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Tuition assistance and ongoing professional development
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Pet insurance and employee discount programs

Pay Range for the posted level: $120,000 - $170,000 plus target annual bonus opportunity of 25%. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and demonstrated market-relevant expertise

Our Commitment

Geronimo Power is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and energized to do their best work. We believe strong teams and strong communities drive better outcomes.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.

title: IT Business Analyst I
description:
The IT Business Analyst I supports the design, documentation, and communication of business and technical requirements for new applications, integrations, and process improvements.


This role serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are well-defined, properly scoped, and traceable throughout the delivery lifecycle. Working under supervision, the BA I assists in conducting discovery sessions, documenting workflows, preparing user stories, and supporting QA and UAT efforts. This is an entry-level analytical role designed to build expertise in requirements elicitation, documentation discipline, and process understanding, forming the foundation for future leadership in business or technical project management.

Requirements Gathering & Documentation

  • Assist in conducting requirement-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
  • Document functional, non-functional, and technical requirements under the guidance of senior analysts or project leads.
  • Develop process flow diagrams, current/future state analyses, and user story drafts in alignment with project scope.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, design, and testing artifacts within the project lifecycle.


Business Process Analysis

  • Observe and document existing workflows, identifying pain points, bottlenecks, or inefficiencies.
  • Collaborate with senior analysts and developers to translate operational needs into system requirements.
  • Support creation of use cases, data maps, and reference documentation for integration or enhancement requests.


Collaboration & Communication

  • Act as a communication bridge between business teams and technical staff, clarifying requirements and priorities.
  • Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, and project review meetings to track status and dependencies.
  • Support the preparation of project documentation, release notes, and training materials for end-users.
  • Ensure timely and accurate updates of tickets or project tasks in Jira or other tracking systems.


Testing & Validation Support

  • Assist QA teams and stakeholders in validating solution behavior against requirements.
  • Participate in UAT sessions and log findings, feedback, and retest confirmations.
  • Support defect triage by tracing issues to their original requirements or design artifacts.


Continuous Learning & Process Maturity

  • Learn and apply ITIL, Agile, and SDLC principles in day-to-day work.
  • Contribute to improvement of templates, documentation practices, and knowledge repositories (e.g., the KB Vault).
  • Pursue ongoing skill development in business process modeling, data analysis, and solution design.

Requirements

Specialized knowledge:
  • Foundational understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
  • Basic knowledge of business process analysis, requirements documentation, and system design principles.
  • Familiarity with data flow, integration concepts, and change control procedures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and attention to documentation accuracy.
Computer knowledge:

  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint) for documentation and collaboration.
  • Familiar with Atlassian Jira or equivalent tools for project tracking and user story management.
  • Experience using Visio for process mapping and diagramming.
  • Exposure to SQL or data query concepts for simple validation or investigation.
  • Basic understanding of cloud-based applications, API dependencies, or system integrations preferred.
Experience:

  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, project coordination, or system support, ideally within a technology or operational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience documenting requirements, tracking issues, or supporting project teams.
  • Educational foundation in Information Systems, Business Administration, or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Prior exposure to Agile/Scrum or ITIL-based processes preferred.


Benefits

  • Paid days off
  • Competitive weekly salary
  • Great location (Zona Río, Tijuana)
  • Benefits by law and more
  • Private Health Insurance and Preventative Care
  • Friendly work environment
  • Savings Fund and voluntary Savings Account
  • Financing and discounts at various establishments around the city
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Constant motivational events and more!

title: Product Expert - Clinical Operations
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Operations (Clinical Trials) domain to drive customer success with our Veeva Clinical Operations products family in Europe.
As part of the European and broader Global Product Expert teams, your experience will play a key role in the Product organization. You will:
  1. Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly communicating with them in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value
  2. Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, with internal team education and at industry events – driving increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion
  3. As a Voice for the Customers, capture and relay their needs (and industry-specific learnings) to our Product Management team based across the US, helping them to inform product decisions and improve designs that ultimately create better Clinical Operations products that enable:
    • AI & Digital transformation
    • Risk-based decision making
    • Regulatory compliance
    • A culture of continuous improvement
    • Operational excellence across the pharmaceutical industry
  4. Develop rich relationships with key product users / influencers
  5. Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices (Good Vault Practice) and Veeva success!
This role is ideal for someone passionate about Clinical Operations and associated processes, eager to collaborate with customers, and excited to drive their success.

What You'll Do

  • Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva Clinical Operations products
  • Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI vision to effectively guide customers through their AI transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues). Stay up to date with the latest features, strategy and roadmap
  • Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva Clinical Operations product area
  • Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate product roadmap and vision
  • Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Operations customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality
  • Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations
  • Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication
  • Provide cross-functional product expertise to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support

Requirements

  • 5+ years working in the Clinical Operations (Clinical Trials) space, usually in Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles and with hands-on experience of associated software tools (e.g. CTMS, eTMF or Study Start-up) and associated operational processes
  • Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations – communicated to both business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content relevant for end users and business teams
  • Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations)
  • Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations)
  • A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve real-world clinical operations problems (including some exposure to AI in driving efficiencies in your existing role and/ or optimizing workflows)
  • Self-directed team player with a positive attitude
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%
  • Based in Europe (with ability to work across time-zones)

Nice to Have

  • Veeva Clinical Operations Products experience
  • Fluency in another European language
  • Creating engaging videos with familiarity with Video Recording software (e.g. Camtasia)
  • Experience with Risk Management in the Life Sciences domain

Note: Veeva will consider applicants from European countries where Veeva has representatives.

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

  • Total compensation: 70,000 - 140,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

title: Tłumacz (angielski-polski-angielski)  (M/F/NB)
description:
Dlaczego Etteplan?

W Etteplan łączymy technologię, inżynierię i komunikację, wspierając międzynarodowych klientów w realizacji złożonych projektów przemysłowych. Pracujemy w środowisku, w którym precyzja, dobra organizacja i jasna komunikacja mają realne znaczenie dla powodzenia projektu.

Obecnie, w związku z realizacją międzynarodowego projektu dla klienta z sektora przemysłowego, poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Tłumacz (angielski-poski-angielski).

To rola dla osoby, która lubi pracować z językiem, ale jednocześnie dobrze odnajduje się w środowisku technicznym i chce mieć kontakt z dokumentacją dotyczącą rzeczywistych procesów inżynieryjnych.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć?

Ta rola będzie dobrym wyborem, jeśli:

  • chcesz pracować przy międzynarodowym projekcie przemysłowym
  • lubisz tłumaczenia techniczne i pracę z terminologią branżową
  • dobrze czujesz się zarówno w pracy samodzielnej, jak i we współpracy z inżynierami i zespołami projektowymi
  • zwracasz uwagę na szczegóły i zależy Ci na wysokiej jakości tłumaczeń
  • interesuje Cię praca z nowoczesnymi narzędziami CAT i technologiami wspierającymi tłumaczenia
  • szukasz projektu, w którym możesz rozwijać swoją wiedzę techniczną i językową

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

  • tłumaczenie dokumentacji technicznej z języka angielskiego na polski i z polskiego na angielski
  • tłumaczenie korespondencji projektowej w obu kierunkach
  • przegląd, korektę i redakcję tłumaczeń pod kątem poprawności językowej, spójności i terminologii
  • pracę z glosariuszami projektowymi, bazami terminologicznymi i pamięcią tłumaczeniową
  • dbanie o zgodność tłumaczeń z zatwierdzoną przez klienta terminologią i standardami dokumentacji
  • koordynowanie oraz kontrolę jakości tłumaczeń realizowanych przez zewnętrznych dostawców
  • współpracę z inżynierami, zespołami projektowymi oraz innymi tłumaczami
  • formatowanie dokumentów i realizację zadań z zakresu DTP
  • tłumaczenie ustne konsekutywne podczas spotkań projektowych oraz wizyt u klienta
  • udział w podróżach służbowych związanych z realizacją projektu
  • dbanie o spójność i wysoką jakość dokumentacji projektowej

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

  • bardzo dobrze znasz język angielski
  • język polski jest Twoim językiem ojczystym lub posiadasz jego znajomość na poziomie zbliżonym do native speaker
  • masz doświadczenie w tłumaczeniach technicznych, najlepiej w środowisku przemysłowym lub inżynieryjnym
  • potrafisz pracować z terminologią techniczną i dokumentacją projektową
  • dobrze organizujesz swoją pracę i potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać kilkoma zadaniami oraz terminami
  • jesteś osobą dokładną i zwracasz uwagę na szczegóły
  • potrafisz współpracować z osobami o różnych kompetencjach, w tym z inżynierami i ekspertami technicznymi
  • masz wykształcenie wyższe – kierunki takie jak lingwistyka, filologia, tłumaczenia, języki obce, inżynieria lub kierunki pokrewne będą mile widziane; równie ważne będzie odpowiednie doświadczenie zawodowe

Świetnie, jeśli dodatkowo:

  • masz doświadczenie w tłumaczeniach dla przemysłu ciężkiego, górnictwa, sektora mineralnego, energetyki lub branży procesowej
  • posiadasz wykształcenie techniczne lub inżynierskie
  • masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach inżynieryjnych
  • znasz narzędzia CAT, szczególnie RWS Trados Studio
  • masz doświadczenie w zarządzaniu terminologią i pamięcią tłumaczeniową
  • znasz zasady DTP i potrafisz samodzielnie formatować dokumenty
  • masz doświadczenie w tłumaczeniu ustnym podczas spotkań biznesowych lub technicznych

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

  • udział w międzynarodowym projekcie w środowisku przemysłowym
  • pracę z zaawansowaną dokumentacją techniczną i specjalistyczną terminologią
  • współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem tłumaczy oraz ekspertami technicznymi
  • możliwość rozwijania kompetencji w zakresie tłumaczeń technicznych
  • pracę z nowoczesnymi technologiami wspierającymi tłumaczenia, w tym Trados Studio 2026 i Trados Team
  • możliwość przystąpienia do egzaminu Trados Studio Certification i uzyskania certyfikacji Trados Studio Level 1 (Basic)
  • hybrydowy model pracy – z możliwością pracy zdalnej i pracy z biura
  • udział w międzynarodowym środowisku projektowym

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

  1. Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim.
  2. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
  3. Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację i doświadczenie pod kątem wymagań projektu.
  4. Zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę z HR, podczas której porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji i oczekiwaniach.
  5. W kolejnym etapie możesz zostać zaproszony/a na rozmowę z przedstawicielem zespołu projektowego lub klienta.
  6. W zależności od przebiegu procesu możemy poprosić Cię również o wykonanie krótkiego zadania lub próbki tłumaczenia.
  7. Po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

title: Graphic Designer - Health Data Dissemination

Rusta Jærhagen søker deltidsansatte til julesesongen, vikariatet varer til og med 31. desember 2026.

Hos oss er hverdagen aktiv og variert – ingen dager er helt like. Du jobber både i kassen og ute i butikken, der du møter kundene med et smil og bidrar til at varehuset er ryddig, påfylt og inspirerende. Én dag hjelper du en kunde med å finne riktig produkt, en annen dag er du med på å bygge om en avdeling. Variasjonen er en del av det som gjør jobben spennende.

Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra start – vi lærer deg! Men vi tror at du:

  • Trives med kundekontakt og ønsker å bidra til de gode handleopplevelsene
  • Holder hodet kaldt når det er travelt og finner løsninger raskt
  • Har mulighet til å jobbe morgen, dag, kveld og helg
  • Sprer positiv energi og vil vokse og utvikles med oss

Har du jobbet i butikk før? Supert! Men det viktigste for oss er at du har rette holdninger, verdier og personlig egnethet.

Slik fungerer det når du søker

Fordi vi ønsker å forenkle søknad- og utvelgelsesprosess benytter vi oss av Hubert som verktøy. Det betyr at du etter søknaden er sendt vil få tilsendt en chat med spørsmål (tar ca 20 min), dette hjelper oss å kartlegge litt mer om deg og forenkler prosessen med å velge ut kandidater. Dersom du går videre etter Hubert vil du bli kontaktet for et fysisk intervju med varehussjefen.

Etter at du har sendt inn søknaden din blir du umiddelbart invitert til et chatbasert førstegangsintervju via Hubert.

  • Tips og råd for ditt Hubert-intervju
  • Startdato: 1. oktober
  • Arbeidstid: Tidligvakt (kl. 0600-1400) - og kveldsvakt (kl. 1400 - 2000), og annenhver lørdag. Du må kunne jobbe disse tidspunktene.

title: Quality Assurance Intern
description:
Our Technology division is seeking a motivated QA Intern with 0-2 years of experience to support our software quality initiatives. In this role, you will collaborate closely with QA Engineers, Product Managers, and Developers to ensure the stability and performance of our applications. This position provides hands-on exposure to the full testing lifecycle, ranging from requirement analysis and test design to defect management and exploring automation potential. It is an ideal opportunity for a candidate dedicated to software excellence who thrives on investigating system behaviors, pinpointing vulnerabilities, and cultivating core Quality Assurance skills within a fast-paced setting.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Scrum team to dissect product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, ensuring clear understanding while flagging potential risks or edge cases.
  • Translate business objectives into robust test scenarios and cases utilizing proven design techniques.
  • Perform manual testing procedures to confirm that software functionalities match specifications, encompassing functional, regression, exploratory, and integration testing.
  • Verify standard user journeys as well as alternative and failure scenarios across diverse devices, browsers, and environments.
  • Contribute to API validation initiatives using tools like Postman to verify responses, status codes, and data consistency.
  • Aid in the creation of automated test scripts under guidance, utilizing frameworks such as Cypress or Playwright.
  • Record, monitor, and report software defects, providing thorough reproduction steps, expected versus actual outcomes, and relevant evidence.
  • Partner with developers to troubleshoot issues, retest corrections, and confirm that fixes do not create new problems.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups and sprint reviews, to update the team on testing progress and quality metrics.
  • Keep precise test documentation, such as plans, checklists, and execution logs, while actively seeking methods to boost testing efficiency.
  • Review production incidents and customer feedback to optimize future testing strategies and broaden test coverage.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or demonstrated foundational expertise in software development and testing.
  • Basic grasp of testing principles, the software testing lifecycle, and various testing categories including functional, regression, and boundary testing.
  • Capability to evaluate requirements and logically construct test scenarios and cases.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum, and the defect management lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical skills combined with a meticulous attention to detail and a dedication to quality.
  • Critical thinking capabilities to foresee user behaviors that extend beyond standard use cases.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration within cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive mindset toward continuous learning, receptiveness to feedback, and ongoing improvement of technical knowledge.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit:

We're seeking a Senior Product Designer to lead the design of Waabi's driverless commercial and operations ecosystem, and the critical tools and interfaces that support scaling our company forward.

This is not a typical product design role. You'll design workflows where a human decision can pull a 40-ton truck off the road or send it back into traffic. The tension between operational tools, speed, and safety-critical decision-making is what makes this seat unique.

You'll join as the second product designer at Waabi, working closely with the first (your hiring manager) to establish design culture, systems, and processes as the team grows. You'll ship designs in code from your first week. And will grow to own the full human-to-robot experience, designing everything from fleet management software to the interior and exterior interfaces of our AVs.

You will…

  • Design fleet management and remote assistance workflows: Define and design the end-to-end workflows that operations staff use to monitor, dispatch, and intervene with AVs in real time. This includes dashboards, pre-mission checks, remote assistance, and the operational procedures that connect them.

  • Observe users in their actual environment: Take a first-principles approach to design by stepping out of the office. You will observe users, terminal staff, and fleet operators in their actual environments to gain deep insights into their workflows and streamline processes. 

  • Design for AI and Automation: Define how humans interact with highly capable AI systems, creating intuitive workflows for fleet tracking, vehicle dispatch, remote assistance, and on-the-ground operational exception handling.

  • Build and extend our design system: Contribute to and expand Waabi's shared system to maintain consistency and scalability across all product surfaces.

  • Ship directly in code: You'll contribute to production React codebases using AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor), not hand off static specs. The shipped product is the deliverable.

  • Collaborate across product, engineering, and operations: Work with PMs, engineers, researchers, and operations teams to define requirements and translate them into effective design solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Experience building complex tools: 5+ years experience designing for information dense, complex ecosystems (e.g., healthtech, dev tools, or logistics). We value your ability to untangle complexity over your specific industry background.

  • Own complexity and execute end-to-end: You can break down messy problems and drive from discovery through delivery with clear user-centric thinking. 

  • First-principles thinker: You don't just rely on standard patterns. You strip problems down to their fundamental truths to build intuitive tools for entirely new paradigms.

  • Hands-on and curious: You are comfortable in ambiguous environments and excited to build in domains you may not be familiar with. You are eager to understand the realities of logistics, hardware integrations, and autonomous tech. 

  • Strong design craft and judgment: You raise the bar, push for excellence, and balance visual polish with usability, making smart, user-centered tradeoffs. 

  • A builder's mindset: You design in code, are comfortable with component libraries, and see AI-assisted coding as a natural way of iterating. You know the shipped product is a key measure of success.

Bonus:

  • AV / Robotics / Logistics Background: Prior experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or logistics operations (e.g., time at Waymo, Cruise, Aurora, Nuro, or a freight/logistics company).

  • Real-time Interfaces: Experience designing for real-time monitoring, dispatch, or command-and-control interfaces.

  • Physical Operations: Background that touches industrial design, hardware interfaces, or physical operations environments (terminals, warehouses, test tracks).

  • Scaling Products Externally: Experience designing products that transitioned from prototype/internal usage to customer/external-facing, demonstrating the ability to scale designs for broader user adoption.

title: Senior Analyst, Power Markets
description:
Position

Senior Analyst – Power Markets

Location

Bloomington, MN

About Us

Geronimo Power develops, owns, and operates large-scale power and affiliated digital infrastructure projects throughout America's Heartland, including solar, wind, energy storage, and powered data parks. As a farmer-founded and community-focused business, Geronimo Power equips landowners and rural communities with sustainable revenue to ignite local economic growth. To learn more about Geronimo Power, visit www.geronimopower.com or follow the company on LinkedIn.

About This Role

This role is a high-impact opportunity to shape investment and commercial strategy across U.S. power markets, with a strong focus on ERCOT and other organized markets. You will lead advanced market modeling and translate complex power market dynamics into actionable insights that directly influence development, trading, and capital allocation decisions.

The Investments team drives portfolio strategy across Geronimo Power’s renewable energy, storage, and data center development opportunities. In this role, you will partner closely with Brookfield and internal stakeholders to evaluate market risks, optimize trading strategies, and support critical commercial and investment decisions..

The clean energy transition is occurring at a rapid pace, creating new commercial structures, load growth opportunities, and business models. The Senior Analyst will provide insight and expert analysis of US electricity markets to support project development, investment underwriting, origination, portfolio optimization, and strategic decision making.


Responsibilities

  • Lead nodal modeling & analysis of specified US electricity markets to support investment decisions, business planning, strategic planning, data center development, and new business opportunities
  • Develop, maintain & continuously improve in-house electricity market models and databases ensuring they are fit for purpose
  • Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders (Investments, Development, Origination, and Operations)
  • Support asset valuation, investment underwriting, and risk assessment for new and existing projects
  • Monitor market developments and provide analysis of critical changes
  • Track key regulatory changes within specific markets through research and attending conferences and ISO meetings
  • Become a leading electricity market expert internally and externally

What You’ll Bring

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, or related quantitative field (power system emphasis desired)
  • 5+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, investment analysis, consulting, and/or energy trading

Technical & Business Expertise

  • Direct ERCOT notal modeling expertise
  • Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, including Excel and programing (Python, VBA, SQL, or similar)
  • Broad knowledge of US power industry structures, policies, regulations & market fundamentals
  • Familiarity with recent trends in conventional generation, renewables, gas, energy storage, transmission, data centers, large load growth & distributed generation
  • Strong understanding of transmission system and power flow fundamentals and LMP formation
  • Ability to translate model outputs into business insight & articulate impact of results on the business
  • Experience in developing & employing market and/or financial models, as well as with commercial production cost modeling software: PROMOD, PLEXOS, Aurora, Gridview, PAS, Dayzer, or similar
  • Familiarity with linear algebra, linear programming & optimization theory
  • Specific experience analyzing ERCOT, MISO, PJM, or other major US power markets is strongly desired

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Build and enhance market models to support ERCOT and priority market analysis
  • Deliver actionable insights that influence key investment and commercial decisions
  • Establish credibility as a trusted market expert across Investments, Development, and Commercial teams
  • Contribute to improved forecasting, valuation accuracy, and risk assessment capabilities

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Tuition assistance and ongoing professional development
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Pet insurance and employee discount programs

Pay Range for the posted level: $130,000 – 150,000 plus target annual bonus opportunity of 15%. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and demonstrated market-relevant expertise

Our Commitment

Geronimo Power is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and energized to do their best work. We believe strong teams and strong communities drive better outcomes.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.

title: Director of Housing Stability
description:
The Director of Housing Stability provides strategic, operational, and administrative leadership for the agency's housing stability continuum, including Transitional Living Programs (2), Oneida County Street Outreach, Oneida County Family Homeless Case Management, Oneida County Care Transitions, and the strategic planning, development, and implementation of future ESSHI Programming.

This role is responsible for the overall direction, quality, compliance, performance, and sustainability of housing stability programming designed to prevent and end homelessness, increase housing stability, and improve outcomes for individuals and families experiencing housing insecurity.

The Director translates agency strategy into effective program operations, ensuring high-quality, person-centered, trauma-informed, and housing-focused service delivery while maintaining fidelity to contractual obligations, agency mission, and evidence-informed practices. This position provides direct supervision to Program Managers and serves as an agency leader responsible for driving operational excellence, measurable outcomes, workforce development, fiscal stewardship, strategic partnerships, housing development, and program growth.

The Director of Housing Stability works in close partnership with the Vice President of Community Services and collaborates across agency departments, community providers, healthcare systems, landlords, housing authorities, county departments, managed care organizations, housing developers, and state partners to strengthen housing systems, improve service coordination, expand housing opportunities, and ensure high-quality services across the housing continuum.


Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.


Strategic Leadership & Program Oversight:

  1. Provide strategic and operational leadership for all housing stability programs, ensuring alignment with agency mission, values, strategic priorities, contractual expectations, and long-term organizational goals.
  1. Oversee agency housing programs, including Transitional Living Programs (2), Oneida County Street Outreach, Family Homeless Case Management, Care Transitions and ESSHI Programs.
  2. Translate agency strategy into integrated program operations, workflows, and implementation priorities across housing stability services.
  3. Directly supervise, coach, and support Program Managers to ensure accountability, leadership development, quality implementation, and consistent program performance.
  4. Ensure housing programs are implemented effectively and achieve intended outcomes while maintaining a strong commitment to Housing First principles, trauma-informed care, client-centered services, and strengths-based practices.
  5. Promote collaboration across housing programs to improve continuity of care, client engagement, housing retention, and long-term stability.


Housing Development & ESSHI Implementation:

  1. Lead the planning, development, and operational readiness of future ESSHI supportive housing projects from award through implementation.
  1. Coordinate cross-functional planning efforts related to staffing, policies, procedures, service delivery models, regulatory compliance, and operational infrastructure for new supportive housing developments.
  2. Collaborate with VP of Community Services to establish implementation timelines, occupancy plans, staffing models, referral processes, and service delivery strategies for new supportive housing developments.
  3. Develop operational policies, workflows, partnerships, and procedures necessary to successfully launch supportive housing programs.
  4. Identify opportunities to expand supportive housing, housing stability initiatives, and other innovative housing solutions that align with community needs and agency strategic priorities.
  5. Support grant development, contract implementation, and funding opportunities related to supportive housing expansion.
  6. Monitor project milestones and implementation benchmarks to ensure successful program launch and long-term sustainability.


Housing Partnerships & Community Engagement:

  1. Build and maintain collaborative relationships with county departments, healthcare systems, behavioral health providers, landlords, affordable housing developers, housing authorities, managed care organizations, Continuum of Care partners, and community agencies.
  1. Represent the agency within local, regional, and statewide housing coalitions, planning groups, task forces, and collaborative initiatives.
  2. Work collaboratively with the Vice President of Community Services to identify new funding opportunities, housing initiatives, and strategic partnerships.
  3. Develop strategic relationships that increase housing access, strengthen coordinated care, improve landlord engagement, and expand supportive housing opportunities.
  4. Collaborate with municipal planning departments, community stakeholders, and housing partners to identify future supportive housing opportunities.
  5. Promote innovative housing solutions that address homelessness, housing instability, and community needs.


Contract Management, Compliance & Quality Improvement:

  1. Ensure compliance with all federal, state, county, Medicaid, HUD, ESSHI, and contractual requirements.
  1. Maintain oversight of documentation standards, quality assurance activities, incident management, audits, monitoring visits, and corrective action planning in partnership with the Vice President of Community Services and Quality Improvement team.
  2. Utilize program data and performance metrics to identify trends, service gaps, opportunities, and emerging community needs.
  3. Ensure contract deliverables, reporting requirements, and performance expectations are achieved.
  4. Present program accomplishments, performance trends, risks, and improvement opportunities to senior leadership through data-informed reporting.
  5. Ensure adherence to agency policies, contractual requirements, and applicable local, state, and federal regulations.


Fiscal Stewardship & Operational Management:

  1. Collaborate with the Vice President of Community Services and Finance Department to develop, monitor, and manage program budgets and fiscal performance.
  1. Monitor program expenditures, staffing patterns, occupancy, referrals, contract utilization, and resource allocation to ensure financial sustainability and quality service delivery.
  2. Participate in budget planning, grant implementation, contract development, and long-term sustainability efforts.
  3. Participate in financial planning for new supportive housing developments, including staffing projections, operating budgets, service funding, and implementation planning.
  4. Collaborate with Finance and executive leadership to ensure operational readiness aligns with construction timelines and funding requirements.
  5. Make operational and staffing recommendations that maintain fiscal responsibility while achieving contractual and programmatic goals.


Workforce Leadership, Human Resources & Culture:

  1. Partner closely with Human Resources and the Vice President of Community Services to support recruitment, onboarding, retention, workforce planning, employee engagement, performance management, and personnel matters.
  1. Foster leadership development among Program Managers and support succession planning efforts.
  2. Serve as a culture ambassador by modeling and reinforcing the agency's mission, vision, values, and commitment to excellence.
  3. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, professionalism, continuous quality improvement, innovation, and psychological safety.
  4. Participate actively in agency-wide initiatives, strategic planning efforts, and cross-department collaboration to strengthen organizational alignment.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Human Services, Public Administration, Public Health, Psychology, Counseling, or a related field required.
  • Minimum five years of progressive leadership or management experience overseeing housing stability, homeless services, supportive housing, behavioral health, healthcare, or human service programs.
  • Experience developing or implementing housing programs, leading complex projects, or managing multidisciplinary community initiatives strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple contracts, budgets, grants, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Knowledge of Housing First principles, trauma-informed care, HUD programs, ESSHI initiatives, supportive housing models, coordinated entry systems, Medicaid-funded services, and homeless response systems.
  • Experience collaborating with housing developers, state agencies, managed care organizations, healthcare systems, and community stakeholders preferred.
  • Strong strategic leadership, communication, organizational, fiscal management, project management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data, drive quality improvement, lead organizational change, and implement strategic initiatives.
  • Valid New York State driver's license with the ability to travel throughout the service area as required.

title: Lab Assistant-Engineering Technology
description:
Who We Are:

Are you ready to work at a dynamic institution that believes in higher education with lower obstacles? Benjamin Franklin Cummings Institute of Technology (now known as Franklin Cummings Tech) is a nationally accredited non-profit, technical college serving Eastern Massachusetts and beyond. The college was seeded in 1791 with funds from the estate of Benjamin Franklin that were given to the City of Boston to proliferate access to education and level the playing field for aspiring talent with meager financial means.


Today, Franklin Cummings Tech continues to build on that legacy by offering post-secondary education in high-demand technical and skilled trade fields that lead to excellent careers. Our majors intentionally focus on select industries connected to sustainability and the clean energy transition including electric vehicle technology, smart manufacturing, practical electricity, power engineering, heat pumps/HVAC, biotechnology, automation, construction management and more.

With a mission to deliver transformative technical and trade education that leads to economic advancement, we offer a unique mix of certificate and degree granting programs that appeal to enterprising students and respond to employers’ demand for a well-prepared workforce. Intentional partnerships with the industries we serve coupled with high graduation and job placement rates, recently attracted the largest philanthropic gift in the history of the college from the Cummings Foundation.

Last year, Franklin Cummings Tech educated more than 1,000 learners across three student types: 1) certificate and degree seekers, 2) continuing education clients, and 3) high schoolers pursuing early college. As further evidence that our mission holds resonance, this year the college tracked a 25% year-over-year jump in fall new student enrollment and applications soared.

We seek team members who are optimistic, entrepreneurial, data-informed, and excited about the prospect of continuing to strategically increase student success outcomes and total enrollment from 1,000 learners today to at least 1,500 learners by 2030. Join us in this mission driven work!

title: Mechanical Process Technician
description:
Build a Long-Term Career in Food-Grade Manufacturing

At Fuji Vegetable Oil, Inc., this is not a traditional production role—and it’s not just pushing buttons.

We are looking for a hands-on Utility Technician / Processing Technician who is mechanically inclined, enjoys troubleshooting, and takes ownership of keeping operations running smoothly.

In this role, you will walk the process, work directly with equipment, troubleshoot issues in real-time, and support the physical operation of the plant—from pressing filters to maintaining flow through our systems.

We refine high-quality, food-grade vegetable oil used in premium chocolate and confectionery products worldwide. Our environment is safety-driven, GMP-compliant, and highly process-focused, where attention to detail and consistency matter.

If you’re someone who likes to stay moving, solve problems, and work with your hands, this is the role for you.

Why Join Fuji Vegetable Oil?

We invest in our people and reward long-term commitment.

Our Benefits Include:

  • Semi-Annual Performance-Based Bonuses
  • 401(k) with 12.5% Company Contribution
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (Day One Eligibility)
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays
  • Life Insurance, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Remote Healthcare Access
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Boot Vouchers, Required PPE, and Uniforms Provided
  • Dependent Coverage for Spouses and Children (Under Age 26)

Position Summary – Mechanical Process Technician

The Processing Technician (Utility Tech) plays a critical, hands-on role in running and maintaining the process within our CBE (Cocoa Butter Equivalent) operation.

This is a field-based role—not a control room-only position—requiring you to:

  • Walk the line and monitor live processes
  • Physically interact with equipment and systems
  • Troubleshoot and correct process disruptions
  • Maintain cleanliness and food safety standards in a GMP environment

Every day can vary based on production needs, making this a great fit for someone who enjoys variety, problem-solving, and staying engaged.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Walk the production line to monitor flow, equipment, and system performance
  • Troubleshoot process issues in real time (flow issues, pressure, temperature, blockages, etc.)
  • Operate and maintain equipment, including pumps, valves, and piping systems
  • Press and change industrial filters, including hands-on filter breakdown and rebuild
  • Perform basic mechanical work and minor repairs using hand tools
  • Assist maintenance with equipment issues and communicate system needs
  • Operate computerized systems to support processing, but remain actively engaged in the field
  • Sample, test, and monitor product quality (temps, specs, consistency)
  • Blend, transfer, and route oils through process systems
  • Maintain GMP cleanliness standards, including routine cleaning of equipment and work areas
  • Support washdowns, sanitation, and spill cleanup as needed
  • Prepare equipment for startup, shutdown, and changeovers
  • Operate forklifts and material handling equipment
  • Work in both indoor and outdoor environments, including elevated areas
  • Participate in safety initiatives and continuous improvement efforts

What We’re Looking For

We are specifically seeking someone who is:

  • Mechanically inclined and comfortable using basic tools (wrenches, etc.)
  • A troubleshooter who can identify and resolve issues—not just report them
  • Comfortable working on their feet, moving throughout the plant, and staying hands-on
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and food safety (GMP)
  • Self-motivated and able to take initiative without constant direction
  • Interested in long-term growth within a stable manufacturing environment

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • 6+ months of industrial, mechanical, or manufacturing experience preferred
  • Experience in process operations, maintenance support, utilities, or production troubleshooting is a strong plus

Knowledge & Skills

  • Ability to read measurements (tape measure, gauges, etc.)
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and comfort with tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to follow safety procedures and operating instructions
  • Effective communication (verbal and radio)
  • Basic math skills (fractions, decimals, conversions)

Physical Requirements

This is an active, hands-on role requiring the ability to:

  • Stand, walk, climb, and move throughout the plant for extended periods
  • Work at heights (up to 60 feet)
  • Lift up to 50 pounds
  • Work in confined spaces (with proper clearance)
  • Perform repetitive physical tasks, including cleaning and equipment handling

Work Environment

  • Combination of indoor and outdoor work
  • Exposure to heat, steam, oils, and industrial equipment
  • GMP environment requiring cleanliness and sanitation standards
  • Loud environment (hearing protection provided)

What Success Looks Like in This Role

Successful candidates typically come from backgrounds such as:

  • Utility Technician / Boiler / Process Operator
  • Maintenance Technician or Mechanically Inclined Production Tech
  • Industrial manufacturing with hands-on troubleshooting experience
  • Experience working with pumps, valves, filters, conveyors, or process systems

They are known for:

  • Taking initiative
  • Being reliable and consistent

title: Production Materials Coordinator-Chemical Manufacturing 1st
description:
Position Summary:

The Lean Material Flow Specialist is directly responsible and accountable for the tactical and real-time execution of Lean material flow within a chemical processing environment. This includes inventory kitting, staging, replenishing, returning, and direct digital/material accountability from warehouse through line-side, changeover, and end-of-run. The Specialist acts as the subject matter expert on inventory accuracy, material readiness, and buffer management, enabling higher operator value-add time and improved reliability – all in compliance with PSM, OSHA, HazCom and facility protocols.

Essential Duties:

  • Review production schedules, batch records, and inventory data to prepare kitting and staging requirements for raw materials, packaging, and consumables.
  • Pick, kit, label, stage, and issue materials to production lines to ensure accurate, timely availability.
  • Replenish line-side, staging, and buffer inventory based on production demand and changing priorities.
  • Reconcile physical and system inventory in SAP/ERP; investigate, escalate, and help resolve discrepancies affecting production readiness.
  • Support changeovers and machine setup by aligning staged materials to production needs to reduce downtime.
  • Manage returns, scrap, empties, and by-products to maintain organized work areas, material traceability, and compliance.
  • Collaborate with Material Handlers and Warehouse Manager to coordinate material movement between warehouses, secondary storage, and production areas to maintain continuous flow.
  • Monitor shortages, stockouts, and bottlenecks; communicate proactively with production, warehouse, and shift leadership.
  • Maintain accurate material transactions, labeling, and documentation to support inventory control and regulatory standards.
  • Assist with cross-shift, weekend, and contingency coverage plans, while supporting 5S and continuous improvement in staging and material flow processes.


Success Criteria:

  • Material Flow Reliability: ≥98% on-time completion of workstation replenishment with zero unplanned stockouts at point-of-use stations.
  • Safety & Compliance Excellence: Zero incidents, spills, exposures, or regulatory findings; 100% adherence to PSM, OSHA, HazCom, RCRA, DOT, and spill prevention protocols.
  • Inventory & Pull System Accuracy: ≥99% POU inventory match during audits.
  • Waste & Contamination Control: Zero accumulation of empties/hazardous waste at workstations and zero cross-contamination events.
  • Operator Support Effectiveness: ≥95% reduction in operator material-fetching interruptions (via audits/feedback); on-time assistance for ≥95% of changeovers.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical/chemical-related certification preferred.
  • 1–2 years in chemical manufacturing, material handling, or production support; hazardous materials experience a plus.
  • Knowledge of Lean principles (JIT, Kanban, waste reduction) and regulated process industries.
  • Strong time management, reliability, and ability to follow precise routes/schedules.
  • Physical ability to walk extensively, handle carts/tuggers/dollies, and lift up to 50 lbs while wearing PPE (respirators, suits, etc.).
  • Safety-focused mindset with attention to detail, quality, and regulatory compliance.
  • Good communication/teamwork; basic ERP/scanner skills.


Work Environment /Physical Demands:

Work Environment: Primarily on the chemical production floor with high mobility across reactors, mixers, filling lines, storage areas, and waste zones; exposure to typical manufacturing conditions including noise, chemical odors, varying temperatures, potential hazardous atmospheres, and strict PPE-required areas (e.g., respirators, protective clothing, gloves); adherence to PSM, OSHA, HazCom, RCRA, and facility safety protocols is mandatory at all times.


Physical Demands: Extensive walking and standing for most/all of the shift while following replenishment routes; frequent pushing/pulling of carts, tuggers, drum dollies, or material handling equipment; lifting, carrying, and moving loads up to 50 lbs (e.g., containers, drums, supplies); bending, stooping, and reaching to handle materials or replenish stations; sustained physical activity to maintain pace and reliability in a fast-moving, safety-critical setting.


Additional Considerations: Must wear full required PPE continuously; ability to respond quickly to alerts or needs without compromising safety; role requires good balance, stamina, and dexterity for precise handling of chemicals and equipment to prevent spills, exposures, or cross-contamination.

Station Supervisor are often required to work at various locations in addition to their supervisory duties. title: Generally Registered Psychologist | Parramatta & Surrounds
description:
Connect2Care started as a passion for two physiotherapists and has now become one of the fastest-growing allied health companies in Australia, with services nationwide. As a registered NDIS health provider, Connect2Care provides a range of community-based, allied health services to people of all ages and of all abilities.

Growing every day, with opportunities bubbling at every corner, Connect2Care is invested in delivering best-practice therapy to its clients. We also want to ensure their therapists feel satisfied and motivated to come to work every day.

Our team is a beautiful group of like-minded individuals working together to fulfill the same mission; to empower people to reach their personal goals.

Location: All C2C Service locations around Australia

Salary: Banding $79,499 to $96,400 + Super

Occupations: Positions available for Occupational therapists, Speech Pathologists and Psychologists


The Role

As a therapist at Connect2Care, you will be joining a multidisciplinary team. You will provide evidence-based services to people through multiple service delivery models, including telehealth, community visits and centre-based services. Referrals may come through the NDIS, Medicare or privately. It is a mobile role, with the option to work from home or our hubs when not seeing clients. The role will involve the following:

  • Assessing and providing interventions for children & adults living with a range of disabilities
  • Working within the NDIS to maximise clients' level of function, capacity & social engagement
  • Assisting clients with assistive technology assessment, recommendations and applications (in relevant fields)
  • Timely documentation & report writing
  • Managing a varied caseload
  • Meeting company professional expectations (e.g. meeting billables & effective client management)
  • Attending meetings, supervision & personal development (as required)
  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, including therapists, clients, & referral sources
  • Working across leading software platforms & online tools


The New Grad Program

Connect2Care has developed and specifically tailored a New Graduate Program to make the transition smoother for new graduates entering the workplace. The program fully supports recent graduates, enabling them to acquire the skills needed to launch them into a successful career. Spanning over 12 months and starting from the moment you step through our doors.

What you can expect:

  • Comprehensive induction week
  • Weekly 1:1 supervision with your supervisor
  • Core competency skills training sessions
  • Fortnightly group mentoring sessions
  • Mental health drop in sessions
  • Internal PD sessions
  • Shadowing opportunities with experienced clinicians
  • Opportunity to learn & be supported by senior clinicians within multidisciplinary teams

Connect2Care is fortunate to be surrounded by a wealth of knowledge, with each staff member bringing different and unique learning experiences to the company. As we have over 100 therapists, with some having specialties in certain areas of clinical practice, you will have the opportunity to expand your knowledge and learn from the best.



Requirements

To apply for the role, you will need to have or be able to obtain the following:

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in related field
  • Discipline-specific professional registration (e.g. AHPRA/SPA)
  • Working with Children Check (WWCC or Blue Card)
  • NDIS Worker Screening Check
  • Police Check & International Police Check (only applicable to individuals who have lived overseas)
  • Drivers licence & access to a reliable vehicle
  • Car insurance
  • Professional Indemnity & Public Liability insurance

As part of your role, you will be working with children, people with disability, the elderly, and people who are vulnerable. We are committed to safety, including those of children. We have zero tolerance for abuse.



Benefits

Connect2Care fiercely believes that happiness is the key to success. Knowing this, we place significant value on an exceptional work culture and a healthy work-life balance, hoping that our therapists love what they do!

Additional benefits of working at Connect2Care include:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Achievable KPI bonuses
  • Loyalty bonuses
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Benefits, discounts & rewards with premier retail & service partners
  • Clearly defined career progression opportunities
  • Comprehensive New Graduate Program

  • Social events, team building & well-being activities
  • Opportunities to live & base yourself almost anywhere in Australia
  • Unlimited drinks & snacks in all our hubs

The Application Process

If you think you would be a good fit at Connect2Care, we would love to hear from you! To view and apply for a role at Connect2Care, please visit

Alternatively, if you would like to have a private and confidential conversation with someone from our Recruitment Team, please call 1800 950 288.

title: Staff AI Product Manager, Phoenix Platform
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need - and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across Musculoskeletal, Women’s Health, Cardiometabolic, and Mental Health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 1 million members across three continents have completed over 15 million AI sessions, helping 2,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 59 clinical studies, 43 patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

The platform
The Phoenix platform is the continuous, connected intelligence layer that makes Sword’s AI Care solutions come alive. It provides the building blocks across member experience, clinician efficiency, and customer support for Sword’s products to ship integrated, delightful, and differentiated care.
By carefully designing and maintaining these blocks while driving AI innovation, the Phoenix Platform enables teams to ship fast and well without rework.
AI Proficiency at Sword Health

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword Health. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

    • Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

What you’ll do:

  • Own Sword’s Applied AI platform roadmap, from strategic initiatives and innovation bets through to platform upkeep;
  • Work at the intersection of AI and product management, hands-on with the agents, evals, harnesses, and observability that our care products are built on;
  • Own the trade-offs that shape the platform: cost, latency, quality, and when to move to open source models or bring something in-house;
  • Scope initiatives with Engineering, AI, and Product teams, carefully balancing reusability with differentiation;
  • Execute by iterating closely with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Operations to guarantee scope adapts and deliverables do not drift from high-value member experiences;
  • Hold the quality bar, including after release. A model that degrades quietly in production is your problem;
  • Own safety alongside our clinical team. Our agents talk to people about their bodies and their recovery, and you’ll know how we prevent, detect, and respond when they get something wrong.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in product management, including recent hands-on ownership of an AI-powered product;
  • Significant technical depth in AI, generative AI in particular. You understand how models, prompting, retrieval, and agent architectures actually behave, not just what they’re supposed to do;
  • You’ve put LLM-based features in front of real users and dealt with what came back: the evaluation, the annotation, the observability, the failure modes nobody predicted;
  • You can hold your own in an AI or engineering discussion, and follow a nuanced technical decision through to what the member will actually experience;
  • You disagree up and sideways. We expect pushback any time the member experience is being compromised, whatever the source;
  • Ability to efficiently track the state of the art and, exercising sound product and technical taste, bring innovation;
  • You write and speak clearly enough to cut through noise. At our size that’s a load-bearing skill, not a nice-to-have;
  • You get real leverage out of coding agents: debugging, data analysis, production monitoring, small builds, one-off tooling, research, process automation. No slop;
  • You can manage and grow a small product team.

Bonus points:

  • Memory, guardrails, or multi-agent orchestration;
  • Voice AI experiences shipped to production;
  • Experimentation or evaluation infrastructure you built rather than inherited (A/B testing, evals, human annotation);
  • Working knowledge of how foundation models are trained and deployed;
  • Healthcare, or another regulated domain where being wrong has consequences.
*This range includes base, variable and equity

These compensation bands are just the starting point. Once someone joins and proves they’re outlier talent, we adjust quickly to ensure their compensation aligns with their impact.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. Actual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, location, market demand, and other factors. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base salary and any potential variable, bonus or sales incentives, and the Company’s estimation of the value of private company stock options, if applicable. The pay range is subject to change, future value of company stock options is not guaranteed, and compensation may be modified in the future. In addition to our total compensation, Sword offers a number of benefits as listed below.
