• Meal allowance
• Equity shares
• Remote work allowance
• Flexible working hours
• Work from home
• Discretionary vacation
• Snacks and beverages
Note: Please note that this position does not offer relocation assistance. Candidates must possess a valid EU visa and be based in Portugal.
Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender, Gender expression, Gender identity, Gender information, Marital status, Medical condition, National origin, Physical or mental disability, Pregnancy, Race, Religion, Caste, Sexual orientation, and Veteran status.

title: Virtual Security Operations Center-Program Ma
description:
Job Title: Program Manager / Virtual Security Operations Center (vSOC)– CISSP

Company: Sugpiat Defense, LLC Salary: DOE

Reports To: PM FLSA Status: Full-Time / Exempt (Shift)

Location: Remote/ Hybrid (Washington, DC metro preferred- on-site requirements in the Washington, DC metro aera)

Job Summary:

Sugpiat Defense is looking for a highly qualified Program Manager with an active security clearance and extensive experience managing a Virtual Security Operations Center (vSOC) in a federal setting. This dual-role leader will be responsible for both the execution of the contract at the program level and the operational oversight of vSOC services, addressing enterprise cybersecurity needs within a Managed Shared Services model. The successful candidate will ensure 24/7 readiness of the SOC, adherence to federal standards (FISMA, NIST, Zero Trust), and the delivery of high-quality contract performance within a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) structure.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Lead program planning, resource management, scheduling, and risk mitigation through a formal Program Management Plan (PMP).
  • Deliver and maintain a Quality Control Plan (QCP) ensuring contract deliverables meet SLA thresholds and federal cybersecurity standards.
  • Serve as the primary interface to the federal Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer’s Representative.
  • Manage internal staffing, subcontractors, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Conduct kickoff briefings, status reviews, and quarterly reporting.
  • vSOC Operations Management
  • Direct the operations of a contractor-hosted Virtual Security Operations Center (vSOC) delivering 24/7 monitoring, threat detection, and incident response.
  • Supervise tiered SOC teams and ensure shift coverage, operational performance, and audit-readiness.
  • Oversee incident handling, malware reverse engineering, SIEM optimization, and threat analytics.
  • Ensure compliance with federal security frameworks including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53/800-207, EO 14028, and Zero Trust requirements.
  • Develop and report on performance metrics, threat trends, and continuous improvement actions.

Required Education and Experience:

  • CISSP certification (required)
  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity or IT program management
  • 5+ years managing SOC or vSOC environments in the federal or defense sector
  • Strong understanding of federal compliance frameworks (FISMA, NIST, OMB, Zero Trust)
  • Experience developing and executing PMPs and QCPs for complex government programs
  • Demonstrated leadership with both technical and client-facing teams
  • Must be a U.S. citizen with an active TS/SCI clearance or eligible to obtain one

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP, CISM, CISA, or ITIL certification
  • Experience with VDI environments (e.g., Citrix, Nutanix)
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms (Splunk preferred), IDS/IPS, endpoint protection
  • Background in incident response, vulnerability management, and federal audit cycles
  • Strong communication skills with ability to brief stakeholders and manage technical staff

Join Team Sugpiat to gain real-world experience in a federal cybersecurity mission. Be part of a team defending against nation-state actors and advanced threats. Sugpiat Defense offers competitive salaries, benefits, and shift differentials. Don’t wait, apply NOW!

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required, sometimes for extended periods, to walk, stand, or sit. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. The employee is occasionally required to climb ladders or stairs; use hands to type, finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and get in and out of vehicles. title: Advanced CNC Operator 2nd Shift - SRC Automotive
description:
SRC Automotive, Inc. is a leader in the remanufacturing of engines used in the Automotive, Marine, Natural Gas & Oil and Power Systems industries.

At SRC, we do things differently. Our associates take pride in their reputation as businesspeople who understand how they impact our bottom line. Their excellent technical skills – accompanied by their role as employee-owners – has become our legacy.

Our Advanced CNC Operators operate machine shop equipment such as mills, lathes, grinders, presses, drill presses, CMM, or operate an assembly line for routine parts from casting. They may operate manual machining equipment. They produce production parts to required tolerances for preparation for the engine assembly.

This is a 2nd shift position working 3:30pm - 2:00am Monday-Thursday with mandatory overtime as needed Fridays and Saturdays.

About the Job:

  • Performs routine production duties by following written processes to operate machinery such as: mills, lathes, grinders, seat/guide/stud presses, induction heat treating equipment, drill presses, CMM, specialized gauging equipment for seat and guides and operate an assembly line to specific tolerances in required quantities.
  • Performs equipment set up, make machine offsets, maintain tooling, and may perform minor operating modifications to equipment as needed.
  • Responsible for the visual and quantifiable inspection of the result of their process.
  • Ability to use and understand general machine shop gauges, operate a CMM, and understand the CMM data to know when machines need adjusted.
  • Assess adjustments needed to CNC equipment by reviewing CMM reports, make adjustments as necessary, check adjustments for accuracy.
  • Resolves basic production and machine operating problems, reports non-routine machinery failures to the Team Leader or Production Supervisor for assistance.
  • Maintains good housekeeping in the department.
  • Follows all safety rules regarding machine operation and proper guarding.
  • Maintains a safe working environment by following company safety policies.
  • Performs daily Total Preventive Maintenance on the equipment to maintain their quality.
  • Assist in other production areas as needed.
  • Assist in SRC Automotive’s continuous improvement efforts.
  • Works within production processes to ensure compliance with IATF-16949.
  • Participates in and supports the principles of Open Book Management.

Work Environment:

Applicants must be able to work in a manufacturing environment. You may be exposed to harsh conditions such as dust, fumes, noise, and varying temperatures for extended period of times. PPE such as steel toed boots, safety glasses, gloves, and ear protection may be required.

Physical Requirements:

You will regularly be required to walk, stand, use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms, climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk and hear. You may sit 5% of the time and stand/walk 95% of the time. You must be able to frequently lift or move 35 to 50 pounds.

Who you are:

As an employee-owner, you must have a teammate mentality and strong interpersonal skills. An employee-owner is proactive, upholds commitments and is continually learning. Other requirements include:

  • Two or more years of experience in a manufacturing paced assembly line setting preferred.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematics addition, subtraction, and conversions.
  • Ability to work back and forth between the metric and SAE standards.
  • Ability to use hand, air, and power tools.
  • Verbal and written communication skills.
  • Requires effective relationship management skills with co-workers in a team environment.
  • Basic computer literacy required. Ability to use computer systems to retrieve work process and Bills of Materials.
  • Requires the desire to expand knowledge, skills, and abilities through training and education.

Rewards for you:

  • Competitive compensation package with opportunity for growth in your career; promotion from within opportunities available
  • Affordable and comprehensive insurance on your 61st day of employment
  • Bonus opportunity up to 8%
  • Paid Time Off Program and 11 paid Holidays
  • 5% 401(k) match
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • 100% Tuition Reimbursement
  • Fitness Center and Wellness Program with free mental health resources

Employee-owners first, manufacturers second:

We believe the best way to operate is to educate everyone on how the business works, give them a voice in saying how the company is run and provide them a stake in the financial outcome, good or bad.

We do this by creating a business of businesspeople who think, act and feel like owners through education, empowerment and engagement. It’s all part of our open-book management system, The Great Game of Business®.

If you are interested in joining our team, we would love to hear from you! Please submit an application and our HR team will reach out to you.

3:30pm to 2:00am Monday-Thursday with mandatory overtime on Fridays and Saturdays as needed.

Qualifications

Knowledge of:
  • Proficiency in standard manual communication methods for the Deaf and hard of hearing, encompassing American Sign Language, Signed English, fingerspelling, and non-manual expression such as facial, eye, and body language.

  • Current developments, trends, and techniques in the field of interpreting for both the Deaf and hard of hearing as utilized by the Deaf community.

Skilled in:

Ability To:

  • Exercise patience, tact, flexibility and sensitivity.
  • Meet schedules and timelines.
Physical Demands

This role functions in diverse environments, primarily delivering in-person services at customer locations, with occasional virtual or remote work as needed based on customer needs. title: Flight Ticketing and Reservation Officer
description:
Job Summary

The Flight Ticketing and Reservation Officer plays a pivotal role in facilitating seamless travel experiences by managing the full spectrum of airline booking operations. This position focuses on the precise issuance and modification of tickets, handling complex cancellations and refunds, and serving as a primary source of accurate travel intelligence for clients. The officer ensures strict adherence to airline policies and fare structures while collaborating effectively with airline partners, travel agencies, and internal departments to fulfill diverse client travel requirements with efficiency and professionalism.

Responsibilities:
  • Guide clients through the process of securing reservations for both domestic and international flights.
  • Execute the booking, issuance, reissuance, and cancellation of airline tickets utilizing Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and proprietary airline platforms.

  • Track real-time flight status updates and proactively inform clients of any schedule alterations, delays, or itinerary changes.
  • Construct comprehensive travel itineraries and secure final confirmations with customers.
  • Address and resolve client inquiries, grievances, and booking discrepancies with speed and a professional demeanor.
  • Uphold meticulous records of reservations and client data within the booking management system.
  • Liaise with airlines and travel suppliers to identify and secure optimal travel solutions.
  • Adhere to all organizational policies, airline mandates, and industry best practices.
  • Handle financial transactions, generate receipts, and reconcile sales figures as necessary.
  • Achieve established benchmarks for service quality and booking processing speed.
  • Provide tailored travel solutions for both corporate and leisure clientele.
  • Remain current on airline promotions, fare conditions, travel alerts, and market trends to offer expert guidance.
  • Partner with the Digital Marketing Team to design and launch travel offers and promotional initiatives.

title: Executive Vice President, AFBA and 5Star Life
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION:

The Executive Vice President, AFBA and 5Star Life Insurance serves as a senior executive leader supporting both the Armed Forces Benefit Association and 5Star Life Insurance Company. This position acts as deputy to the President of AFBA and 5Star Life Insurance, providing executive leadership, strategic support, operational oversight, and cross-functional coordination to advance AFBA’s mission and ensure alignment across AFBA and 5Star Life. The role also serves as a knowledgeable resource on life insurance, supplemental health, worksite voluntary benefits, policy administration, claims support, and insurance-related customer and broker service. The position requires strong executive judgment, insurance knowledge, relationship management, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complex policy, benefit, operational, and organizational matters clearly and professionally.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as Executive Vice President for AFBA and 5Star Life Insurance, providing senior leadership, strategic guidance, and enterprise-wide coordination in support of the President and organizational priorities.
  • Act as deputy to the President of AFBA, representing the President as requested, supporting executive decision-making, coordinating key initiatives, and helping ensure effective follow-through across departments and leadership teams.
  • Support AFBA governance, board, committee, member, partner, and stakeholder activities by helping prepare information, coordinate responses, elevate issues, and advance priorities on behalf of executive leadership.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for 5Star Life insurance products, including life insurance, supplemental health, group, and worksite voluntary benefit offerings.
  • Explain policy provisions, benefit schedules, eligibility rules, coverage limits, exclusions, continuation options, portability provisions, premium requirements, and claims procedures in clear, practical language.
  • Support internal business partners, brokers, employer groups, policyholders, insureds, and beneficiaries, as needed with insurance-related questions and service needs.
  • Coordinate across AFBA and 5Star Life functions to ensure communication, execution, and operational decisions are aligned with the President’s direction, board priorities, member service expectations, and business objectives.
  • Review policy, certificate, rider, enrollment, claims, and administrative documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with contract provisions and company policies and procedures.
  • Assist with claims-related inquiries by helping clarify documentation requirements, coverage provisions, claim status, and next steps while coordinating with claims, operations, compliance, and other internal teams as needed.
  • Partner with Worksite, Distribution, Operations, Claims, Compliance, Legal, Actuarial, Product, and Sales teams to resolve issues and support a strong client and customer experience.
  • Identify trends, recurring service issues, process gaps, or training needs and recommend improvements that strengthen service quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of communications, policy reviews, service requests, claims support, and related follow-up activity.
  • Assist with new product implementation, policy administration updates, process improvements, audits, regulatory inquiries, and quality assurance activities as requested.
  • Demonstrate complete adherence to privacy laws, company privacy guidelines, confidentiality requirements, and standards for safeguarding customer, employee, and business information.
  • Travel to other offices, conferences, meetings, and other events as necessary to accomplish business goals.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance, finance, association management, public administration, or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible leadership experience in life insurance, supplemental health, group benefits, worksite benefits, claims, policy administration, customer operations, account management, underwriting, compliance, association management, nonprofit leadership, or a related executive function, including significant executive-level responsibility with a life insurance carrier, association, or member-based organization.
  • Experience in association executive management, including governance support, board and committee relations, member services, strategic planning, executive communications, stakeholder engagement, and implementation of association priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience working with or reporting to Boards of Directors, executive committees, senior officers, or governance bodies in a mission-driven, member-based, nonprofit, association, insurance, or financial services environment.
  • Professional insurance designation or coursework such as ALMI, ACS, FLMI, AINS, CLU, or similar credential.
  • Experience with life, accident, hospital indemnity, critical illness, cancer, disability, or other supplemental health insurance products.
  • Experience supporting brokers, employer groups, worksite voluntary benefit programs, or member-based insurance programs.
  • Experience with LifePRO, Salesforce, enrollment platforms, imaging systems, or other insurance administration tools preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to learn insurance administration, imaging, workflow, CRM, enrollment, or claims systems.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES & COMPETENCIES:

  • Executive presence, discretion, and judgment necessary to serve as deputy to the President of AFBA and to help lead enterprise priorities across AFBA and 5Star Life.
  • Strong understanding of life insurance and supplemental health products, policy language, benefit provisions, claims requirements, and insurance administration processes.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and explain group policies, certificates, riders, benefit schedules, forms, and related insurance documents.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with Boards of Directors, AFBA members, regulators, distribution partners, vendors, executive leadership, and internal teams, and to represent the President and organization with professionalism and sound judgment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with brokers, employer groups, insureds, beneficiaries, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of insurance compliance, privacy, regulatory requirements, quality assurance, market conduct, or audit support.
  • Ability to foster a culture of integrity, accountability, service excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Exceptional analytical thinking and practical problem-solving. Attention to detail, accuracy, and documentation discipline. Professional discretion and confidentiality.


WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position will be based in Alexandria, Virginia. The role requires regular collaboration with AFBA and 5Star Life leadership, internal departments, boards, committees, brokers, employer groups, policyholders, insureds, beneficiaries, vendors, and service partners. The position may be asked to represent or act on behalf of the President of AFBA in meetings, communications, initiatives, and follow-up activities. Occasional travel or extended hours may be required during board and committee activities, product launches, renewals, audits, major service initiatives, claims escalations, executive priorities, or project deadlines.

The Armed Forces Benefit Association serves members and their families through benefits, services, and support designed for those connected to military, government, and public service communities. 5Star Life Insurance Company is the primary underwriter of AFBA member policies and is also a provider of group and worksite voluntary products. title: Lead Fullstack Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION

We're seeking a lead Full-Stack Engineer to lead a diverse team to design, implement, and optimize production-grade tools and applications that support video game asset pipelines and production workflows.

Responsibilities
Agent loop & harness engineering

  • Own prompting strategy at scale: system prompt design, guardrails, mitigation of context poisoning and pollution, and management of hyperparameters (context window sizing, lost-in-the-middle effects, temperature, top-k).
  • Design tool interfaces for agents: MCP servers, structured inputs/outputs for context, and sub-agent composition patterns.
  • Champion best practices for typed-agent frameworks, with first-class observability and telemetry baked into every agent.
  • Evaluate and integrate ..local LLM.. options where latency, cost, or data-residency requirements demand it.

Backend

  • Design and build scalable backend services and secure RESTful APIs using Python (FastAPI or Flask).
  • Model, query, and optimize data across relational and NoSQL databases implement caching and messaging when needed.
  • Enforce authentication/authorization, input validation, and robust error handling.

Quality, performance, and delivery

  • Write comprehensive tests with tools such as pytest.
  • Own performance tuning, troubleshooting, code reviews, and technical documentation.
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD with Git and GitLab use Docker for local development and deployment pipelines.


Collaboration and process

  • Lead a group of engineers to deliver AI/Software project.Partner with UI/UX, backend, production, SRE, and IT stakeholders to deliver user-centric solutions.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor junior engineers.
  • Work within agile methodologies, continuously improving team practices.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience building production applications as a fullstack engineer.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python (FastAPI or Flask), RESTful API design, and SQLAlchemy/Pydantic or similar tooling.
  • Proficiency in Vue or React, including routing, state management (Vuex/Pinia or Redux), and component libraries.
  • Proven experience working on public cloud like AWS/GCP
  • Database proficiency with relational systems (PostgreSQL) and familiarity with NoSQL (MongoDB, Vector DB) experience with caching and message queues (Redis) is valued.
  • Proven testing mindset and experience with automated test suites.
  • Comfortable with Git, GitLab CI/CD, and Docker.
  • Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Nice to haveExperience with agent development frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph) is a plus.Certification: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate

title: Lead Social
description:
Als Lead Social geef je leiding aan het Social team en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, uitvoering en continue optimalisatie van de social mediastrategie van de Postcode Loterij en de VriendenLoterij. Je vertaalt de marketingdoelstellingen van beide organisaties naar een heldere en meetbare social aanpak en bent inhoudelijk eigenaar van de organische social performance op onze kanalen. Vanuit diepgaande kennis van platforms, community ontwikkeling en data-analyse zorg je voor structurele groei in zichtbaarheid, community -en contentimpact. Daarnaast stuur je de multidisciplinaire Social Taskforce aan en werk je nauw samen met collega’s binnen Marketing en daarbuiten. Bovendien: met jouw werk lever je, net als jouw collega’s, elke dag een bijdrage aan alle goede doelen die we steunen.

Geert Friebel, Hoofd Marketing Postcode Loterij: “Elke dag werk ik met slimme, gedreven collega’s aan campagnes die écht verschil maken – niet alleen in onze resultaten, maar ook in de wereld daarbuiten. De combinatie van de grote zichtbaarheid van onze social uitingen, data, creativiteit en maatschappelijke impact maakt dit werk uniek.”

Dit ga je doen:

  • Je geeft leiding aan het Social team. Je bent zowel inhoudelijk als hiërarchisch verantwoordelijk voor het team en zorgt voor een inspirerende werkomgeving waarin collega’s zich kunnen ontwikkelen. Daarnaast stuur je de multidisciplinaire Social Taskforce aan, waarin creatie, paid social en productie samenwerken aan sterke social content en campagnes.
  • Je ontwikkelt en vertaalt de social mediastrategie naar de praktijk. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de organische social performance van de Postcode Loterij en VriendenLoterij en zorgt voor een passende aanpak per kanaal, zoals Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok en Snapchat.
  • Je bouwt aan een social-first contentaanpak. Je ontwikkelt formats en content die aansluiten bij de manier waarop mensen social media gebruiken. Daarbij zorg je voor een sterke samenwerking tussen owned social, creators, influencers, ambassadeurs en partners.
  • Je signaleert kansen en innovaties. Je volgt ontwikkelingen in het social medialandschap, nieuwe platformmogelijkheden en veranderend gebruikersgedrag op de voet en vertaalt deze naar ideeën en initiatieven die bijdragen aan groei, betrokkenheid en deelnemerswerving.
  • Je stuurt op resultaat. Je definieert relevante KPI’s, maakt resultaten inzichtelijk en gebruikt data en inzichten om content en campagnes continu te verbeteren. Je weet wat werkt, waar kansen liggen en wanneer bijsturing nodig is.
  • Je verbindt teams en disciplines. Je werkt intensief samen met Marketing, Concept Center, Goede Doelen, Events, TV en andere collega’s binnen de organisatie. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking en maakt social media een integraal onderdeel van onze marketing- en communicatieaanpak.

Hier herken je jezelf in:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Marketing, Communicatie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.
  • Je hebt meerdere jaren relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare leidinggevende rol binnen social media, digital marketing of contentstrategie in een professionele commerciële marketingorganisatie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en realiseren van social mediastrategieën gericht op groei, community-ontwikkeling en business impact.
  • Je hebt diepgaande kennis van social mediaplatformen, algoritmes, trends en contentformats, met sterke storytellingvaardigheden en een creatief vermogen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met influencer marketing, creator partnerships en community building, en met het definiëren, monitoren en optimaliseren van social KPI's.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het coachen en ontwikkelen van creatieve professionals en/of multidisciplinaire teams, sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een resultaatgerichte, ondernemende houding.
  • Je hebt een salarisverwachting van €6.100 tot €8.500 per maand, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek en flexibele werktijden.

Wij geloven dat een inclusieve organisatie de beste voedingsbodem is voor creativiteit, samenwerking en innovatie. We hechten bovendien grote waarde aan onderlinge verbondenheid. Al onze collega’s spelen daarbij een rol: zij zijn de Loterijen. We streven ernaar dat iedereen zich bij ons thuis voelt. Dit vraagt om een open blik en oog hebben voor elkaar.

Denk jij bij ons te kunnen groeien en een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan onze organisatie? Je bent welkom, ongeacht je roots, religie, leeftijd, arbeidsvermogen of levensovertuiging.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer door middel van het opsturen van je CV en motivatie t.a.v. Caroline Hetterschijt, via .

De vacature staat niet open voor bemiddeling door bureaus, acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Education Reporter
description:
Job Summary:

The Education Reporter is responsible for covering a multitude of topics related to K-12 and higher education in Colorado, notably policy, public safety, budgeting and taxpayer spending in school districts, colleges and universities, and government by school boards and the Board of Regents. This reporter will also handle breaking news, features and general assignments as assigned.


A key component of this job is to regularly produce enterprise and feature stories, including in-depth analysis and investigative reporting. Your priority will be pursuing accountability journalism.


This position is physically based in Denver. Candidates from out of state must be willing to relocate to metro Denver.


Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Write daily stories focused on education and policy
  • Produce enterprise stories about education and other issues, as assigned
  • Pursue human-interest feature stories, as assigned
  • Pursue breaking news stories
  • Convey news and tell stories using multiple tools, including social media, photos and video
  • Develop a wide range of sources
  • Collaborate and maintain strong working relationships with staff at The Denver Gazette, Colorado Politics and the Colorado Springs Gazette
  • Coordinate with colleagues on content, visual, digital and audience operations to present and promote stories
  • Ensure that journalism standards are followed, notably accuracy and objectivity
  • Consistently meet deadlines
  • Serve as liaison for customers, sources and other community members


Other Duties:

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Minimum Education & Work Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or mass communications. Minimum of three to five years of experience at a daily newspaper preferred.

The employee may frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Study Abroad Counselor / Student Advisor
description:
Role Overview
Univacity Ltd is looking for an experienced Study Abroad Counselor to guide prospective students through every stage of their international education journey — from initial consultation and school selection to application support, visa guidance, and pre-departure preparation. This role requires someone who combines genuine empathy for students' goals and anxieties with deep, practical knowledge of study abroad processes across multiple destination countries.

Department: Student Services / Admissions
Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Head of Student Services
Location: Univacity Ltd HQ / Hybrid

Key Responsibilities

  • Counsel prospective students one-on-one (in person, by phone, or via video call) to understand their academic goals, budget, and preferences, and recommend suitable study destinations, institutions, and programs.
  • Guide students through the entire application process, including documentation, personal statements, recommendation letters, and institution-specific requirements.
  • Advise students on visa application procedures, financial documentation, and compliance requirements for their target countries.
  • Track each student's application pipeline from initial inquiry to offer acceptance and enrollment, ensuring timely follow-up at every stage.
  • Build and maintain relationships with partner universities, colleges, and institutions abroad to stay current on admission requirements, deadlines, and program offerings.
  • Conduct pre-departure briefings covering accommodation, cultural adjustment, academic expectations, and logistics.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date student records within Univacity's CRM/platform, logging interactions, document status, and next steps.
  • Address student and parent concerns with patience and clarity, managing expectations around timelines, costs, and outcomes.
  • Stay current on changes to immigration policy, visa regulations, and admissions trends across key study destinations (UK, US, Canada, Australia, Europe, etc.).
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to support webinars, info sessions, and outreach events for prospective students.
  • Meet individual and team targets for student applications, conversions, and successful enrollments.


Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in study abroad counseling, international student advising, or education consulting.
  • Demonstrated track record of successfully guiding students through university applications and visa processes.
  • Strong working knowledge of admissions requirements and visa procedures for at least two major study destinations.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with students and parents.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of student cases simultaneously without losing attention to detail.
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, International Relations, Counseling, or a related field.

Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Personal experience studying or living abroad.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems or student management platforms.
  • Existing network of contacts at partner universities or institutions.
  • Multilingual ability.
  • Experience with scholarship or financial aid advising.
  • A calm, reassuring manner when handling high-stress situations (rejections, visa delays, deadline pressure).
  • Genuine passion for international education and student success.


Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives tied to successful enrollments.
  • Opportunities for professional development, including training on new destination markets.
  • A meaningful role directly shaping students' futures.
  • Collaborative, mission-driven team culture.

title: Director of Financial Operations
description:
Scope of Job: The Director of Financial Operations stands at the intersection of finance and operations ensuring a smooth flow of information and oversight across both domains. This role involves monitoring the financial health of the company’s operations and supply chain, implementing budgetary controls, and providing strategic financial insights to support decision-making processes. By tracking and analysing operational and supply chain metrics, understanding standards and variances, controlling inventory, and driving timely financial reporting, the Director of Financial Operations aids in steering the company towards its financial and operational goals while ensuring operational and supply chain efficiencies.

At the core of this role is the management and coordination of ERP process improvements and alignment of systems ensuring the design and structure provide a strong foundation in identifying areas for financial improvement. The information provided must align operational activities with the overall financial strategy of the company, thereby fostering a cohesive environment for sustainable growth and profitability.

The Director of Financial Operations will oversee a team of plant-based controllers and cost accountants supporting plant-level operations with operational metrics, financial reporting, pricing support, and cost determination. This role will ensure consistent and accurate tracking of production costs across all sites, drive efficiency initiatives, and provide insights to improve plant profitability.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Cost Accounting Oversight: Manage the plant controllership and cost accounting function for all locations ensuring processes are effective and accurately tracking production costs, variances, and operational efficiencies. Oversee product costing, standards revisions, gross margin analysis, inventory control and accounting and reconciliations for manufacturing.
  • ERP Oversight: Manage the design, structure and flows of the ERP system to provide alignment of data and transactions for efficient and effective use in managing the business. Develop and maintain cost accounting systems, policies, and procedures that align with the organization's financial goals.
  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks in operational processes and implement strategic solutions to enhance productivity and reduce costs. Continuously evaluate workflows for optimal performance and alignment with organizational goals. Analyse operational data and reports to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for process improvements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with procurement, production, supply chain, sales, and finance teams to ensure alignment of cost objectives and pricing strategies. Work together and collaborate to ensure inventory levels meet customer needs while minimizing carrying costs and allocating resources optimally, minimizing waste and ensuring the availability of necessary items for uninterrupted operations. Create and maintain dashboards with weekly performance indicators to inform and influence management. Facilitate communication and collaboration across departments to ensure operational goals are met.
  • Risk Management: identify potential threats and develop strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth operation and financial stability. Forecasting, evaluating, and responding to risks in a way that minimizes impact while finding opportunities for improvement.
  • Financial Forecasting: Precision in predicting future revenues, expenses, and resource needs to maintain the organization’s financial health and operational efficiency. Proactively manage budget allocations and mitigate financial risks through informed strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Pricing and Cost Determination: Oversee the price board process, ensuring accurate and timely pricing aligned with business objectives and market conditions. Support Commercial and FP&A teams to perform comparative price and margin analysis to successfully secure the business at optimal margins.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare plant-level financial reports and analyse cost data to identify trends and improvement opportunities. Ensure plant leadership has complete visibility and understanding of performance and specific actions plans to drive results. Present financial information in a way that resonates with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive business action
  • Operational Support: Collaborate with plant managers and operations teams to develop strategies for cost control, process improvements, and efficiency gains. Be the business partner to think outside the four walls to what is possible for the operations in driving profitability. Lead special projects aimed at operational innovation, such as implementing new technology or systems to enhance productivity.
  • Leadership and Team Development: Provide direction, mentorship, and development opportunities for the plant-based cost accounting team. Set clear goals and objectives and ensure they are engaged with each leadership and have a full understanding of the operations.
  • Budgeting and Forecasting: Support the development of plant budgets, forecasts, and operational performance metrics. Ensure year-over-year improvements set a new bar for standard performance.
  • Collaborate with production and supporting departments to ensure the food safety and quality of our products.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in appropriate discipline required; master’s degree or CPA preferred.

Experience: 10 years of experience in manufacturing accounting and systems, with a focus on cost accounting and financial reporting. Experience managing a team within a multi-site food manufacturing environment. Experience with ERP systems; Oracle preferred.

Competencies: Business Acumen, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Financial Forecasting, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, Budget Development, Cost Accounting, Variance Analysis, Margin Analysis, Operational Metrics, ERP Structure, Process Improvement, Operational Efficiency, Cost Control, Strategic Planning, Leadership, Mentorship, Team Development, Strong Communication Skills, Analytical skills, Problem Solving and Operational Excellence.

Physical Requirements: Requires prolonged sitting and use of computer.

title: Machining/Tooling Engineer
description:
Position Summary

A Machining and Tooling Engineer designs, develops, and maintains manufacturing tools and fixtures. The M & T engineer is the subject matter expert in traditional and non-traditional machining. While optimizing production processes for efficiency and quality, they also lead R&D efforts to increase ACC capabilities for new business opportunities. They use CAD software to create blueprints, troubleshoot equipment, and collaborate with production teams to reduce downtime. This role typically requires strong mechanical knowledge and experience in machine shop environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Design & Development: Create or enhance tooling, fixtures, and molds (e.g., plastic injection, metal stamping) using CAD/AutoCAD to support production and prototyping.

• Process Optimization: Analyze and improve manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure high-quality, consistent output.

• Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair machinery/tools, providing solutions for technical issues during production.

• Fabrication & Maintenance: Oversee tool fabrication, maintain tool records, and establish preventative maintenance programs to minimize downtime.

• Collaboration & Vendor Management: Work with design teams and vendors to ensure tools meet specifications, often managing tool fabrication and validation.


Key Competencies

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in CAD/CAM software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD), understanding of material properties, and CNC programming.

• Machining Knowledge: Expertise in manual/CNC machining, metalworking, and tool repair.

• Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.

• Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot on the production floor.


Education and Experience

• Education: A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field is often preferred, though many positions accept an Associate degree in machine control technology or extensive experience.

• Experience: Usually requires 3-5+ years in a machine shop, tool and die shop, or manufacturing environment.

The successful candidate will possess experience in a manufacturing industry with increasing responsibilities in Engineering, Operations, and/or Research & Development. He/she will be responsible for bringing new product and processes to market on time and within budget. Strong focus on process improvement and waste elimination in their responsible areas working closely with Production, Engineering, Facilities, and Quality. He/she will apply techniques and processes, teach and mentor best practices (Lean, Six Sigma, DFM, DFA, DOE, FMEA, VA/VE, etc.).

Supervisory Responsibility

No


Work Environment

This job operates in both an office environment and a manufacturing environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment, such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. The individual will be required to adhere to safety policies and procedures on the manufacturing floor.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle or feel and reach with hands and arms.

The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 lbs and occasionally lift and or move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position, Monday through Friday 8am to 5pm, with additional hours as business needs necessitate.

Travel

Occasional travel may be required to support the rapid growth of the company

title: PRODUCTION CONTROL COORDINATOR
description:
We are currently looking for a Production Control Coordinator to support the Manufacturing Operations on and off the production floor in the Irvine, Ca facility. The Production Control Coordinator will be hands on in the Manufacturing Operations as well as the department administration process.


  • Request Batch Records according to lots scheduled for production via the Batch Record tracker.
  • Support manufacturing on the workflow of batch records between Manufacturing, IPQA, and QA, and other departments to ensure timely movement and closure of documentation.
  • Review batch records for Good Documentation Practices (GDP), ensure completeness, calculation accuracy, and free of documentation errors/omissions.
  • Assist Manufacturing personnel in correcting GDP errors and documentation discrepancies in accordance with company procedures.
  • Assist production planning activities by monitoring the progress on the floor and communicating any issues.
  • Support Manufacturing in verifying material consumption, issuance, and inventory transactions by comparing SAP/ERP records against batch documentation.
  • Assist with reconciliation activities related to inventory cards, batch documentation, and material usage records.
  • Generate and maintain production-related reports including labor utilization, production metrics, SAP transaction reports, KPI tracking, and operational summaries.
  • Coordinate office and production supply requests and maintain inventory of operational consumables through Kanban or other inventory control systems.
  • Assist with the development of OJT (On the Job Training) and provide support with SOP updates and revisions.
  • Assist with tracking of tooling, utensils, production supplies, and operational materials.
  • Participate in inventory counts, reconciliation activities, and operational audits as required.
  • Support proper disposition and coordination of rejected or obsolete materials in collaboration with QA and Warehouse departments.
  • Perform additional production support activities as assigned by Production Management.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) and/or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of manufacturing experience preferred in Oral Solid Dose Manufacturing (Tablets and Capsules) with combination floor and production control experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications such as Word, PowerPoint and Excel functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, filters, and data tracking are preferred.
  • Experience with SAP ERP system desire.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
  • Great organizational skills and attention to detail, desire
  • Bi-lingual (Spanish and English) desire

We do not offer relocation.

title: Opleidingsplaats Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ (VIOS)
description:
Wil jij doorgroeien als HBO-Verpleegkundige naar een zelfstandige, regio voerende rol in de GGZ? Dan is deze opleidingsplaats tot Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ iets voor jou!
Wij bieden opleidingsplaatsen aan bij Opleidingsinstelling GGZ-VS en bij de MANP GGZ bij Hogeschool Utrecht. We kijken samen met jou welke leerroute het beste past: 2 jaar of 3 jaar. Niet het papier is leidend, maar jouw ervaring, leervermogen en ambities.

Tweejarige opleidingsroute – start september 2026 (ca 3 opleidingsplaatsen)
Driejarige opleidingsroute – start januari 2027 (ca 6 opleidingsplaatsen)

Welke route het beste bij je past, bepalen we samen tijdens de selectieprocedure, waarbij de sollicitatiecommissie een bindend advies kan geven.

Wat ga je doen
Je wordt opgeleid om uiteindelijk als regiebehandelaar op te treden. Als volleerd VS-GGZ kun je klinisch redeneren en diagnosticeren, somatisch onderzoek doen en medicatie voorschrijven binnen het eigen deskundigheidsgebied.

Als Verpleegkundige-In-Opleiding-tot-Specialist (VIOS) werk je drie of drie-en-een- halve dag per week bij één van de specialismen van Arkin. Hierbij kun je denken aan het NPI, een FACT-team van Mentrum of bijvoorbeeld Jellinek. Bij het praktijkleren word je begeleid door een VS-GGZ, medisch specialist, en door de opleider VS-GGZ. Tijdens werktijd kan vier uur per week worden besteed aan praktijkopdrachten en supervisie. Het theoretische deel van de opleiding volg je 8 uur per week in Utrecht bij de betreffende opleidingsinstelling.

Na afronding van de opleiding heb jij de wettelijk beschermde beroepstitel Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ en de graad Master of Science.

Op het gebied van innovatie en onderzoek - op basis van evidence based practice - vervult de VS-GGZ een voortrekkersrol. Dit verbind je met directe patiëntenzorg, wat maakt dat je een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan kwaliteitsverbetering van deze zorg. Het geven van deskundigheidsbevordering en coaching aan andere professionals is ook één van de beroepsrollen.

Wij bieden jou

  • De opleiding duurt 2 of 3 jaar. Er wordt gekeken naar de best passende opleidingsplaats binnen één van de specialismen van Arkin. Bij de 2 jarige opleiding werk je op 2 afdelingen meestal binnen hetzelfde specialisme, bij de 3 jarige opleidng werk je elk jaar op een andere afdeling in een ander specialisme;·Volg je de driejarige opleiding dan krijg je een contract voor 36 uur per week; bij de tweejarige opleiding is dit een contract van 32 uur per week.
  • Je werkt 24 of 28 uur in de praktijk waaronder 4 uur vrij te besteden is aan zelfstudie/innovatie. Er is 8 uur beschikbaar voor het volgen van de theoretische lessen;
  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden en salaris zijn volgens de CAO GGZ schaal 55; (Min: € 4.000,- Max: € 5.294,-);
  • Arkin werkt voor de tweejarige opleiding samen met de MANP GGZ bij de Hogeschool Utrecht, met wekelijkse lesdagen op dinsdag. De opleiding start september 2026.
    Arkin werkt voor de driejarige opleidingsvariant samen met de GGZ VS, met verschillende lesdagen. De opleiding start 1 januari 2027.

Aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden Arkin:

  • Er is een actieve Vakgroep VS-GGZ (ca. 75 VS GGZ en VIOS), er worden interne geaccrediteerde scholingen geboden;
  • Er is voor afgestudeerde VS-GGZ een jaarlijks individueel scholingsbudget van €2000,- beschikbaar;
  • Je werklocatie hangt af van je opleidingsplaats. Deze zal zijn bij één van onze Arkin specialismen;
  • Een uitstekende OV-regeling woon-werkverkeer, collectieve zorgverzekering, fietsplan en een uitruilsysteem waarmee je bijvoorbeeld vakantiedagen kunt kopen/verkopen;
  • Je krijgt toegang tot Nrgize: een platform met allerlei sportieve activiteiten: van boksclinics, bootcamps tot windsurfen;
  • Je krijg onbeperkt toegang tot het online trainingsaanbod van Good Habitz.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent BIG-geregistreerd HBO- verpleegkundige of hebt de in-service B opleiding of MBO-V gevolgd aangevuld met een relevantie bachelor;
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in de GGZ (minimaal 0.8 FTE);
  • Een aantoonbaar bovengemiddeld functioneren als HBO-Verpleegkundige;
  • Je bent leergierig, reflectief en durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen;
  • Je wilt je langdurig verbinden aan de GGZ en investeren in verdieping;
  • Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal.

Twijfel je of je een 2- of 3-jarige opleiding aankunt? Geen probleem. Dat bepalen we samen, op basis van een zorgvuldig gesprek en jouw profiel.

Een assessment op HBO-master niveau kan onderdeel zijn van de toelating tot de opleiding.

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Heb jij interesse in deze mooie kans in jouw verpleegkundige carrière? Neem gerust contact op. Onze opleider VS-GGZ Elfi Rookhuizen informeert je graag over de instroomeisen, sollicitatieprocedure en opleiding. Zij is bereikbaar via 06-83223461.

description:

title: Sommelier - Part Time
description:
The Allison Inn & Spa is Oregon Wine Country's first full service luxury resort in the heart of the Willamette Valley. JORY is the signature restaurant at The Allison Inn & Spa. Our creative fine dining menus accentuate the native flavors of the Willamette Valley with a strong influence on seasonal, farm-to-table agriculture.

The JORY Sommelier is a very visible and prestigious position within the Willamette Valley winemaking community. You must have great excitement about the Oregon wine industry and be knowledgeable on local trends and developments. The importance of this role as a connection point between local wineries and our guests cannot be overstated. Your knowledge and passion for the wine industry and community must be continually nurtured so our guests and the JORY team may share in your excitement.

The Sommelier role is part of the JORY leadership and server teams. The role functions primarily as part of The Allison’s wine team and as a representative and steward of the wine program. Secondarily the Sommelier participates in JORY leadership and all aspects of service, helping to uphold The Allison’s exceptional hospitality.

This role requires you to possesses food and wine pairing skills and be able to work in collaboration with our Chefs. Additionally, you must enjoy educating, mentoring, and leading our Server team on proper wine service, descriptions, and sales techniques. You must have a passion for hospitality, people, wine, and food. We are currently recruiting for one (1) part time team member.

The Allison Inn & Spa Standards of Excellence

  • At all times, cultivate a welcoming environment for our guests: great guests with a smile, learn and use guest names, welcome returning guests
  • Thank guests and invite them to return
  • Consistently demonstrate teamwork – sharing workload responsibilities with a positive attitude
  • Maintain confidentiality: refrain from gossip, rumors or inappropriate workplace language
  • Interact professionally at all times with guests, suppliers and other team members
  • Support management business decisions
  • Learn and comply with The Allison Inn & Spa policies and procedures
  • Follows all safety policies and procedures

Duties and Responsibilities

During JORY Service Hours

  • Provide exceptional service to guests, with a special focus on fine wine and pairing wine with food.
  • Be present in the JORY dining room or lounge for the duration of dinner hours during appointed shifts.
  • Act as the primary sales person and server of all wines, in collaboration with the Server team.
  • Provide expert guidance and instruction about wine and wine service to the JORY staff so they may be better educated to sell wines to our guests.
  • Define and implement JORY wine service standards, ensuring these are consistent throughout the dining room and lounge. Provide training as needed.
  • Participate in general service by assisting Servers as needed, which may include but is not limited to food and beverage service, and clearing of tables.
  • Perform a daily quality audit of the open bottles of wines by the glass.
  • Keep a neat, groomed appearance as per The Allison guidelines.
  • Have an awareness and understanding of federal, state, and local regulations on the service of alcoholic beverages.

Outside of JORY Service Hours

  • Recommend and manage the implementation of promotions, displays, and other ideas within approved guidelines.
  • Perform daily restocking of the walk-in cooler, display cases, and wine storage areas.
  • Keep wine storage and display areas stocked and clean.
  • Maintain the function and accuracy of iPad wine lists, ensuring that the Tastevin/Slate app is syncing as needed, and that guided access is working correctly.
  • Perform a weekly inventory audit of the by the glass wines.
  • When appointed, lead guided tasting experiences for guests or staff, and provide wine service for special events.
  • Monitor the maintenance and sanitation of various outlets and equipment to protect the assets, comply with regulations, and ensure a safe work environment. Report concerns and issues to the Wine Director.
  • Any additional duties assigned by management

OTHER DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES
Promote accident prevention to minimize occurrences of accidents.
Perform special projects and additional responsibilities as assigned.

Job Skills/Requirements/Qualifications

  • Great communication skills and the ability to work well and communicate effectively with managers and other departments
  • Excellent fine wine sales skills
  • Ability to provide upscale food & wine service
  • Ability to plan and execute wine pairings for guests on demand
  • General knowledge of global fine wine, and specific knowledge of Oregon wine
  • Certification or education achievement in wine
  • Ability to educate staff on wine and wine service
  • Ability to conduct training sessions in front of groups of 15+ people
  • Create tasting notes & selling points for major wines on the list
  • Respectful interaction with members of the local wine industry wine trade
  • Ability to collaborate with guests on Chef’s Table reservations
  • Ability to manage items Silverware and to perform inventory searches in BinScan

title: People Business Partner - UK (12-Month FTC / Maternity Cover)
description:
Who we are?

Silverfin is a cutting-edge cloud software solution built by accountants, for accountants.

Founded in 2013, Silverfin was created to solve the frustrations of manual, error-prone processes in analysing financial data and compliance. From day one, we’ve been a cloud-first platform with an open API architecture, leveraging structured data to transform how accountants work.

Our mission is simple: to enhance and support the accountancy profession through AI and automation, ensuring accountants remain relevant and respected in the future of finance.

In 2023, Silverfin became part of the Visma Group, joining one of Europe’s leading providers of cloud software. This partnership strengthens our ability to innovate and expand our impact within the accountancy industry.

Today, Silverfin is trusted by over +1000 firms across 18 countries. Our clients include all of the Big 4 accounting firms, as well as leading global networks like BDO, PKF, Baker Tilly, Grant Thornton, and Moore.

Headquartered in Ghent, with offices in London, Luxembourg, Gouda (NL), and Mont-Saint-Guibert (BE), we’re a team of over 200 people - including a diverse remote engineering team working across multiple time zones - all working together to drive innovation in accounting.

How would you support our success?

Ellen, our People Business Partner for the UK, will be on maternity leave for around a year, and we're looking for an experienced People Business Partner to step into her role for the duration of her leave, starting early January 2027 and running until end of January 2028, with a short handover overlap with Ellen at both ends of the assignment. This role can be offered either as a 12-month fixed-term employee contract or as a freelance/interim engagement, depending on what suits you best.

You'll be the People Business Partner for BU UK, and for our Technology (Engineering, DevOps and Business Solutions) and Product departments, partnering closely with their leaders and managers on people topics and workforce planning. As the only HR representative based in the UK, you'll also be the go-to point of contact for HR-related questions from across the UK business more broadly – in practice the role carries a somewhat more generalist flavour than the title suggests, even though that's not the intention behind it.

You'll also pick up the HR programmes Ellen runs: Peakon (our engagement survey) will be your responsibility to manage end-to-end. DEI, Health & Wellbeing and Culture Champs will mainly be managed by Isaline, our Workplace & Culture Manager, over this period, though you'll stay aligned to these topics as they intersect with your day-to-day partnering.

Alongside your day-to-day partnering, you'll partner on a number of projects:

  • Helping organise our Leadership Days.

  • Organising AI impact workshops with departments across the business, to help support our AI transformation.

  • Supporting the broader transformation underway in Technology and Product, as new ways of working reshape roles and skills needs – helping teams through those changes with attentiveness and clarity.

  • Helping us make better use of HR data, so we can have more meaningful, informed conversations with our business stakeholders.

You'll be part of an international People team, working closely with the People Business Partner in Belgium, and will report directly to the Head of People. As you'll be the only HR presence in the UK day-to-day, you'll need to be comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy, and willing to travel to Belgium roughly once a quarter to stay in touch with the wider People team.

Your responsibilities

  • Cross-functional Partnership:
    Serve as a trusted advisor to managers, offering expert guidance on people strategy, organisational design, and workforce planning. Build solid, cooperative relationships to improve morale, boost productivity, and enhance employee retention, while identifying opportunities in advance and addressing issues.

  • Change & Transformation Support:
    Support Technology and Product managers through a period of change, contributing to conversations on team structures, role changes and reskilling needs, and helping communicate change clearly and constructively to teams.

  • Employee Lifecycle Management:
    Guide and support managers throughout the employee journey, from onboarding to offboarding. Promote performance management and talent development practices while coaching managers to strengthen their people management capabilities. At Silverfin, we believe that empowering people managers to become the best versions of themselves is integral to our strategy for building the company’s success.

  • Talent & Performance Management:
    Build a culture of feedback and professional growth. Oversee biannual performance review cycles to ensure a structured, effective approach to employee development. Deliver tailored training for people managers to enhance their ability to provide constructive feedback and hold meaningful career conversations. Promote the use of tools available to prompt employees to actively plan and advance their career paths.

  • Engagement (Peakon):
    Manage the Peakon engagement survey programme end-to-end – running survey cycles, analysing results, and partnering with senior stakeholders on follow-up actions and deep-dive reviews.

  • DEI, Health & Wellbeing and Culture Champs:
    Stay aligned to these programmes, which will mainly be managed by our Workplace & Culture Manager during this period, ensuring alignment with your client groups where relevant.

  • HR Generalist & Employee Relations Support:
    As the primary HR point of contact in the UK, respond to day-to-day HR questions across the business. Across stakeholder groups, coach and support managers through employee relations casework - performance issues, disciplinary processes, workplace adjustments, and other sensitive situations. You’ll also be the go-to source of UK employment law expertise for the wider People team on any case that needs it.

  • HR Data & Reporting: Help improve how we use HR data, turning it into insights that support more meaningful conversations with business stakeholders.
    Key Projects: Help organise our Leadership Days, run AI impact workshops with departments across the business, and support the ongoing transformation in Technology and Product.

  • Compensation & Benefits:
    Advise managers on compensation matters, including salary reviews, bonuses, and benefits. Partner with the C&B manager to refine frameworks that balance employee satisfaction with business goals.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership:
    Partner with People, Finance, and other teams to streamline processes and enhance the employee experience. Work closely with managers to align people solutions with current and future business priorities, ensuring a cohesive and effective approach.

What would success look like?

Success in this role means keeping the People Business Partner function for the UK running smoothly during Ellen's maternity leave, while helping Technology and Product navigate a period of change with clarity and attentiveness, and moving the Leadership Days, AI impact workshops and HR data projects forward. We'll measure impact through indicators like employee engagement and how well-resourced people managers and employees feel – not just to meet benchmarks, but to keep the UK a genuinely great place to work throughout the year.

What will support our success?

Experience and Qualifications


  • Over 5 years of experience as an HR professional, including solid experience as a People Business Partner, ideally gained in a scale-up or fast-paced Tech/SaaS environment.

  • Demonstrated success across key HR functions, including performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, and offboarding.

  • Some experience supporting organisational change (e.g. team restructuring, role changes, reskilling) is a solid plus, ideally in a technology or product environment.

  • Comfortable using HR data to inform decisions and support conversations with stakeholders.

  • Experienced in working in an international context, with a working knowledge of UK employment practices.

  • Comfortable working as the sole HR presence in a location, acting as a generalist point of contact beyond your core client groups when needed.

  • Able to work with a high degree of autonomy and take responsibility, with willingness to travel to Belgium roughly once a quarter.

  • Available for a 12-month assignment starting early January 2027 through end of January 2028.

Skills and knowledge


  • Solid coaching and advisory skills to support and develop people managers.

  • Good grasp of change management, and comfortable partnering with stakeholders on this.

  • Comfortable working with HR data and turning it into useful insights.

  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills.

  • Ability to run and deliver cross-functional HR projects effectively, autonomously and with limited local support.

  • Good stakeholder management skills to balance diverse needs, build credibility, and align people topics with business priorities.

  • High interpersonal awareness (EQ) and the ability to navigate sensitive conversations, including around role change.

  • Solid problem-solving skills to work through people issues with capability and attentiveness.

  • Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day, and open to experimenting with new ways of applying AI in your workflows.

Attitude and personality-related traits

  • Hands-on and pragmatic, comfortable rolling up your sleeves.

  • Brings new ideas and can work with a high degree of autonomy, with minimal onboarding time.

  • Communicative, and quick to build trust and credibility with managers and teams.

  • Excellent judgement, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive matters with attentiveness.

  • Adaptability and steadiness – comfortable stepping into an ongoing role and juggling multiple priorities from day one.

  • Acts as an ambassador for Silverfin, embodying our culture and living our values throughout the assignment.

We care for you

  • Be part of something bigger - Join a growing SaaS company that’s now proudly part of Visma, Europe’s leader in mission-critical cloud software.

  • A connected team, wherever you are - Take part in regular team activities, retreats, and offsites to keep our culture thriving.

  • Grow with us - Take advantage of career development opportunities and a personal training allowance to support your growth.

  • Time to recharge - Enjoy our company-wide Wellbeing Days off each month (for employees on payroll - reviewed annually).

  • Fair compensation - Receive a competitive rewards package with benefits tailored to your role.

  • Flexibility with connection - We have a hybrid setup, with a minimum of two days a week in the office. However, we understand that life can be unpredictable, so we offer flexibility to accommodate unexpected events. Our offices in Belgium (Ghent and Mont-Saint-Guibert), the UK (London), the Netherlands (Gouda), and Luxembourg provide great spaces to collaborate and connect.

title: Director, Supply Chain Operations
location: Primary Kids Inc, New York, NY, US
description:
About the Role

Primary is looking for a Director of Supply Chain Operations to lead our logistics strategy and manage our inbound freight operations end-to-end—from purchase order release all the way through to domestic warehouse delivery.

In this role, you will act as both a strategic planner and an operational builder. You’ll protect the business against global supply chain volatility, scale our wholesale infrastructure, and mentor a high-performing team. You'll help make sure product lands on time, at the right cost, and with the visibility our internal and external partners need to plan and scale with confidence. This is a fully remote role (the Primary team operates on US East Coast Time).

What You'll Do

  • Drive Inbound Freight Strategy: Own end-to-end inbound logistics. Negotiate with and manage freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers using clear performance metrics to optimize transit times, service levels, and landed costs.

  • Mitigate Global Supply Chain Risk: Serve as our expert on global supply chain trends. Anticipate port conditions, tariff changes, capacity constraints, and geopolitical shifts, building practical risk-mitigation strategies to prevent business disruption.

  • Scale Wholesale Expansion: Lead the operational readiness for wholesale growth—overseeing overseas vendor preparation, EDI/systems development, and process alignment to onboard new wholesale partners smoothly.

  • Optimize Data & KPI Visibility: Establish vendor scorecards, internal reporting, and monthly cross-functional reviews that provide clear ongoing visibility into freight performance, cost metrics, and compliance risk.

  • Guide Vendor Compliance: Own vendor routing and packing guidelines, partnering across Operations to enforce compliance and manage reporting or chargeback processes when necessary.

  • Budget & Financial Planning: Partner with the VP of Operations to set departmental goals, forecast inbound freight costs, and manage operational P&L planning.

  • Lead & Mentor the Team: Direct and develop the Supply Chain Operations team (including managing our Senior Supply Chain Manager), nurturing talent, removing manual process friction, and building modern operational capacity.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven Supply Chain Leadership: Extensive background directing inbound freight strategy, carrier/forwarder negotiations, and vendor operations from purchase order to final delivery.

  • Wholesale Operational Expertise: Experience preparing vendors, integrating EDI systems, and building operational frameworks to launch and scale wholesale partnerships.

  • Global Compliance & Risk Savvy: Deep understanding of macro logistics trends, duty/tariff risk, and direct experience working with U.S. Customs and Border Protection on compliance and clearance issues.

  • Data-Driven & Systems Mindset: Skilled at establishing operational KPIs, building cost forecasting models, and streamlining manual reporting. Experience with NetSuite or modern AI productivity tools (like Claude) is a plus.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: A natural communicator who builds strong working partnerships across Sourcing, Merchandising, Planning, and external vendors.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 to 12 months, we anticipate that you will likely:

  • Streamline Internal Workflows: Audit current process flows, transit tracking, and communication channels to eliminate manual overhead and speed up data delivery.

  • Elevate Partner Accountability: Establish forwarder and vendor scorecards and launch regular business reviews to measurably reduce transit times and landed costs.

  • Build Predictive Cost Models: Implement an accurate forecasting model for inbound freight costs to support company-wide P&L planning.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Form tight working partnerships across Sourcing, Merchandising, and Planning to ensure seamless operational visibility.

  • Set the 2027 Roadmap: Co-create the department’s long-term operational strategy and annual goals alongside the VP of Operations.

What We Offer

We want our team to feel supported, valued, and able to thrive — at work and beyond. Our benefits include:

  • 4-day work weeks (for most roles, Fridays are flexible)

  • Generous time off (3-4 weeks of PTO, unlimited sick time, 10 holidays + winter break) and leave options (including 12 weeks fully paid for all new parents)

  • Multiple medical, dental, vision, and pre-tax accounts

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Perks like an employee discount, monthly learning (or gym) stipend, home-office reimbursement, and manager team-building fund

  • A kind, colorful, and collaborative culture


Ready to Apply?

We’re excited to grow our team with people who share our curiosity, care, and creativity. At Primary, we believe great work happens when everyone feels seen, supported, and free to bring their full selves — just like the kids we design for.


We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace that welcomes diverse perspectives and experiences. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out to recruiting@primary.com. We partner with Disclo, a secure third-party platform, to make the process simple and confidential.


If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you - visit our careers page to learn more.
