title: Sr Data Warehouse Architect
description:
The Senior Data Warehouse Architect will lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise data warehouse solutions that support critical business intelligence and analytics needs. This role requires deep technical expertise in modern cloud data platforms and the ability to architect scalable, performant data solutions that serve diverse analytical requirements across the organization. The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence with strong collaboration skills and a commitment to delivering high-quality, reliable data solutions.


Job Responsibilities

  • Data Warehouse Architecture: Design and implement dimensional models, data vault structures, and other architectural patterns optimized for analytical workloads. Define data integration patterns, data flow architectures, and transformation strategies that balance performance, maintainability, and flexibility. Lead the architectural evolution of the enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake.

  • ETL/ELT Development and Optimization: Architect and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using modern tools like Coalesce and Wherescape. Design efficient data transformation logic including complex recursive CTEs, hierarchical data structures, and performance-critical queries. Establish patterns for handling slowly changing dimensions, data historization, and temporal data.

  • Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize query performance, implement appropriate clustering strategies, and design efficient data structures. Monitor warehouse performance metrics and implement solutions for query optimization, resource management, and cost efficiency. Establish best practices for performance tuning across the analytics stack

  • Data Integration: Lead integration efforts across source systems including policy management systems (Atlas, AMS360), CRM platforms, quoting applications, call center systems, and financial systems. Design robust data pipelines that handle various data formats, frequencies, and quality challenges. Architect solutions for real-time and batch data integration needs.

  • Platform Migration Leadership: Lead technical aspects of platform migrations and modernization initiatives. Develop migration strategies that minimize business disruption while improving capabilities. Conduct proof-of-value assessments for new technologies and platforms.

  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical mentorship to data engineers and analysts. Establish architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices for the BI&A team. Conduct design reviews and provide technical guidance on complex data challenges. Collaborate with stakeholders across Retail Operations and Supporting Operations Departments to understand analytical requirements and translate them into technical solutions


Requirements

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in data warehousing with at least 3 years in architectural roles.
  • Background in data migration projects and platform modernization initiatives
  • Familiarity with additional data integration tools and technologies


Scholarship:

  • University/College
  • Master's Degree


Specialized knowledge:

  • Proven track record of designing and implementing enterprise-scale data warehouse solutions
  • Experience in insurance industry with knowledge of policy systems, commission structures, and industry-specific data challenges


Computer knowledge:

  • Expert-level SQL skills including advanced optimization techniques, recursive CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning
  • Deep experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms (Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks)
  • Experience with BI and analytics tools (Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and metadata management
  • Experience with Python or other programming languages for data engineering
  • Knowledge of DataOps practices, CI/CD for data pipelines, and infrastructure as code
  • Understanding of FinOps principles for cloud data warehouse cost optimization
  • Experience with customer data platforms, CRM systems, and marketing analytics

English level:
  • Advanced (C1)


Benefits

  • Private Health Insurance.
  • Life Insurance.
  • Saving Funds and Voluntary Savings Account.
  • Profit Sharing (PTU).
  • Vacation Days (above law).
  • Christmas bonus.
  • Vacation premium.

title: Associate Director
description:

title: Plant Operator 1
description:
JOB SUMMARY/PURPOSE

Primary functions of the operator include but are not limited to being responsible for the safe and efficient operation of plant mining and processing equipment and effectively monitor all equipment.

  • Ensure all MSHA and HSEQ procedures and policies are implemented and followed.

  • Communicate with other plant operators and Quality Technicians.
  • Operate front-end loader and haul trucks to move screenings, waste or product as needed.
  • Work with maintenance to keep plants at high physical availability.
  • Perform level 1 plant maintenance duties as required during shutdowns.
  • Complete pre-shift inspections on mobile equipment.
  • Work with Plant Operations Lead Person (OLP) for proper utilization of resources, work assignments and daily tasks.
  • Collect, process, and perform tests on process samples.
  • Sort ore on sorting belt
  • Perform housekeeping duties and operate cleanup equipment, such as skid steers and plant vacuum.
  • May be temporarily assigned to other shifts or mining locations to facilitate training, work schedule, downtime and work assignment.
  • Perform other tasks assigned by Plant Supervisor or OLP.

Knowledge, skills, abilities and other characteristics:

  • Ability to perform a safety risk assessment before performing any task
  • Ability to perform work in adverse weather conditions
  • Experience working under MSHA rules and regulations preferred
  • Experience operating front-end loader, haul-truck and other mining equipment
  • Process plant knowledge and operating experience highly desired.
  • Computer experience a plus.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Education and Experience requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • One or more years operator experience, preferably in mining/milling or industrial environment.

NOTE

The requirements and responsibilities contained in this job description do not create a contract of employment and are not meant to be all-inclusive. They may be changed by the role manager during employment on an as-needed basis.

title: Project Controller
description:
Geronimo Power develops, owns and operates large-scale power assets throughout America’s Heartland, including solar, wind and energy storage. SUMMARY OF THE POSITION

As a Project Controller at Geronimo Power, you will play a pivotal role in supporting multiple projects with budgets ranging from $1 million to $4 billion, focusing on accounting and finance-related functions. This position is particularly critical as Project Controllers are often assigned to significant projects, typically those exceeding $200 million. In this capacity, you will act as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and trusted advisor to Project Delivery Team and Executive Management, providing them with meaningful insights and accurate analyses to facilitate informed decision-making. Your primary responsibilities will include managing and developing the careers of business team members, establishing trust and credibility with upper-level management, and ensuring effective communication across various departments. The role demands strong leadership skills, a relentless ambition for continuous improvement, and polished technical and soft skills.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Analyzes and effectively communicates financial results of the project to upper-level management

Earns trust, credibility, and buy-in of processes from project delivery team to create better cohesion and clear communication within the organization

Understands financial reporting, including the upstream effects of reporting to other areas of the organization

Drives continuous improvement throughout the organization and is a proponent for positive change

Effectively utilizes the right data, reports, and tools for risk analysis and benchmarking

Reviews all project and estimate cash flows, contract terms, and change orders in detail for financial risks and opportunities

Recognizes when and who to escalate specific conversations/issues

Understands, substantiates, and reconciles all financial reports monthly and annually

Creates an inviting workplace that motivates and challenges each team member to achieve career goals and strives for opportunities

Understands the needs of the organization, aims to bring in high quality talent, and continually develops team members through critical conversations and performance reviews

Monitors results of new processes, troubleshoots, failures and issues, and presents solutions to unsolicited problems

WHAT YOU BRING TO THIS ROLE

5-10 years of financial/data analysis or public accounting experience

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, and/or an equivalent degree is required

Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel

Effective communication (both oral and written), organization, and interpersonal skills

Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills

Ability to balance multiple tasks and responsibilities

High level of professionalism and standards

Managerial experience

Must be able to freely access all parts of a construction site in wide-ranging climates and environments

Ability to work in the United States without sponsorship, both now and in the future

We offer a comprehensive benefit package, including Medical, Dental, 401(k) and disability benefits.

title: Systeemspecialist treinbeveiliging buitenelementen
description:
De bestaande treinbeveiligingssystemen presteren optimaal door jou.

Werk om trots op te zijn

De ambitie om de capaciteit op het Nederlandse spoor te vergroten, realiseren we in nieuwe en bestaande systemen. Als systeemspecialist buitenelementen bij treinbeveiliging draag je bij aan de systeemprestaties en ontwikkeling van diverse bestaande en nieuwe systemen. De focus ligt hierbij op de diverse buitenelementen, zoals seinen, wisselsturing, aardfoutdetectie en relaiskasten. Je wordt de kennisdrager van verschillende systemen. Dit doe je niet alleen, maar samen met jouw collega systeemspecialisten, in samenwerking met de systeemmanager, gebruikers, stakeholders en leveranciers. Daarnaast houd jij je onder andere bezig met:

  • Zorgdragen dat ontwerp- en onderhoudsvoorschriften van jouw systemen up to date zijn.
  • Bijdragen en begeleiden van het ontwikkelproces voor gewijzigde en nieuwe systemen.
  • Het leveren van een belangrijke bijdrage in het beheer van de verschillende buitenelementen.
  • Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor in- en externe gebruikers in het bedenken en implementeren van gewenste functionaliteiten van jouw systemen.
  • Je ondersteunt op verzoek bij het oplossen van complexe storingen.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als systeemspecialist buitenelementen is er plek in ons team Assetmanagement Techniek en Systeemmanagement. Je werkt op de afdeling Treinbeveiliging Lokale Systemen. Deze afdeling houdt zich bezig met bestaande en toekomstige treinbeveiligingssystemen op het Nederlandse spoornet. Zowel het in stand houden van operationele systemen als het optimaliseren ervan.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.091,- en € 7.262,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 9. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring kan je ook ingedeeld worden in schaal 8.

  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • 170 vakantie-uren én de optie om tot 185 extra vakantie-uren bij te kopen vanuit jouw IKB.
  • Een NS-Business Card met Treinvrij (en een NS-Businesscard Daluren voor directe gezinsleden). Of een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer per dag.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen. Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Een afgeronde technische wo-opleiding of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met het spoor en vindt het leuk om specialist te worden op component of systeemniveau.
  • Kennis van treinbeveiligingssystemen en aantoonbare werkervaring of een vergelijkbaar domein is een pre.
  • Analytisch denken / Probleemoplossend vermogen: Je ordent informatie, legt verbanden en vindt oplossingen voor ingewikkelde vragen.
  • Initiatief: Je herkent kansen, speelt er snel en doeltreffend op in en bent resultaatgericht.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als systeemspecialist treinbeveiliging buitenelementen werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer vóór 20 september. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Steven de Jong via steven.dejong@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Bas Lokker via bas.lokker@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie. De gesprekken vinden plaats in de week van 28 september. Uitgenodigd voor een vervolggesprek? Dan vragen we je mogelijk thuis een online assessment te maken als aanvulling op je cv en motivatie. Een referentiecheck is mogelijk onderdeel van deze procedure.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

title: CREDIT ANALYST
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Credit Appraisal & Analysis

  • Analyze loan applications for completeness and compliance with lending requirements.
  • Conduct financial analysis of customers including:
    • Income assessment
    • Cash flow analysis
    • Debt service capacity
    • Business performance analysis
  • Review customer bank statements, financial statements, and supporting documents.
  • Assess customer repayment ability and identify key credit risks.
  • Prepare detailed credit appraisal reports and recommendations.
  • Verify collateral valuation and adequacy.


B. Customer Due Diligence

  • Conduct Know Your Customer (KYC) and customer verification checks.
  • Review customer credit history from Credit Reference Bureaus (CRB).
  • Perform background checks on borrowers and guarantors.
  • Conduct site visits and business assessments where required.
  • Identify early warning signs and suspicious transactions.


C. Portfolio Monitoring

  • Monitor performance of approved facilities.
  • Track overdue accounts and identify potential problem loans.
  • Support periodic loan reviews and portfolio quality assessments.
  • Monitor covenant compliance and facility conditions.
  • Assist in monitoring Portfolio at Risk (PAR) indicators.


D. Documentation & Compliance

  • Ensure loan files contain complete and properly approved documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • Bank Credit Policy
    • Bank of Tanzania regulations
    • AML/CFT requirements
    • Internal lending procedures
  • Maintain proper credit records and filing systems.
  • Ensure conditions precedent are fulfilled before disbursement.


E. Reporting & MIS

  • Prepare periodic credit analysis and portfolio reports.
  • Maintain accurate customer and facility information in the Core Banking System.
  • Support preparation of:
    • Disbursement reports
    • PAR reports
    • Sector exposure analysis
    • Credit committee papers
  • Assist Finance and Risk departments during audits and reviews.


F. Credit Committee Support

  • Prepare loan proposals for Credit Committee review.
  • Present findings and recommendations during credit discussions where required.
  • Track approved conditions and follow-up actions.


Requirements

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Quality and accuracy of credit appraisal reports
  • Loan turnaround time (TAT)
  • Portfolio quality of analyzed accounts
  • PAR and delinquency levels within assigned portfolio
  • Compliance with Credit Policy and procedures
  • Number of documentation exceptions
  • Timely submission of reports


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, CFA, etc.) is an added advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 2–4 years’ experience in credit analysis, lending, or banking operations.
  • Experience in microfinance or SME lending is an added advantage.
  • Familiarity with financial statement analysis and credit risk assessment.
  • Experience using Core Banking Systems and Microsoft Excel.


COMPETENCIES

  • Strong financial analysis skills
  • Credit risk assessment capability
  • Attention to detail
  • Report writing and presentation skills
  • Good understanding of lending principles
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Integrity and confidentiality
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

title: Move to Australia as a Speech Pathologist- Graduate and Experienced
description:
Thinking of making a move to Australia? We want you! You can move to trendy Melbourne or sunny Brisbane!


Connect2Care started as a passion for two physiotherapists and has now become one of the fastest-growing allied health companies in Australia, with services nationwide. As a registered NDIS health provider, Connect2Care provides a range of community-based, allied health services to people of all ages and of all abilities.

Growing every day, with opportunities bubbling at every corner, Connect2Care is invested in delivering best-practice therapy to its clients. We also want to ensure their therapists feel satisfied and motivated to come to work every day.

Our team is a beautiful group of like-minded individuals working together to fulfill the same mission; to empower people to reach their personal goals.


Location: All C2C Service locations around Australia

Salary: Banding $79,499 to $96,400 + Super

Occupations: Positions available for Occupational therapists, Speech Pathologists and Psychologists


The Role

As a therapist at Connect2Care, you will be joining a multidisciplinary team. You will provide evidence-based services to people through multiple service delivery models, including telehealth, community visits and centre-based services. Referrals may come through the NDIS, Medicare or privately. It is a mobile role, with the option to work from home or our hubs when not seeing clients. The role will involve the following:

  • Assessing and providing interventions for children & adults living with a range of disabilities
  • Working within the NDIS to maximise clients' level of function, capacity & social engagement
  • Assisting clients with assistive technology assessment, recommendations and applications (in relevant fields)
  • Timely documentation & report writing
  • Managing a varied caseload
  • Meeting company professional expectations (e.g. meeting billables & effective client management)
  • Attending meetings, supervision & personal development (as required)
  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, including therapists, clients, & referral sources
  • Working across leading software platforms & online tools


The New Grad Program

Connect2Care has developed and specifically tailored a New Graduate Program to make the transition smoother for new graduates entering the workplace. The program fully supports recent graduates, enabling them to acquire the skills needed to launch them into a successful career. Spanning over 12 months and starting from the moment you step through our doors.

What you can expect:

  • Comprehensive induction week
  • Weekly 1:1 supervision with your supervisor
  • Core competency skills training sessions
  • Fortnightly group mentoring sessions
  • Mental health drop in sessions
  • Internal PD sessions
  • Shadowing opportunities with experienced clinicians
  • Opportunity to learn & be supported by senior clinicians within multidisciplinary teams

Connect2Care is fortunate to be surrounded by a wealth of knowledge, with each staff member bringing different and unique learning experiences to the company. As we have over 100 therapists, with some having specialties in certain areas of clinical practice, you will have the opportunity to expand your knowledge and learn from the best.



Requirements

To apply for the role, you will need to have or be able to obtain the following:

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in related field
  • Discipline-specific professional registration (e.g. AHPRA/SPA)
  • Working with Children Check (WWCC or Blue Card)
  • NDIS Worker Screening Check
  • Police Check & International Police Check (only applicable to individuals who have lived overseas)
  • Drivers licence & access to a reliable vehicle
  • Car insurance
  • Professional Indemnity & Public Liability insurance

As part of your role, you will be working with children, people with disability, the elderly, and people who are vulnerable. We are committed to safety, including those of children. We have zero tolerance for abuse.



Benefits

Connect2Care fiercely believes that happiness is the key to success. Knowing this, we place significant value on an exceptional work culture and a healthy work-life balance, hoping that our therapists love what they do!

Additional benefits of working at Connect2Care include:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Achievable KPI bonuses
  • Loyalty bonuses
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Benefits, discounts & rewards with premier retail & service partners
  • Clearly defined career progression opportunities
  • Comprehensive New Graduate Program
  • Professional Development allowance
  • Paid study leave
  • Annual leave loading included
  • Laptop & mobile phone
  • Social events, team building & well-being activities
  • Opportunities to live & base yourself almost anywhere in Australia
  • Unlimited drinks & snacks in all our hubs
  • Access to a library of online resources & assessment tools


The Application Process

If you think you would be a good fit at Connect2Care, we would love to hear from you! To view and apply for a role at Connect2Care, please visit

Alternatively, if you would like to have a private and confidential conversation with someone from our Recruitment Team, please call 1800 950 288.

title: Clinical Reviewer
description:
Are you passionate about improving access to behavioral health services in the community? Do you enjoy using your clinical expertise to evaluate needs, support care decisions, and help individuals receive the right services at the right time?

In this role, you will review clinical documentation to determine medical necessity and appropriateness of services, complete functional needs assessments that evaluate how mental health symptoms impact daily living, and support service coordination that connects children, youth, and adults to in-home and community-based care. You will manage referrals, follow-ups, reviews, and assessments within an electronic medical record system; apply evidence-based criteria to utilization management reviews; document clinical determinations; provide subject matter expertise to stakeholders; support quality activities and audits; and travel for in-person assessments as needed across your assigned region.

If you are someone who demonstrates strong clinical judgment, builds trusting relationships with members and partners, and effectively manages a high-volume workload while meeting timelines, we encourage you to apply. If you bring a collaborative mindset, accountability in your work, curiosity to ask questions and learn, and comfort using technology to navigate systems and documentation, you will be well-positioned for success on this team. This is a remote position based in Oregon and travel is required.


Why Comagine Health?

Comagine Health is a national, mission-driven, nonprofit organization that has engaged in health care quality consulting and quality improvement services for more than 50 years.

We are leaders in assisting front-line providers and engaging health care partners to improve care delivery and patient outcomes.

Our talented remote workforce spans the country and plays a vital role in our success. We go beyond merely providing a remote work option; we support and embrace it. We offer opportunities to make a difference from anywhere in the U.S. and enjoy better work-life balance. An annual stipend gives you the freedom to enhance your workspace with options that suit your needs.

We believe in an environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. That’s why we offer benefits that include:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Paid time off for vacation, illness, and volunteering
  • Retirement savings plan with employer contribution
  • Adoption financial assistance
  • Paid parental leave.
  • And much more!


You Have (Required Qualifications)

  • Current, active, unrestricted clinical licensure as required by the Oregon contract (e.g., RN or behavioral health licensure such as LCSW, LPC, LCPC, LPA, PsyD, PhD)
  • Master's in physical or occupational therapy OR Master's in psychology, counseling, or social work OR Bachelor’s degree in nursing and licensed by the State of Oregon
  • 3 years of clinical (direct patient care) experience; behavioral health preferred

Candidates must reside in Oregon, have personal transportation, and ability to travel. Valid Driver License and Proof of Auto Insurance are required.


You May Have (Desired Qualifications)

  • Experience with Medicaid
  • Knowledge of the Oregon behavioral health system of care
  • 2 years of utilization review or other medical management experience
  • 2 years of full-time substance use disorder and/or behavioral health disorder experience


You Bring (Competencies)

  • Clinical documentation review expertise, including use of the Oregon Health Plan Prioritized List of Health Services and InterQual
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a team environment
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite and familiarity with database software
  • Ability to apply clinical review criteria, policies, and guidelines to determine medical necessity
  • Ability to document utilization review determinations accurately and timely in designated systems
  • Capability to provide clinical and utilization review subject matter expertise and respond to stakeholder questions or concerns


In this Role, You Will

  • Review clinical documentation to substantiate medical necessity and appropriateness for requested services
  • Perform initial and continued stay reviews using standardized, evidence-based criteria to ensure services align with individualized behavioral health needs
  • Apply clinical review criteria, organizational policies, guidelines, and screening tools to determine medical necessity of healthcare services
  • Document utilization review determinations accurately and timely in designated systems
  • Consult with physician or practitioner reviewers when cases do not meet clinical review criteria
  • Refer cases to other clinicians when appropriate
  • Provide clinical and utilization review subject matter expertise and respond to stakeholder questions or concerns
  • Support quality assurance activities, audits, and other program support as assigned
  • Provide guidance or oversight to non-clinical staff performing support activities, as appropriate
  • Perform other duties as assigned


Work Environment

  • Full-Time
  • 100% Remote (Oregon)
  • Travel required
  • Reliable, secure internet connection required
  • Must maintain licensure eligibility for assigned state contract


Equal Opportunity Employer
Comagine Health is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

This position is primarily remote and performed in a home-based setting, requiring reliable internet access and a workspace free from significant distractions. The role involves frequent use of computers, phones, and virtual communication tools. Employees must be able to sit for extended periods, communicate effectively.

Some positions may require operating a motor vehicle for business purposes; in such cases, employees must maintain a valid driver’s license and meet the organization’s driving eligibility requirements. Occasional travel may be required for meetings, training, or other work-related events.

Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

title: Compensation & People Analytics Analyst
description:
Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.


About the role

This position is responsible for developing Power BI dashboards, maintaining compensation and incentive reporting, administering commission and bonus calculations, and providing analytical insights that support compensation decisions across the organization.
Working closely with the Compensation Director, Finance, Payroll, HRIS, and business leaders, this role helps ensure compensation programs are administered accurately, efficiently, and consistently while leveraging data to improve decision-making and operational effectiveness.
This position is ideal for an analytical professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, automation, and continuous process improvement.
Location: This position may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America or may work hybrid from our Dublin, Ohio location.

Compensation Administration

Calculate commissions, quarterly incentives, and bonus payouts while ensuring accuracy and compliance with plan documents.
Audit compensation data and resolve discrepancies before payroll processing.
Partner with Payroll to validate compensation-related payments.
Support market pricing activities and compensation analysis.
Maintain compensation documentation, templates, and reporting.
People Analytics & Reporting
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards for compensation, workforce, and HR metrics.
Develop automated reporting that improves visibility into workforce trends and compensation programs.
Analyze workforce, compensation, and incentive data to identify trends and provide actionable insights.
Create recurring executive reports supporting HR and business leadership.
Ensure data integrity across HRIS, payroll, and reporting systems.
Incentive & Variable Pay Administration
Administer monthly, quarterly, and annual commission and bonus calculations.
Validate performance data supporting incentive payments.
Partner with Finance and business leaders to reconcile payout calculations.
Maintain incentive tracking files and reporting.
Support annual plan updates and testing.
Process Improvement & Automation
Identify opportunities to automate manual compensation and reporting processes.
Improve reporting accuracy through Power BI and HRIS enhancements.
Document compensation administration procedures and reporting processes.
Partner with HRIS to improve workflows and reporting capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives across Total Rewards.
Other duties as assigned
What you’ll bring (Qualifications)
Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Analytics, Data Science, or related field.
Experience: 3–5 years of experience in compensation, HR analytics, finance, payroll, or business analytics.
Strong Excel skills including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, and complex formulas.
Advanced Power BI experience including dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience administering commissions, incentive plans, or bonus programs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
Ability to work with confidential compensation information.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with UKG Pro or similar HRIS.
Experience with compensation survey tools (Mercer, Radford, Salary.com, etc.).
Knowledge of Power Automate or Power Query.
Basic SQL experience.
Experience supporting annual compensation planning cycles.

title: Construction Materials Testing Technician I
description:
At Three Notch Group, we are a leading civil engineering firm with over 75 years of experience, dedicated to delivering a wide range of services, including Field and Lab Services, UST, Environmental, Utility, Transportation, Geotechnical & Construction Engineering, and Civil/Site Development. We foster a collaborative environment where driven team members can build lasting friendships, support one another, and guide our clients in shaping their futures. With offices across the Southeast, including seven in Alabama, two in North Carolina, one in Florida, and one in Tennessee, we offer an exceptional opportunity for personal and professional growth. If you’re ready to make a difference and advance your career, join us at Three Notch Group and be part of a team that truly values your contributions!

Position Summary

Three Notch Group is seeking a motivated Construction Materials Testing (CMT) Technician to join our growing team in Charlotte, North Carolina. The Construction Materials Testing Technician plays a critical role in ensuring the quality and compliance of construction projects through field observations, materials testing, and documentation. The mission of the Construction Materials Technician is to ensure the quality of a constructed project, monitor contractor progress, and perform certain quality control and contract administration functions

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Read and interpret construction plans, geotechnical reports, project specifications, and applicable building codes.
  • Perform field observations, testing, and inspections on commercial, industrial, institutional, roadway, and infrastructure construction projects throughout the region.
  • Monitor contractor activities and document conformance with project plans, specifications, geotechnical recommendations, and applicable standards.
  • Perform construction materials testing and special inspections during:
    • Site grading and earthwork operations
    • Structural fill placement and compaction testing
    • Foundation bearing evaluations
    • Cast-in-place concrete placement and sampling
    • Reinforcing steel inspections
    • Asphalt placement and density testing
  • Collect field samples and perform testing in accordance with ASTM, ACI, ICC, DOT, and project-specific testing requirements.
  • Utilize nuclear density gauges in accordance with company procedures, safety protocols, and applicable certifications.
  • Utilize concrete testing equipment for slump testing, air content testing, temperature measurements, unit weight testing, and concrete cylinder fabrication in accordance with ASTM and ACI standards.
  • Utilize other field testing equipment and devices in accordance with company procedures and applicable standards.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and timely field reports, daily observation reports, test summaries, and inspection documentation using company software and reporting systems.
  • Communicate effectively with contractors, project managers, engineers, and clients regarding:
    • Construction progress
    • Test and inspection results
    • Non-compliant conditions
    • Field observations and recommendations
  • Maintain testing equipment, company vehicles, and field supplies in proper working condition.
  • Follow company safety procedures and maintain a safe working environment on active construction sites.
  • Work outdoors in varying weather conditions and travel to project sites as needed throughout the service area.

Requirements and qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe Acrobat

Preferred, but not required

  • 1–2 years of construction or construction materials testing experience
  • Familiarity with construction inspection and field testing procedures
  • Industry certifications such as:
    • ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician I
    • NICET
    • ICC Certifications
    • DOT certifications

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift and carry materials and testing equipment in accordance with company safety policies and OSHA guidelines, including routinely lifting up to 50 pounds independently and heavier items with team assistance or mechanical aids.
  • Ability to move, transport, and handle construction materials, testing equipment, concrete samples, and soil samples using proper lifting techniques and approved assistance devices when necessary.
  • Frequent bending, hammering, lifting, kneeling, crouching, stooping, crawling, climbing, balancing, and other repetitive physical movements are required.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods while performing field observations and testing activities.
  • Ability to work in outdoor environments and varying weather conditions.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay based on experience and certifications
  • Opportunities for advancement and technical training
  • Company vehicle or mileage reimbursement (if applicable)
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

Locations:

Charlotte, NC

Three Notch Group. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

The listed compensation range is a general guideline. Actual compensation will be determined based on a candidate’s verifiable skills, relevant experience, and educational or professional credentials.

title: Tech Lead (Financial and Trading Platforms)
description:
Haluatko ottaa teknisen vetovastuun liiketoimintakriittisestä järjestelmäkokonaisuudesta? Helen etsii nyt Tech Leadia talouden ja finanssikaupankäynnin järjestelmien kehitykseen ja entistä sujuvamman digitaalisen arjen rakentamiseen!

Helen Oy on vähittäissähkönmyynnin markkinajohtaja Suomessa. Yritys tarjoaa sähkön, lämmön ja jäähdytyksen lisäksi ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan. Helen on myös tarina uudistumisesta ja muutoksen voimasta. Jo vuosisata sitten Helen toi valon ja lämmön helsinkiläisille. Yrityksen visio puhtaasta ja joustavasta energiasta toteutuu jokaisessa työpäivässä, kun he rakentavat maailmanluokan osaamisellaan kestävämpää huomista.

Mitä tulet tekemään?

Kestävän tulevaisuuden rakentaminen edellyttää monipuolista osaamista, myös digitaalisesta näkökulmasta. Helenillä ratkaisutiimit ovat digitaalisen kehityksen ydin. Tech Leadina tulet työskentelemään osana huippuasiantuntijoista koostuvaa Digitaalinen talousohjaus ja finanssikaupankäynti -ratkaisutiimiä (Financial & Trading Platforms).

Tämän ratkaisutiimin vastuulla ovat finanssikaupankäynnin, talouden järjestelmien ja talousraportoinnin ja talousennustamisen kehitys ja ylläpito. Tiimi vastaa Helenin salkkutiimin käyttämistä järjestelmistä sekä yhteyksistä eri kaupankäyntialustoihin, sekä huolehtii eheästä dataputkesta talouden järjestelmiin. Tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on varmistaa taloushallinnon järjestelmien toimivuus, kehitys ja jatkuva ylläpito. Tiimin vastuulla on noin 20-25 erilaista talouden ja finanssikaupankäynnin järjestelmää ja tuotetta, sekä näiden järjestelmien yhteensopivuus muun teknisen infran kanssa.

Tech Leadina toimit Helenin Financial & Trading Platforms -ratkaisutiimin teknisenä suunnannäyttäjänä ja sparraajana. Vastaat järjestelmäkokonaisuuden teknisestä kehittämisestä Helenin arkkitehtuuri- ja teknologialinjausten mukaisesti. Johdat järjestelmäkokonaisuuden muutosta nykyisestä monijärjestelmäisestä ympäristöstä kohti yhtenäisempää ja pitkäjänteisesti kehittyvää rakennetta. Suunnittelet teknisiä ratkaisuja ja integraatioita sekä arvioit vaihtoehtoja liiketoiminnan tarpeiden, kustannusten ja arvontuoton näkökulmasta. Ohjaat myös järjestelmäkumppaneita kehitysprojekteissa ja varmistat muutosten hallitun läpiviennin. Lisäksi kartoitat tekoälyn tuomia mahdollisuuksia järjestelmäkokonaisuuden tueksi.

Työskentelet tiiviisti talouden ja kaupankäynnin asiantuntijoiden, ratkaisuomistajan, muiden ratkaisutiimien ja ulkoisten kumppaneiden kanssa. Tiimillä on sekä kehitys- että operointivastuu, joten varmistat myös järjestelmien jatkuvuutta, hallitset teknisiä riskejä ja osallistut tarvittaessa poikkeustilanteiden ratkaisemiseen.

Roolisi ydin on toimia ratkaisutiimisi teknologisena määrittelijänä, arkkitehtina ja toimeenpanijana kehitystiimeille. Rooli ei sisällä esihenkilövastuuta.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Etsimme teknisesti vahvaa osaajaa, joka hahmottaa laajoja järjestelmäkokonaisuuksia ja pystyy viemään vaativiakin muutoksia määrätietoisesti eteenpäin. Muodostat oman näkemyksesi parhaasta toteutustavasta, perustelet tekniset valinnat ymmärrettävästi ja viet sovitut ratkaisut käytäntöön yhdessä eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Sinulta toivomme:

  • Tehtävään soveltuvaa teknistä tai kaupallista koulutustaustaa
  • Vähintään 3 vuoden verran relevanttia kokemusta kriittisten järjestelmäkokonaisuuksien kehittämisestä ja muutosten hallinnasta
  • Kokemusta järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista, integraatioista ja tietovirroista sekä laajojen end-to-end-kokonaisuuksien hallinnasta
  • Kykyä arvioida teknisten ratkaisujen kustannuksia ja arvontuottoa sekä muuttaa liiketoiminnan tarpeita toimiviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi
  • Näyttöä teknisestä johtajuudesta ja vaativien kehitys- tai järjestelmämuutosprojektien määrätietoisesta läpiviennistä
  • Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa sekä kykyä viestiä teknisistä ratkaisuista ymmärrettävästi

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Kokemus talouden tai finanssikaupankäynnin järjestelmistä ja prosesseista
  • Kokemus Dynamics 365 F&O-, Anaplan-, Basware P2P- tai ION Allegro ETRM -ratkaisuista
  • Kokemus energiatoimialasta tai muusta toimintaympäristöstä, jossa järjestelmillä on liiketoimintakriittinen rooli

Helen tarjoaa sinulle:

  • Teknisen vetovastuun liiketoimintakriittisestä järjestelmäkokonaisuudesta, jossa päätöksesi näkyvät konkreettisesti Helenin talouden ja kaupankäynnin toiminnassa
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi uusilla ratkaisualueilla tai syventää teknistä osaamistasi esimerkiksi arkkitehtuurin ja data engineeringin parissa
  • Työympäristön, jossa saat vastuuta ja voit hyödyntää kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia urasi tukena
  • Työskentelyn joustavassa hybridimallissa, jossa tiimit sopivat yhdessä toimivimmat käytännöt
  • Mahdollisuuden nauttia kattavista henkilöstöeduista, muun muassa henkilöstösähköstä, lounasedusta, Kulttuuri-, liikunta-, hyvinvointietu sekä työmatkaedusta (yhteensä 500 € vuonna 2026), ilmaisesta pysäköinnistä toimistolla, laajasta vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksesta, henkilöstörahastosta, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä ja etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla

Käytännön asiat:

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Helen Oy:n palvelukseen. Työskentelet joustavalla hybridimallilla, ja suosituksena on työskennellä toimistolla noin kerran kahdessa viikossa. Helenin toimisto sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa Helsingissä. Tehtävän palkkaus määräytyy valitun henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, ja neuvotellaan ehdokaskohtaisesti. Helenin työntekijänä sinulle kuuluu palkan lisäksi tulospalkkiojärjestelmä, joka on enimmillään 10% vuosipalkasta.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At RelationalAI, we’re solving one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence: how to teach large language models the logic, semantics, and business context of the modern enterprise.

Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand your business. We fix that.

RelationalAI has pioneered a breakthrough called Superalignment — technology that enables LLMs to learn natively from private, structured enterprise data inside the data cloud.

By combining this with relational knowledge graphs and our proprietary neuro/symbolic-relational reasoners, we deliver trustworthy decision intelligence: systems that use semantic models to truly understand how a business operates and can reason across its data to drive better outcomes.

We’re a globally distributed team of engineers, scientists, and builders redefining how AI learns from data. We believe that high-stakes decisions deserve frontier intelligence — intelligence that’s explainable, aligned, and grounded in reality.

If you’re driven by curiosity, thrive in complexity, and want to help build the system that brings true understanding to enterprise AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role

You will be embedded inside our customers' hardest problems, and you will own the outcome until it works in production.

You'll sit with executives, domain experts, and data teams to find the decisions that actually move their business - inventory that's in the wrong place, risk concentrations nobody can see, fraud patterns that only emerge across three systems, capacity plans built on guesses. Then you'll model their world in our ontology, formulate the reasoning problem, write the PyRel, and ship something that runs against their real data in their own Snowflake account.

Every engagement here produces two deliverables.

The first is the one the customer sees: a working decision system that changes how they operate.

The second is the one that matters most to us: the pile of things you had to invent because our platform didn't have them yet. The modelling pattern you hand-rolled. The constraint formulation that should have been a primitive. The three-hour workaround where an API should have existed. You bring those back, you argue for them, and the strongest of them become product.

That second deliverable is why this role exists. If you only ever deliver the first one, we've hired a consultant. We're not hiring consultants.

You'll operate with unusual autonomy: you decide what's worth building, when a workaround is acceptable and when it's technical debt we'll regret, and when to tell a customer their real problem is not the one they asked about. You'll be technical enough that when something breaks in a customer environment, you find the root cause yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

What You'll Do

  • Own outcomes end to end - discovery, modelling, implementation, performance tuning, production hardening, and the measurement that proves it worked. Not a handoff at each stage. Yours.
  • Build, not describe - design and ship decision solutions on our modelling, reasoning, and learning stack: ontologies over customer data, rules, graph analytics, optimisation formulations, predictive models
  • Fill the gaps yourself - when a customer workflow is blocked on something the platform doesn't do, scope it and build it. Then push the general version upstream: read our source, form a hypothesis before you escalate, open the PR.
  • Close the loop with Product - every deployment generates a signal. Bring back reproductions, patterns, and specific failure modes ("the only way I could express this was by abusing X in this way"), not vibes. You are one of the loudest inputs into our roadmap.
  • Run technical discovery that gets to the truth - workshops, demos, and proofs of concept designed to find out whether we can actually solve the problem, not to look impressive.
  • Leave things better than you found them - document as you go, in the repo, same week. Turn one-off work into reusable reference implementations so the next person starts where you finished. No branch of yours should be diverging for a month.
  • Refuse shortcuts that compound - no undocumented config drift, no "it works now" without knowing why it broke, no restarting the service before you've captured the evidence.

Who You Are

You thrive in ambiguity and move with intent. You're motivated by deep understanding and meaningful impact.

  • Owner, not participant. You take full accountability for the outcome, not your slice of it. When something is broken and it's nobody's job, it becomes yours.
  • You build. Your instinct in the face of a hard problem is to open an editor, not a deck. You'd rather show a working prototype on real data than a diagram of one.
  • High conviction, low ego. You argue hard for what you believe, you're direct about what's wrong, and you change your mind quickly when the evidence turns. You challenge ideas without making it personal - people leave arguments with you feeling sharper, not smaller.
  • Rigorous. You root-cause things. You can explain both why it broke and why your fix works. Surface symptoms don't satisfy you.
  • Fast in unfamiliar territory. Dropped into a codebase, a domain, or a data model you've never seen, you're useful within days. "I only do backend" and "that's not my job" are phrases you don't use.
  • High tolerance for friction. Enterprise environments are messy - broken data, VDI access, security reviews, politics. You route around it and keep shipping.
  • Impact-driven. You want the thing you built to still be running, and still be load-bearing, two years from now.

What This Role Is Not

We'd rather be blunt than waste your time:

  • It is not demo-and-handoff pre-sales. You don't disappear after the POC; you're there when it goes to production.
  • It is not staff augmentation. You own outcomes, not hours or ticket queues.
  • It is not advisory. We deliver working software, not recommendations.
  • It is not a support role. You deploy new things; you don't maintain someone else's legacy.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building and shipping production software, at least some of it inside customer or partner environments
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership: you have personally taken something from an ambiguous problem statement to running in production, and you can walk us through the whole arc, including what went wrong
  • Strong SQL and deep familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift)
  • Strong programming ability - Python primarily; comfort with declarative or logic-style languages is a real advantage
  • Comfortable reading unfamiliar source code, interpreting stack traces, and debugging systems you didn't write
  • Able to hold your own with both a VP of Supply Chain and a staff data engineer, in the same meeting
  • Comfortable operating in high-autonomy, high-velocity, low-instruction environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Built analytical, decision, or reasoning applications that reached production and stayed there
  • Experience with optimization, constraint solving, rule engines, graph algorithms, or ML on structured data
  • Semantic modelling, data pipelines, and governance in real enterprise settings
  • Track record of upstream contribution - features, tools, or abstractions you built for one customer that became standard for everyone
  • Prior experience in enterprise technology, AI, or analytics platforms

How We Hire

Our loop is designed to test the job, not trivia. Expect a technical screen; a session where you navigate and extend a system you've never seen before; a problem-decomposition session on a realistic customer scenario; and a conversation about ownership with the hiring manager. We're looking for how you think when you don't know the answer.

The Solution Engineer position offers a base salary range of $170,000 to $200,000, along with equity and comprehensive benefits. Please note that this range serves as a guideline; actual total compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, skill set, qualifications, and geographic location.

Why RelationalAI

At RelationalAI, you will:

  • Work from anywhere in the world
  • Earn competitive salary + equity
  • Enjoy open PTO, flexible schedules, and recharge weeks
  • Access global benefits, mental-health support, and learning stipends
  • Join a transparent, inclusive, and globally connected culture that values curiosity, excellence, and impact
  • Regular team offsites and global events – Building strong connections while working remotely through team offsites and global events that bring everyone together.
  • A culture of transparency & knowledge-sharing – Open communication through team standups, fireside chats, and open meetings.

Country Hiring Guidelines:

Because of this, understanding location & visa support helps us better prepare to onboard our colleagues.

Our People Operations team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruitment process.

How to Apply

If you’re driven by understanding, powered by curiosity, and ready to help shape the next era of enterprise intelligence — we’d love to hear from you.

Join us and help build the reasoning layer for the modern enterprise.

title: Associate Product Manager - Bay Area Based
description:
At Side, we believe everyone should own their path.

Side partners with top-producing real estate professionals to help them own and operate their own boutique real estate companies, without the legal, regulatory, or operational complexity of running a traditional brokerage. As a pioneer in the Brokerage-as-a-Service model, Side provides a proprietary platform that increases efficiency, strengthens client relationships, and enables entrepreneurs to focus on what they do best — selling real estate and growing their businesses.

Headquartered in San Francisco and backed by more than $300 million from top-tier venture capital firms, Side is recognized as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in real estate. At Side, you’ll work alongside experienced industry leaders and world-class engineers to help shape the future of real estate and empower exceptional professionals to thrive as business owners.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Product team at Side drives product vision, strategic planning, and the design, rollout, and measurement of new products and features. The team is responsible for delivering products that delight customers and impact the business, and for measuring that impact against well-defined success outcomes. We build products iteratively based on data-directed insights and user feedback, and generate insightful hypotheses about our users and their needs. We regularly collaborate with internal partners and are in a unique position of easy access to users for real time feedback due to our close partnerships with our customers & their teams. We believe that collaboration, teamwork, and communication are critical to the product development process. We strive to communicate clearly, manage expectations proactively, and exercise full transparency with our partners and teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As an Associate Product Manager who is new or early in the Product Management career path, you will be learning and applying core Product skills. Your focus will be on execution with the UX and Engineering members on your team, under the guidance and coaching of senior Product team members, and working on defined problems and features in our Transaction & Compliance Management product. You will clearly define product work, participate in planning, test and validate completed work, and participate in release planning and communication. In partnership with adjacent teams on the platform, you will leverage both product iteration and 10x innovation to provide industry-leading automation, efficiency, and ease-of-use. You will deeply understand the customer, begin to leverage data to validate solution impact, and play a key role in driving predictable, measurable success for our customers and for Side.
This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco headquarters. To foster collaboration and maintain our fast-paced culture, we require 2 days per week in the office.

What you'll be doing

  • In partnership with your UX and Engineering Lead counterparts, and with guidance from senior Product team members, driving the work of the Agile team to produce high-quality, reliable, and high-impact product iterations and releases
  • Clearly defining product features, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria to empower efficient and high-quality product work, leveraging AI tools to amplify your work and impact
  • Coding with AI to produce prototypes, examples, and other artifacts for clearly articulating features and requirements
  • Leveraging data analytics and qualitative understanding to validate feature adoption and impact
  • Collaborating with senior Product team members to prioritize the backlog of work to deliver the most impactful and strategically sequenced releases and improvements
  • Participating in team Agile ceremonies to groom, plan, execute, and improve
  • Working with the Go-to-Market team to document product releases for internal and external stakeholders, and providing team updates/training for major releases
  • Releasing as needed to alpha/beta groups for refinement, feedback, and hardening
  • Contributing skills, artifacts, and best practices for AI use in the team

What will make you a strong fit for the role

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Comfort with distilling ambiguity into an actionable path to execute and learn
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to tailor communication style, format, and depth based on your audience
  • Aptitude working with technology and collaborating with others who have varying degrees of technical skills
  • Extreme comfort using AI tools and skills to accelerate your work and expand the breadth of your impact
  • Ability to organize and leverage data for evaluation and decision making
  • Growth Mindset: embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, focus on fearless learning, thrive on effort
  • Experience working directly with customers and with interdisciplinary cross-functional teams
  • Ownership mentality with strong execution capability and a track record of achieving measurable results
  • High empathy, curiosity, self-awareness, and transparency in both wins and misses
  • Strong work ethic with a willingness to dive deep into the details
  • Bonus: experience with data analytics - SQL, advanced spreadsheet functions, business analytics tools
  • B.A., B.S. or equivalent
Side is dedicated to working with the highest skilled people from the most inclusive talent pool feasible. We maintain that diversity in all aspects leads to positive change, solutions and innovation for our customers and career fulfillment for our employees. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply!

Side uses the E-Verify employment verification program.

title: Forward Deployed Data Engineer - Houston
description:
The Opportunity

As a Forward Deployed Data Engineer (FDE) on our US Launch Team, you will act as the principal technical anchor embedded directly within high-stakes enterprise client accounts (focusing heavily on Financial Services and Healthcare). You won't just be writing specs or advising from afar—you will be on the front lines in client environments, bridging the gap between C-suite data strategy and hands-on production code.

Working at the tip of the spear alongside our elite partners at Databricks and Anthropic, you will lead architecture design, modernize brittle legacy ecosystems into cloud-native Lakehouses, build agentic AI data harnesses, and guide integrated "SWAT" pods to ship working software in weeks rather than months.

Key Responsibilities

  • Embedded Technical Leadership: Serve as the primary technical authority on client engagements. Partner directly with client VP/CTO stakeholders to scope architectures, map data domains, and turn complex requirements into execution-ready engineering plans.

  • Hands-On Lakehouse Modernization: Roll up your sleeves to write and optimize production PySpark, Databricks SQL, and Delta Live Tables (DLT)—actively refactoring complex legacy logic (Informatica, PL/SQL, legacy stored procedures) into Medallion Architectures.

  • Agentic AI & Data Infrastructure: Architect deterministic, secure data "harnesses" that integrate LLM workflows (Anthropic/Claude) into traditional enterprise data pipelines safely and cost-effectively.

  • DataOps & IaC Ownership: Write modular Terraform scripts to provision cloud environments (AWS/GCP), manage governance and lineage via Unity Catalog, and enforce CI/CD rigor across projects.

  • Pod & Delivery Guidance: Partner with our LATAM-based nearshore engineering squads (600+ experts) as the US technical lead—conducting code reviews, debugging performance bottlenecks, and maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Technical Unblocking & Escalation: Act as the ultimate technical safety net. If a pipeline breaks or a deployment stalls at 2:00 AM, you have the hands-on depth to jump into the code, fix the issue, and keep client delivery on track.

Qualifications & Requirements

Technical Mastery & Execution

  • Extensive Hands-On Data Engineering: Deep proficiency in Python and advanced SQL with a proven track record of shipping production data software.

  • Deep Databricks Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience building, scaling, and tuning Databricks Lakehouse environments (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, PySpark, DLT, Workflows).

  • Modern Stack & IaC Discipline: Expert-level experience with dbt (Core or Enterprise) for data modeling, Terraform for Infrastructure as Code, and Git/Airflow for orchestration and CI/CD.

  • Legacy Migration Experience: Demonstrated background migrating enterprise client workloads from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Informatica, Oracle) to modern cloud infrastructure.

Client Presence & Startup Grit

  • The "Player-Coach" Mindset: Equal comfort pitching target architectures to a client CTO and debugging a failing PySpark job or dbt macro alongside junior engineers.

  • Executive Communication: Ability to translate messy business requirements into clean architectural patterns and speak authoritatively across both technical and business functions.

  • Scrappy Nation-Builder: High autonomy and resilience—thriving in a fast-paced, Series A growth environment without relying on rigid corporate playbooks or large support structures.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience in forward-deployed, technical consulting, or ProServe roles at top-tier agencies or hyper-growth vendors.

  • Pragmatic experience building or deploying LLM/GenAI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Anthropic API) into production pipelines.

  • Official certifications in Databricks, AWS, GCP, or dbt.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $230,000. In addition to base pay, this position may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. An individual's final salary offer will be determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, experience, specialized skills, and qualifications. This compensation range is subject to updates or modifications at the company’s discretion

title: Resident Activities Director
description:

We are looking for a qualified and enthusiastic Resident Activities Director (RAD), to join a property in Roslindale. This is a full-time position, Monday-Friday including resident events. title: Senior Staff Communication Systems Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Staff Communication Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of space architecture concepts, sub-system design, payload design, requirements development, analysis and decomposition, high-level software and hardware system architecture design, concept of operations (CONOPS) development, and risk assessment. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success.

The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces.
  • Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe.
  • Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility.
  • Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations.
  • Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability.
  • Lead system-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration.
  • Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance.
  • Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms.
  • Very strong background in communication theory.
  • Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation).
  • Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS).
  • Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews.
  • Fluent in English (German language skills a plus).
  • Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team.
  • High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.

Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Associate Technical Consultant - Entry-Level Consulting
description:
Do you love technology but want to do more than just code? If you are looking for meaningful work with a big impact and a chance to work directly with stakeholders to design solutions and solve complex problems, then this role is for you.

The Technical Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact technical consultants—empowering you to write production code, build custom integrations, and deploy enterprise cloud and AI solutions that help global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.

Explore More Generation Veeva Roles

We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers

The Role

As a customer-facing Technical Consultant, you will build, customize, and deploy Veeva’s industry-leading enterprise SaaS platforms and AI solutions directly to customers. Moving beyond theoretical advisory, this hands-on role gives you immediate ownership to translate complex business challenges into production-ready software systems for customers in Life Sciences. We provide comprehensive domain and technical training at the start of the program, making this an ideal accelerator for high-potential graduates eager to build a high-impact career at the intersection of enterprise cloud architecture and client-facing technical services.

Start Dates: October 2026 and April 2027

The Program

As part of the Technical Consultant Development Program, you will:

  • Ramp up quickly. Your journey begins with an intensive, engineering-focused onboarding program designed to build deep technical expertise in Veeva’s Vault Platform, APIs, and custom development—while equipping you with the core consulting and customer-facing skills needed to engage directly with clients and ship production code from day one.
  • Learn by doing. Skip the sidelines and routine QA—you’ll take on real engineering responsibility within your first three months, writing production code, building custom integrations, and working directly with customers to solve complex technical challenges.
  • Thrive together. Learn side-by-side with seasoned Technical and Migration Architects who prioritize your growth, guiding you through complex system designs and providing transparent, actionable feedback on your code and client delivery.
  • Build your future. Fast-track your career from Associate to Consultant in less than two years, building a powerful foundation in full-stack implementation, DevOps, and technical consulting while leading complex architecture projects alongside a global team.

What You'll Do

  • Build solutions. Skip basic QA and debugging to write production code, develop custom integrations using Java SDKs and APIs, build DevOps pipelines, and deploy Veeva AI tools on the Vault Platform.
  • Architect and migrate. Work directly with migration architects to design custom backend logic, configure enterprise SaaS platforms, and execute complex data migration scripts for global life sciences clients.
  • Ship internal tooling. Accelerate delivery workflows by developing cutting-edge, developer-facing tools used globally across the Veeva Services engineering team.
  • Own technical delivery. Take on real architectural responsibility from day one, mastering software engineering and client-facing technical strategy to advance from Associate to Consultant in under two years.

What We Are Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or related field with strong technical background.
  • Technical Foundation: Demonstrated experience in Object-Oriented Programming.
  • Communication: Excellent technical storytelling skills; you enjoy explaining why a specific technical architecture or decision is right for a customer
  • Drive: Thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong critical thinking skills and proven track record of academic performance.
  • Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company; we expect that from all employees.
  • Work Ethic: A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20% of the time).
  • Experience: Recent university graduate (up to 2 years postgraduate experience maximum)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Languages: Experience with Python, C, HTML, Java, JavaScript, or SQL.
  • Cloud: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • AI Tools: Experience using AI-powered development tools or CLI assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or similar).

THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:

  1. Application: Submit your resume, short cover letter, and take a personality test.
  2. Initial Response: Within one week, we will notify you of your next step via email.
  3. Interview: The next step is a 60-minute interview with a Veeva leader,
  4. Technical Challenge: A 30-minute online technical challenge delivered via Coderpad.
  5. Case: After the coding challenge, there is a case exercise with a member of our services team. You will have three days to prepare for the case exercise.
  6. Decision: Within one week, we will extend an offer or let you know that we are not moving forward.
  7. Commitment: You will have two weeks to accept your offer. We value commitment; once you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to join us on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view.

Compensation

  • Starting Salary: 120,000 ZL
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program
Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the European Union. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position.
Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. Associate Consultants work remotely for Veeva in Poland. To take advantage of regular opportunities for in-person collaboration, skill development, and socialization, we require that you live within a 60 minute commute of Krakow, Warsaw, or Wroclaw.

description:
Title: Compliance Technician II

Department: Quality

Revision Date: 8/10/2026
