title: Independent Cargo Charter Broker (Commission-Only)
description:
Independent Cargo Charter Broker

Position: Cargo Charter Broker

Location: Remote

Type: Independent Contractor (1099) | Commission-Only

Surf On Demand is the private charter brokerage and private airline division of Surf Air Mobility, a publicly traded aviation and mobility company (NYSE: SRFM). We operate a high-volume, performance-driven aviation platform offering on-demand cargo and passenger charter solutions worldwide.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for ambitious, entrepreneurial professionals to join Surf On Demand as

Independent Cargo Charter Brokers.

This is a commission-only, 1099 independent contractor position — ideal for experienced cargo brokers, freight forwarders, logistics professionals, or driven entrepreneurs ready to leverage our global brand, SurfOS software platform, and 24/7 operational support to build and scale their own cargo charter business.

As an Independent Cargo Charter Broker, you’ll have full control over your client relationships, schedule, and business development strategy — while benefiting from the infrastructure and credibility of a publicly traded aviation company.

What You’ll Do

● Develop and manage a portfolio of cargo clients including freight forwarders, logistics providers, manufacturers, and time-critical shippers.

● Source, structure, and close domestic and international cargo charter opportunities (ad hoc and program-based).

● Coordinate air freight solutions including oversized cargo, dangerous goods (DG), AOG (Aircraft on Ground), and time-critical shipments.

● Provide consultative logistics solutions tailored to client timelines, budgets, and regulatory requirements.

● Utilize Surf On Demand’s SurfOS platform for quoting, trip coordination, and CRM tracking.

● Collaborate with our 24/7 operations team to ensure seamless execution from pickup through delivery.

● Build and maintain relationships with carriers, operators, and logistics partners globally.

● Represent Surf On Demand and Surf Air brands professionally in client interactions, industry events, and partner engagements.

What You’ll Get

● Uncapped Commission Potential: Industry-leading payouts with no earning limits.

● Autonomy & Flexibility: Operate independently, manage your own schedule, and work from anywhere.

● Inbound Lead Option: Access qualified inbound cargo opportunities in exchange for a reduced commission split.

● 24/7 Global Operations Support: Expert team handling flight following, permits, handling, and logistics coordination.

● Extensive Carrier Network: Access to a global network of vetted cargo operators with competitive wholesale pricing.

● Full Back-Office Infrastructure: Contracts, invoicing, compliance, and financial settlements managed for you.

● SurfOS Technology Platform: Proprietary system for real-time quoting, workflow management, and client tracking.

● Global Brand Credibility: Partner with Surf Air Mobility (NYSE: SRFM), a recognized name in aviation and mobility.

Who You Are

● Experienced in air cargo charter, freight forwarding, logistics, or high-value B2B sales.

● Existing book of business or strong industry network preferred (freight forwarders, 3PLs, shippers).

● Knowledge of cargo aircraft types, payload capabilities, and routing/logistics considerations.

● Familiarity with aviation and cargo platforms such as Avinode, CargoWise, or similar tools is a plus.

● Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and client relationship management skills.

● Entrepreneurial, self-driven, and comfortable operating in a commission-only environment.

● Ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines in a fast-paced, time-critical environment.

Why Partner with Surf On Demand

● Global reach, local freedom: Build your own cargo brokerage under a publicly traded brand.

● Unlimited earning potential: Scale your income directly with your performance.

● Robust support infrastructure: 24/7 ops, finance, and technology designed to help you succeed.

● Industry connectivity: Collaborate with a network of experienced brokers and logistics professionals.


Take Off With Us

If you’re ready to grow your cargo charter business with the backing of a trusted global aviation brand, Surf On Demand invites you to join us as an Independent Cargo Charter Broker.


Build your business. Move critical cargo. Earn without limits.


Apply today and elevate your future with Surf On Demand — part of Surf Air Mobility (NYSE: SRFM).

title: Flight Centre - Travel Consultant - Toronto, ON
description:
Love travel. Love great conversations. Love the thrill of closing a sale.
Sound like you?

At Flight Centre, our Travel Consultants spend their days having meaningful customer conversations, converting enquiries into bookings, and working toward clear sales targets while earning commission on every sale. You will work in a fast paced, customer facing retail environment where personality, performance, and customer experience all matter.

This role is rewarding, but it’s not easy, especially in your first few months. You will be learning multiple systems, navigating a wide range of products, and managing high volume customer conversations, all while building confidence in a dynamic retail environment.

At Flight Centre, we believe great travel experiences are built through human connection. Technology can book trips, people make them memorable. This isn’t point and click booking. It’s about understanding what really matters to customers, thinking creatively, and bringing genuine value to every conversation.

To learn more about Flight Centre please click HERE

About the opportunity

As a Travel Consultant, you will work full time, on site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7 day trade. This is a target driven sales role where success is measured through KPIs, revenue, conversion, and customer satisfaction.

You will take ownership of the customer journey from first enquiry through to booking and follow up, selling complete travel solutions - not just flights.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Convert customer enquiries into confirmed bookings through consultative sales conversations
  • Work toward individual KPIs and sales targets, earning commission on every sale
  • Sell end to end travel solutions including flights, accommodation, tours, cruises, car hire, transfers, and travel insurance

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a People & Culture Lead based in United States.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build and lead the People function within a fast-moving, remote-first consulting environment.
You will own the full employee lifecycle, from attracting and selecting exceptional talent to onboarding, development, and offboarding.
The role combines talent acquisition, people operations, and internal communications into one connected function focused on building a strong, aligned team.
Working closely with founders and senior leadership, you will have significant autonomy to shape processes, policies, and the employee experience.
You will bring structure to a distributed, multi-country workforce while continuously improving how the organization operates and communicates.

This role is designed for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership, and sees People & Culture as a strategic driver of business performance.

  • Lead onboarding and offboarding from end to end, ensuring new employees become productive quickly while departures are handled smoothly, consistently, and compliantly.
  • Manage day-to-day People Operations, including employee questions, contracts, policies, PTO, payroll and benefits coordination, and compliance requirements across a distributed, multi-country workforce.
  • Develop and improve performance management, compensation, benefits, and other people policies, ensuring processes are clear, practical, and well communicated.
  • Serve as the trusted first point of contact for employees on People-related matters, exercising sound judgment and escalating sensitive issues when appropriate.
  • Own internal communications, translating leadership decisions, company updates, project wins, and important information into clear communications that keep remote teams informed and connected.
  • Strengthen culture through recognition, feedback mechanisms, team rituals, events, and other initiatives that reinforce shared values and employee engagement.
  • Use AI tools as part of daily workflows and continuously iterate on People processes to make the function more effective, scalable, and aligned with the organization’s evolving needs.
  • Operate with autonomy, make informed decisions, and constructively challenge existing approaches when improvements are needed.

    • Requirements:

title: Asiakaspalveluhenkilö logistiikka- ja erikoiskuljetuspalveluihin, Espoo
description:
Coor on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kiinteistöpalveluiden tuottajista, jolla on asiantuntemusta yli sadasta tukipalvelusta erilaisiin kiinteistöihin. Coor toimii Suomessa valtakunnallisesti, ja palveluvalikoimaamme kuuluu asiakaslähtöisiä kiinteistöpalveluita, joita kehitetään jatkuvasti paremmiksi.

Haemme nyt Espooseen

asiakaspalveluhenkilöä logistiikka- ja erikoiskuljetuspalveluihin

Etsimme osaavaa ja oma-aloitteista logistiikka- ja erikoiskuljetuspalveluiden asiakaspalveluhenkilöä vastaamaan monipuolisista ja haastavistakin tuonti-, vienti- ja erikoiskuljetuksiin liittyvistä tehtävistä. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, joka hallitset tullausprosessit ammattitaidolla ja nautit vaihtelevasta sekä itsenäisestä työstä.

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen (37,5 h/vko) työsuhteen. Aloitus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan. Sinulle kuuluvat myös Coorin työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas- ja virike-etu, mahdollisuus liittyä vapaaehtoiseen sairauskassaan, laaja työterveyshuolto. Palkkaus tehtävään on sopimuksen mukaan. Työskentelykohteesi sijaitsee Espoossa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella.

Tehtävän kuvaus
Roolissa vastaat logistiikkaan ja erikoiskuljetuksiin liittyvistä operatiivisista tehtävistä ja tarjoat tukea organisaation henkilöstölle. Työ tehdään pääosin sähköpostin, puhelimen ja asiakkaan järjestelmien kautta. Työnkuvan vasteajan mukaisesti sinun tulisi olla tavoitettavissa arkisin klo 8.00-16.00 välillä. Toimeksiannot otetaan käsittelyyn kahden vuorokauden sisällä, kiireelliset tapaukset tarpeen mukaan. Yhteistyö huolinta-, logistiikka- ja aulapalvelutoimijoiden sekä tarvittaessa viranomaisten kanssa on olennainen osa tehtävää.

Keskeisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluu seuraavanlaisia tehtäviä:

Tuontihuolinta

  • Saapuvien tullattavien lähetysten käsittely ja ohjeistaminen.
  • Tuontimenettelyjen, tullinimikkeiden, toimitusehtojen ja arvon tarkistaminen.
  • Tuontiin liittyvien lupa- ja rajoiteasioiden varmistaminen.
  • Neuvonta tuontihuolinnan toimintatavoissa.

Vientihuolinta

  • Neuvonta vientien ja ulkoisten jalostusten valmistelu.
  • Väliaikaisten vientien ja ulkoisten jalostusten valmistelu.
  • Vientirajoitteiden selvittäminen ja lupakäytänteiden noudattaminen.

Erikoiskuljetukset

  • Erikoiskuljetusten suunnittelu ja ohjeistus.
  • VAK-, erityispika- ja olosuhdeherkkien kuljetusten koordinointi.
  • Luvanvaraisten kuljetusten valmistelu (esimerkiksi vientiluvat).
  • Messu-, näyttely- ja tutkimusprojektikuljetusten järjestelyt.

Muut tehtävät

  • Huolintaan liittyvien valtakirjojen ja dokumenttien valmistelu.
  • Raportointi käsitellyistä toimeksiannoista.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta huolinnasta, tullauksesta ja erikoiskuljetuksista.
  • Tuntemusta tuonti- ja vientimenettelyistä ja niihin liittyvistä rajoitteista.
  • Erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.
  • Hyviä dokumentointi- ja raportointitaitoja.
  • Itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta.
  • Kykyä hoitaa useita toimeksiantoja samanaikaisesti.
  • Alan peruskoulutus katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle teetetään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys ennen töiden aloitusta. Lisäksi henkilöluottotiedot tarkastetaan ennen työsuhteen alkua.

Tervetuloa yritykseen, jossa jokaisella on merkitys

Jos sinulla on osaamista huolinnan ja erikoiskuljetusten parista, lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Aloitamme haastattelut heti sopivien hakijoiden löydyttyä. Huomaathan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

title: PLANNER, JR/BUYER
description:
The Jr. Planner/Buyer assists with planning and purchasing tasks by analyzing inventory data, preparing purchase orders, tracking deliveries, and communicating with suppliers. Perform production planning activities driven by the MRP/ERP system, including releasing work orders to the shop floor and generating material requisitions to support manufacturing operations.

The Planner/Buyer, Jr. manages purchasing and inventory planning by forecasting demand, placing purchase orders, coordinating with suppliers, and ensuring materials arrive on time while controlling costs and stock levels.

Ensure the efficient flow of materials across all operational areas, including Procurement, Receiving, Manufacturing, Assembly, Inspection, and Shipping. Coordinate both internal processes and external supplier interactions to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments. Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impact material movement or production timelines by compiling and maintaining action item lists, keeping all stakeholders informed of risks and progress.

Key Responsibilities

  • Route and expedite raw material, components, engineering documents, Blueprints, etc., in and between departments to ensure the un-interrupted flow of projects
  • Revise and re-schedule orders to meet the priorities of the team as directed by Planner or Project manager,
  • Compile and prepare reports tracking material movements to provide detailed updates for Project Manager and Planners.
  • Working within the team and other area owners, ensure accurate and timely responses to requested or required actions to support deliverables.
  • Work with the area owners, prioritize schedules, where necessary, to avoid extended delays and keep High priority jobs moving through their various production activities.
  • Report production issues or irregularities to the project and/or assigned planner as required.
  • Perform Job updates due to scrap and engineering revisions as required to keep hardware in production at the latest configuration.
  • Assist and provide recommendations concerning processes, procedures, personnel, equipment and any other improvements that may improve the effectiveness and efficiencies of the organization and company.
  • Work closely with Project and Planning Teams, Assembly, Machine Shop and Inventory control teams, to drive commitments and achieve required production goals and on-time delivery to both our internal and external customers.
  • Collaborate with all area owners to coordinate preparation of Schedules and reports and maintain those files and other required records.
  • Follow up on late shipments and resolve supply issues.

Experience:

  • Minimum of one-year experience in a fast-paced precision production environment preferred
  • Knowledge of Production control systems, component and assembled products, manufacturing processes preferred
  • Understanding of MRP/ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Epicor) beneficial
  • Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, and supplier quality management systems beneficial
  • Understanding of FAR/DFARS, ITAR/EAR, and government contracting principles beneficial
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and digital procurement tools.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication

Education:

  • High School or technical/vocational school degree required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, or related field (and/or equivalent experience) preferred
  • Physical Requirements
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 25–30 lbs.
  • Regular use of computer, keyboard, and standard office equipment.
  • Ability to travel occasionally to suppliers or company sites as needed.

title: Sr.  Advisor or Director, Advanced Nuclear
company: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority
description:
As a leader in advancing New York’s energy transition, the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) is a credible, objective and trusted partner in energy planning and in deploying new innovative technologies to build an affordable, abundant, reliable, and clean energy system. NYSERDA works with stakeholders statewide, including residents, business owners, developers, community leaders, local government officials, universities, utilities, investors, entrepreneurs, and more, to develop, invest, and foster conditions that:

  • Attract the private sector capital investment needed to expand New York’s clean energy economy.
  • Advance solutions for using clean energy at a large-scale in New York.
  • Enable New York’s communities and residents to benefit equitably in the clean energy transition.

Job Overview

NYSERDA is seeking a Director, Advanced Nuclear and a Sr. Advisor, Advanced Nuclear to develop and lead a new Advanced Nuclear team being formed at NYSERDA. These positions will report to the Senior Vice President of Large-Scale Resources (LSR). These roles will be responsible for strategy development, program design and implementation, written and verbal status and progress reporting, stakeholder collaboration, and team management.

The Director will build-out and manage a team consisting of both direct reports and NYSERDA-wide staff that are part of the Advanced Nuclear work through matrix working relationships. The Director will supervise Senior Advisor(s), Project Manager(s), and other direct reports as NYSERDA’s role evolves, and will work with related NYSERDA staff through a matrixed team arrangement including workforce and supply chain development, economic development, innovation, legal counsel, contracts, communications, and others.

The Sr. Advisor will be responsible for supporting the development of Advanced Nuclear technical and regulatory aspects, including leadership of related techno-economic analysis .This role may informally lead cross functional teams and function as an internal and external Subject Matter Expert, bridging the gap between complex nuclear technology, policymaking, market strategy, stakeholder engagement and regulatory aspects.

In January 2025, Governor Kathy Hochul announced the start of a process to develop a Master Plan for Responsible Advanced Nuclear Development in New York. NYSERDA, together with the Department of Public Service (DPS) and working with other State Agencies, leads on the development of the Master Plan. The development of the Master Plan will provide a framework for in-depth examination into the key issues raised by the Blueprint to develop recommendations for implementation of advanced nuclear technologies in New York State. The Master Plan development process is expected to conclude with publication by the end of 2026.

This announcement was furthered in January 2026 when Governor Hochul announced the "Nuclear Reliability Backbone" initiative, aiming to establish 4 gigawatts (GW) of new, advanced nuclear capacity alongside 1 GW already in development by the New York Power Authority, creating an 8.4 GW total nuclear, zero-emission, baseload power portfolio.

Overall, the execution of these initiatives will support New York's 2040 clean energy goals, enhance grid stability, and meet surging demand from data centers and manufacturing. NYSERDA will continue to play a central role in the advancement of nuclear and other dispatchable zero-emissions technologies and thesepositions will be a central role to realize these outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help finalize and lead the completion of New York’s ongoing Advanced Nuclear Master Plan and, upon conclusion of the Master Planning process, lead NYSERDA's efforts to both deliver on that Plan as well as further develop and execute New York's policy framework for advanced nuclear.
  • Contribute to New York's emerging policies and strategies for other zero-emissions technologies, including as part of the ongoing New York Public Service Commission (PSC) Zero by 2040 proceeding.
  • Impart a deep and broad base of technical and market knowledge development into State deliberations to shape State programs in a market-sensitive manner.

Program

  • Develop, direct, and guide the Advanced Nuclear team to develop, implement and execute advanced nuclear deployment initiatives and programs in line with New York's Advanced Nuclear strategy.
  • Collaborate with wider NYSERDA colleagues and teams (in a matrixed structure) to develop, implement and execute broader advanced nuclear ecosystem initiatives and programs, including on supply chain, workforce, innovation and regulatory matters.
  • Manage Program budgets in accordance with applicable rules and in coordination with the CFO office.
  • Negotiate contracts and manage contractors.
  • Perform other programmatic responsibilities as needed.

Execution

  • Drive projects and policies forward by gathering and effectively organizing required information, communicating effectively and professionally with internal and external stakeholders, developing and monitoring plans, and overseeing the responsibilities and commitments of team members.
  • Represent NYSERDA in collaborative initiatives with other New York State agencies and public and private entities and in technical conferences, public meetings and other forums.
  • Maintain and leverage a network of stakeholders, market participants, peer program administrators, policy experts and other sources of insight.
  • Perform all job responsibilities with respect, fairness, consistency, and inclusion.

People Leadership (for the Director role)

  • Lead and manage the Advanced Nuclear team to develop and build a high-performing team and help team members meet their own professional goals
  • Lead a broader cross-functional team that includes energy analysis, transmission, legal, and other related subject matter experts.
  • Direct analysis on technology developments, advancements, cost trends, labor and workforce assets, or other relevant information
  • Foster and contribute to a team culture and culture of excellence grounded in people development, learning, problem solving, and teamwork.
  • Perform all managerial and supervisory responsibilities with respect, fairness, consistency, and inclusion across the workforce.

Minimum Qualifications

  • For Director title(Salary range: $163,811-$206,043)
    • A Bachelor’s degree preferably in Nuclear Science/ Nuclear Engineering/ Nuclear Technology or adjacent, relevant degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in the nuclear and energy industry including 5 years of supervisory experience.
  • For Sr. Advisor title(Salary range: $147,952-$186,923)
    • A Bachelor’s degree preferably in Nuclear Science/ Nuclear Engineering/ Nuclear Technology or adjacent, relevant degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in the nuclear and energy industry

Specific areas:

  • A track record of leadership roles including experience as a team leader and demonstrated experience leading high-profile nuclear energy projects in the private sector, preferably in the advanced nuclear area in North America.
  • Deep subject-matter expertise, including at a technical and management level, on advanced nuclear technologies
  • Deep understanding of and demonstrated experience with the relevant finance and economics context, such as in the areas of project finance or infrastructure finance, and related financial and cost analysis tools.
  • Experience with development of strategy and policy in the energy space, in the private or public sector.
  • Preferred: leadership experience and technical understanding on other zero-emission technologies under consideration in New York, including biofuels, hydrogen, deep geothermal, carbon capture and storage, long-duration energy storage, virtual power plants and demand response.

Crosscutting/ general areas:

  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and negotiating skills to reach pragmatic solutions for complex issues and often competing stakeholder views.
  • Mentor, and developer of talent, with demonstrated ability to develop a team to achieve their potential and deliver outcomes.
  • Strong interpersonal skills involving the ability to work cross-functionally to understand requirements, present alternatives and recommendations
  • Highest level of presentational, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Project management and leadership skills including the ability to work as a team leader and team member, maintain project timelines, budgets, and deliver on commitments
  • Knowledge of state and federal regulatory processes relating to energy project siting and operations, with a preference for knowledge relating to nuclear energy.
  • Self-starter who acts independently, directs one’s own work and can handle diverse tasks quickly and accurately within a high-performance environment.
  • Relentless work ethic and resolute integrity
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills; ability to quickly aggregate and analyze information. Genuine passion for matters relating to energy and the environment and an interest in developing and supporting a dynamic and talented team.
  • Project management skills including maintaining project timelines and budgets, and delivering on commitments

Preferred Qualifications

  • For Director Title:
    • A Master’s degree preferably in Nuclear Science/ Nuclear Engineering/ Nuclear Technology or adjacent, relevant degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience in the nuclear and energy industry with Zero emissions technology expertise including 5 years of supervisory experience.
  • For Sr. Advisor Title:
    • A Master’s degree preferably in Nuclear Science/ Nuclear Engineering/ Nuclear Technology or adjacent, relevant degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience in the nuclear and energy industry with Zero emissions technology expertise Please submit two files, one for your cover letter and another for a resume.

description:

Position : Lean 6 Sigma Consultant - Black Belt
Location: Klang Valley

Role Summary :

We are engaging a certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt to lead the process-improvement core of a multi-site digital transformation program for a large group in the energy sector. You will run a structured DMAIC discovery, with time-and-motion study at its center, then feed the findings into a phased build of automation, analytics and applications on the client's existing stack. The client is highly outcome-driven and expects visible progress and quantified value from month one. You work within a joint team alongside TTMS and client analysts.


Responsibilities :

  • Standardize, replicate and transfer: capture standard work in the Control phase and a repeatable playbook the client reuses for new sites, and coach and certify the client's process analysts so competence stays in-house.
  • Handle sensitive processes appropriately, leading the method while a nominated client custodian handles confidential data, so raw values stay within the client's systems (confidential-by-design).


Requirements

  • Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (Master Black Belt an advantage) with around eight or more years of hands-on process improvement, ideally in manufacturing, industrial or process-industry settings.
  • Practical mastery of the toolkit (time-and-motion study, value-stream and process mapping, root-cause and statistical analysis, standard work and control plans) and strong facilitation from the shop floor to senior management.
  • Comfort with digital delivery teams, translating process findings into requirements for automation, analytics and low-code apps.
  • Language and travel: fluent in English and Bahasa Malaysia (ability to engage Mandarin speaking stakeholders an added advantage), and willing to travel to client sites within Malaysia.


Benefits

  • Stable employment and professional development.

  • Collaboration with experienced experts in an international environment.
  • Opportunity to develop your career in new organizational structures.

  • Great working atmosphere.

title: Communications Intern

description:
Communications Intern

As a leader in advancing New York’s energy transition, the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) has remained a credible, objective and trusted partner in our state’s energy planning as well as deploying new and innovative technologies to expand New York’s economy. NYSERDA has worked for the past 50 years to protect the environment and help New Yorkers increase energy efficiency, lower energy costs and reduce reliance on fossil fuels. NYSERDA engages with stakeholders including residents, business owners, developers, community leaders, local government officials, universities, utilities, investors, entrepreneurs, and more, to develop, invest, and foster conditions that:

  • Attract the private sector capital investment needed to expand New York’s clean energy economy.
  • Overcome barriers to using clean energy at a large-scale in New York.
  • Enable New York’s communities and residents to benefit equitably in the clean energy transition.

Internship Overview

This is a paid internship for current students at an accredited college. The pay rate is from $18 to $20 per hour based on current class year. This internship will begin as early as September 2026 and will continue through December 2026.

Interns must be located in New York State or an immediately adjacent state while working. It is expected that interns will follow our telework policy, with a combination of in-office and remote work. Interns work up to 18.5 hours per week during the semester, and up to 37.5 hours per week between semesters, when not attending classes.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead special projects that showcase NYSERDA’s work as assigned throughout the duration of the internship. These projects will leverage existing materials and require independent research to inform and enhance successful work products that support the Corporate Communications team and Authority as a whole.
  • Support and assist the Corporate Communications team’s efforts across all portfolios to build public awareness of NYSERDA’s programs and objectives both internally and externally.
  • Research program areas, trends and industry reports to gather information and key facts needed to inform written communications.
  • Review and proofread third-party articles, press releases and other materials to ensure accuracy and enhance understanding of NYSERDA-supported projects and initiatives.
  • Assist with updating existing media lists with accurate reporter contact information (phone number, email, social media handles), identifying new reporters and removing those no longer covering relevant topics, compiling media lists and creating new media lists, if needed.
  • Assist the Corporate Communications team in preparing materials and publicity for NYSERDA in-person and virtual events; and
  • Perform other responsibilities, as assigned.
  • Ability to demonstrate respect, equity and inclusive behavior and practices of a diverse workforce and community.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current, full-time undergraduate or graduate student, pursuing a degree in Communications, Public Relations, or Media Relations.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms including but not limited to Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and Instagram.
  • Excellent skills with the Microsoft Office suite of programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to research primary and secondary sources.
  • Skill in managing multiple activities, delivering on commitments, and operating with speed, accuracy, and strong judgment.
  • Strong work ethic.

title: Geotechnical Project Manager
description:
Three Notch Group delivers comprehensive geotechnical solutions, seamlessly integrating advanced geoscience technologies with the physical environment. From subsurface explorations and laboratory testing to engineering analysis and construction-phase services, we provide timely, cost-effective, and expert design solutions that drive projects from concept to completion. Our seasoned specialists excel in conventional and cutting-edge geotechnical techniques, offering innovative foundation designs, ground improvement and stabilization strategies, and earth retention solutions tailored to the unique challenges of each site.



The mission of the Project Manager is to, under general supervision, deliver quality projects on time and within budget for those projects which are assigned to him or her.

The ideal candidate should have:


  1. Experience in the analysis and design of geotechnical systems, including shallow and deep foundations, earth retention, slope stability, and ground improvement, with the ability to produce clear, defensible geotechnical reports and recommendations.
  2. Experienced in construction materials testing and IBC special inspection in support of construction phase services including observation, testing, and troubleshooting during earthwork and vertical construction phases of construction.

  4. Familiarity with standard and geotechnical related computer applications such as Microsoft Office, EnSoft suite, Geostudio, gINT, etc.
  5. Mentoring and developing staff, including younger engineers and technicians, with a focus on technical growth, accountability, and building high-performing teams that support both project delivery and business objectives.

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET-accredited program
  2. 5–7 years of progressive experience in geotechnical engineering and/or construction materials testing (CMT), including both design and construction-phase services.
  3. Professional Engineer (P.E.) license required, or the ability to obtain licensure within six (6) months of hire.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay based on experience

title: Principal Client Advisory
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.

TTEC Digital is seeking a Principal Client Advisory to join our Managed Services practice. This is a remote, telecommute role based in Manila.

In this role, you will serve as the operational and technical lead for a portfolio of managed services clients, driving service delivery and ensuring excellence across the full client lifecycle. You will act as a trusted advisor, overseeing client platform operations, leading client relationships, and managing day-to-day delivery while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.

You will play a key role in incident management, platform upgrades, contract renewals, and continuous improvement initiatives, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to resolve issues, mitigate risks, and identify opportunities to grow and optimize services. You will also be responsible for creating and delivering weekly and monthly service reviews for clients, providing service metrics, and collaborating with internal teams to support quarterly client reviews.

In addition, you will help ensure compliance with client standards, including ITIL processes, security, and operational policies, while serving as a central point of coordination for internal and external communications. Additionally, you will support the transition from project delivery to ongoing support (Day 2) and contribute to the commercial success of each engagement by assisting with billing inputs, documentation, gathering requirements, and helping define level of effort for new initiatives.

What You Will Be Doing:

Platform Operations & Service Delivery
• Oversee the management, trending, and analysis of support and change service requests
• Perform ongoing platform health monitoring and system checks to ensure stability, performance, and capacity
• Prioritize and coordinate work for technical resources to ensure timely completion of service requests and changes
• Drive Change Management cycles and ensure visibility across stakeholders
• Analyze platform performance metrics and implement action plans to address risks or issues
• Coordinate incident and service request resolution from initiation through root cause analysis across Service Desk, Level II/III, and engineering teams
• Serve as an escalation point for high-priority incidents (P1/P2), ensuring timely communication and resolution
• Drive root cause analysis (RCA) follow-through, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented
• Maintain strong working knowledge of supported platforms and apply expertise to client environments
• Ensure adherence to client policies and ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Security, and Asset Management

Client Relationship & Communication Management
• Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders
• Act as a strategic advisor and primary operational contact for assigned clients
• Lead regular operational status reviews and business review meetings
• Create and deliver weekly and monthly service reviews to clients, and provide service metrics input and collaborate with internal teams to support quarterly business reviews
• Coordinate communications across Account Management, delivery teams, and third-party vendors
• Proactively assess client satisfaction and identify opportunities for improvement
• Conduct structured client feedback sessions and drive action planning based on outcomes
• Capture and share lessons learned and best practices across internal teams
• Mentor internal resources to ensure high standards of delivery and customer experience

Commercial & Account Management
• Participate in and support contract renewal activities, including scope validation and service alignment
• Partner with Business Development teams to identify account expansion and optimization opportunities
• Assist in the development of Statements of Work (SOWs), Change Requests, RFP responses, and other contract documentation
• Track project run rates, resource utilization, and support accurate invoicing processes
• Provide inputs to billing and financial reporting, including effort tracking and utilization data
• Support pre-implementation planning, including requirements gathering, level of effort (LOE), and resource planning
• Deliver regular account status updates and key client insights to internal stakeholders

Transition & Continuous Improvement
• Lead and support the transition of clients from project implementation to Day 2 support operations
• Ensure all required support documentation is developed, maintained, and accessible
• Set clear expectations with clients regarding support scope, responsibilities, and service delivery
• Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, tools, and client experience
• Manage client expectations across ongoing support and project-related activities

What You Will Bring:

• 6 to 8+ years of experience in Technical Operations Management, preferably in contact center cloud or on-prem environments
• Experience supporting CCaaS platforms such as Genesys, Five9, Cisco, NICE CXone, AWS Connect, or similar technologies
• Strong background in client relationship management and consulting
• Proven ability to manage incident response, change management, and service delivery processes
• Solid understanding of ITIL frameworks and operational best practices
• Experience supporting commercial aspects of managed services, including SOWs, invoicing, and renewals
• Demonstrated ability to mentor others and manage technical support teams
• Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to work effectively in a remote, global, and cross-functional environment

description:
Position Overview:

Grand View Lodge is looking for a detail-oriented, mechanically inclined Vehicle Fleet Coordinator to manage the operation, maintenance, and coordination of our resort vehicle fleet. You'll own the full lifecycle of fleet management; from tracking usage and scheduling maintenance to making purchase recommendations and ensuring every vehicle is road-ready, properly licensed, and well-documented. This is a role for someone who takes pride in keeping things running smoothly and sees the value of a well-maintained fleet as part of delivering a great guest and associate experience.

About Grand View Lodge & Cote Hospitality

For over 100 years, Cote Hospitality has crafted transformative guest experiences across world-class resorts and camps. At Grand View Lodge, that means exceptional wellness woven into a full resort lifestyle, golf, dining, events, and more, all grounded in our CoteCares culture of belonging, respect, and shared purpose.   • Manage the vehicle issuance system, ensuring all personnel checkouts are tracked and all vehicles are accounted for at all times.
  • Track usage, fuel consumption, and mileage across the full fleet; maintain scheduled maintenance logs and set up oil change schedules proactively.

  • Make clear, well-documented recommendations on vehicle repair, replacement, or retirement based on inspection findings and usage data.

  • This is a resort hospitality role; availability on weekends, holidays, and extended hours during peak seasons is required.

What you bring:

  • 3 years of experience in transportation, fleet, or related operations management; preferably at a multi-site company.
  • General auto mechanic knowledge and hands-on comfort with vehicle inspection and minor repairs.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; you keep meticulous records and nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills for inventory tracking and scheduling; basic computer knowledge for scheduling and reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work flexible hours as operational needs arise.

Why join us:

You'll be part of a team that genuinely invests in its people. CoteCares isn't a tagline, it's how we show up for each other every day. You'll have the tools, support, and team culture to do your best work, with real opportunity to grow your career across the entire Cote Hospitality organization.

description:

Serving persons with mental health conditions, substance abuse issues and/or disabilities, responsible for day-to-day client interactions and care coordination of assigned cases. Enhance coordination of medical and behavioral health care with the focus on the needs of persons with multiple chronic illnesses.

• Provide basic instruction/health education to clarify provider instructions, procedures and referral needs.

• Conduct outreach activities specially to the loss to care patients • Conduct community outreach visits to patients

• Provide expedited visit to patients for urgent situations such as hospitalization

• Notify Care Coordinators of outcome of contacting the patient for whom phone and mail outreach and engagement attempts have been successful and unsuccessful

• Assist the patient in selecting a Primary Care Provider (PCP).

• Offer assistance in arranging an initial visit with their PCP.

• Provide the patient with the Health Home emergency number.

• Provide patients with information on manage care

• Advise patient about opportunities to learn more about Health Home policies and benefits.

• Proven ability to empathize with the clients we serve.

• Tenacity and passion for this work with the ability to balance objectivity with empathy

• Computer literacy required.

• Valid NYS Driver’s License required and a driving record that will permit the use of an Agency vehicle to transport clients to appointments or other activities as needed.

• Bachelor’s Degree required.

• Associates accepted with experience.

• Bilingual English/Spanish a plus

description:

Operate independently with Engineering Manager oversite to perform engineering valve design functions for the development of new products and for the modification of existing products, in accordance with corporate strategic plans.

title: SVP of Success
description:
About us:
How did Web Summit become, in the words of Forbes, “the best tech conference on the planet”? Meaningful connections. Our tech events are unmissable because we make it easier for the right people to meet and connect. Everyone at Web Summit works towards this goal.
And we’re just getting started.
We’re always looking to build on the impact we have already made at Web Summit. In the coming years we’ll take Web Summit to new markets, promoting global connectivity, highlighting important issues and connecting global leaders – all while making a positive impact on the environment and communities we encounter.
To build a better company, we have to better ourselves. We do that by finding the most ambitious people to work with us.

About the Role

We are looking for an SVP of Success to lead, scale, and unite our global success functions.

Today, Partner Success, Key Attendee Success, and Startup Success operate as three separate, high-performance success functions. This new role is being created to unite these three teams to execute a unified strategic approach to success fulfilment for the various attendees and stakeholders of our global events.

You will be the strategic owner of every core stakeholder group that attends our events: Key Attendee Success (Speakers, Investors, Media & VIPs), Partner Success (the world's biggest and emerging brands), and Startup Success (the next generation of tech giants). You will own budget, headcount, and decisions across all three teams.

This is not a traditional account management leadership role. You'll need to combine operational rigour, relationship management, and data-driven decision-making along with the ability to optimise the service level for each stakeholder group. If you thrive under pressure, love designing scalable service models for complex, high-volume operations, and want to lead a passionate team delivering a world-class experience on a global stage, we want to talk with you!

What you’ll do at Web Summit:

  • Lead & direct: Provide strategic leadership to Partner Success, Key Attendee Success, and Startup Success, fostering a culture of excellence, high motivation, and radical collaboration — while giving each team's leadership the room to keep running exceptional day-to-day operations.
  • Be the voice of the customer: with the standing to challenge: Bring partner, startup, and speaker feedback into the business with evidence, and be prepared to challenge senior leaders — including in Acquisition — when a growth decision creates downstream service risk.
  • Design and optimise the service model: Assess current service levels, cost-to-serve, and effort by segment across the function. Build tiered, deliberate service models that direct the right level of attention to the right relationships, so every partner, speaker, and startup gets a service experience matched to what will genuinely benefit them.
  • Standardise & optimise: Standardise the guardrails, respect the differences: Build common definitions for SLAs, escalation, and satisfaction measurement across teams, shaped to fit the distinct nature of each team's work
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Act as the critical link between Success teams and our internal Production, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering teams to ensure event software, logistics, and account deliverables are perfectly aligned.
  • Data-driven Iteration: Analyse feedback, NPS scores, and fulfilment data to continuously iterate on our service model, ensuring high partner retention rates and unparalleled satisfaction for our key attendees.
  • Agile on-site execution: Thrive during event weeks, managing high-priority escalations with diplomacy, speed, and absolute calm.

Who you are:

  • You are a seasoned leader with 7+ years of experience managing large success, account management, or fulfilment operations teams, ideally in high-growth tech environments or large-scale global events.
  • You are deeply empathetic but highly analytical — you know how to measure "success" quantitatively and qualitatively, and you're comfortable making the case to do less somewhere to do more where it matters.
  • You have a proven track record of designing service tiers or operating models that thoughtfully match the level of treatment to the value of each relationship — scaling smarter, not just scaling bigger.
  • You are an exceptional communicator, able to build trust with internal executives, C-level corporate partners, and high-profile global figures — and to hold your ground with senior leaders when the data supports a different call.
  • You are tech-literate, comfortable working alongside engineers to adopt and shape new tools and systems.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and fast-paced environments where priorities can pivot quickly.
Benefits and perks:
  • Subsidised healthcare, dental, employee assistance programme (EAP) and more.
  • Employer pension contribution up to 6% for Irish-based employees
  • A dedicated in-house L&D department, with access to workshops, online learning and resources to help you excel in your career development.
  • Company MacBook, generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements.
  • Our very own Tramway Team, which drives community and morale-boosting events for employees to participate in.
  • Annual company get-togethers, charity days, and monthly wellbeing talks.
  • Wellness subsidy issued to all employees of €1000 per year
At Web Summit, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We want talent from all walks of life to help us on our journey to digitise the conference sector. Hiring decisions are made purely on experience, skills and the needs of the business.

title: SCO Castroom Technician
description:
About Company:

Experience Excellence

Southern California Orthopedic Institute is the preferred expert for diagnosing and treating bone, joint, and muscle injuries and conditions as well as musculoskeletal and spinal disorders in adults and children.

Our Mission

To provide comprehensive musculoskeletal and supporting services in a manner that demonstrates compassion, value and superior service for every patient encounter while promoting organizational unity and operational efficiency.

Why work for us?

- Competitive pay which matches your abilities and experience

- Health coverage for you and your family

- Generous number of vacation days per year

- A robust wellness plan and health club discounts


Intrigued? We’d love to hear from you! Please review the job details below and then click “apply.”

About the Role:

The SCO Castroom Technician plays a critical role in the healthcare environment by preparing, maintaining, and managing the castroom to ensure efficient and safe application of orthopedic casts and splints. This position is responsible for supporting medical staff by preparing materials, sterilizing equipment, and ensuring compliance with health and safety standards. The technician will work closely with orthopedic specialists to facilitate patient care, ensuring that all castroom operations run smoothly and effectively. Attention to detail and adherence to protocols are essential to prevent infection and guarantee patient comfort and safety. Ultimately, the role contributes significantly to the quality of patient outcomes in orthopedic treatment and rehabilitation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare environment.
  • Experience or training in medical equipment sterilization and maintenance.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and adhere to safety protocols.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification or coursework related to orthopedic casting or medical assisting.
  • Previous experience working in a healthcare or orthopedic setting.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Basic first aid and CPR certification.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with medical staff and patients.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and maintain the castroom environment, including sterilizing and organizing tools and materials used for casting and splinting.
  • Assist healthcare professionals by setting up necessary equipment and supplies prior to patient procedures.
  • Monitor inventory levels of casting materials and order supplies as needed to ensure uninterrupted service.
  • Ensure compliance with infection control protocols and safety regulations within the castroom.
  • Maintain accurate records of materials used and assist in documentation related to patient care and equipment maintenance.

Skills:

The SCO Castroom Technician utilizes their organizational and technical skills daily to prepare and maintain a sterile and efficient castroom environment. Attention to detail is critical when sterilizing equipment and managing inventory to ensure patient safety and procedural readiness. Communication skills are employed to coordinate effectively with healthcare professionals and support patient care activities. Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare protocols enables the technician to understand and anticipate the needs of the orthopedic team. Additionally, problem-solving skills are essential to address any issues related to equipment or supplies promptly, ensuring continuous and smooth operation of the castroom.

title: Sr. Creative Director, Performance Creative
description:
About the Role

Udonis is looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative production team across gaming, lead generation, and ecommerce projects.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You are both the Creative Director and the Copy Director — you don't just direct the work, you write and produce the winning scripts, hooks, and angles yourself. You understand performance creative, know how to manage a team, can work directly with clients, and have the business awareness needed to run a creative department efficiently and profitably. You will turn research, insights, and client goals into winning creative concepts, collaborate closely with our media teams to align creative with campaign performance, and manage production from idea to delivery while meeting both quality and performance standards.

What You'll Do

You will manage creative production across two main areas — Gaming (static images, videos, and playable ads for mobile games) and Lead Generation & Ecommerce (static images and videos for performance marketing campaigns).

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and managing the creative production team
  • Acting as the department's Copy Director — personally writing and producing the scripts, hooks, and ad copy that drive performance
  • Collaborating closely with media buying teams to align creative with campaign performance and feed test learnings back into production
  • Communicating directly with clients and understanding their business goals
  • Translating client needs into clear creative direction for the team
  • Researching markets, competitors, trends, and audiences — spotting winning angles and creative patterns early
  • Leading ideation, scripting, and production of new performance creative concepts
  • Managing creative workflows from concept to final delivery
  • Assigning tasks, setting priorities, and making sure deadlines are met
  • Reviewing creative work and giving clear, useful feedback
  • Running quality assurance on concepts, visuals, videos, and playable ads
  • Making sure creative output is aligned with performance marketing goals
  • Improving internal processes so the department runs smoothly
  • Owning the department's P&L and driving its profitability and growth, while balancing quality, speed, cost, and client expectations

Who You Are

You are a strong creative leader who understands that performance creative needs to do more than look good — it needs to generate results.

You are comfortable owning communication with clients, managing a team independently, and making smart decisions without needing constant direction. You understand how creative production affects profitability, team capacity, client retention, and campaign performance.

You are both creative and operational, and you write. You can come up with strong ideas — and you personally script and produce the copy behind them — but you can also organize people, manage deadlines, review work, and keep production moving.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:

  • The creative team knows exactly what needs to be produced and why
  • Clients feel understood, supported, and confident in the creative direction
  • Creative concepts are well researched, clear, and performance-focused
  • Deliverables are completed on time and at a high quality level
  • The team works efficiently without constant bottlenecks
  • The department runs in a financially healthy way
  • Creative output improves over time based on feedback, testing, and results


Requirements

Experience is essential for this role. We are looking for a proven, senior creative leader who is also a strong writer — not someone growing into the position.

  • Significant, directly relevant experience managing creative teams in a performance marketing environment
  • A strong, decisive leader who can own a team, set direction, and hold quality and delivery standards without supervision
  • Copy Director–level writing ability — you personally write the scripts, hooks, and ad copy, this is a core part of the role, not an occasional task
  • Proven creative performance experience — a track record of producing creatives that actually win and drive results
  • Ability to script and produce winning creative, from concept and hook through to finished ad
  • Experience collaborating closely with media buying / media teams to align creative with campaign performance
  • Sharp instinct for spotting trends, angles, and creative patterns before they saturate
  • Strong understanding of paid social creative, direct response ads, and conversion-focused concepts
  • Hands-on experience with creative production for gaming, lead generation, ecommerce, or similar industries
  • Ability to lead research and ideation for new creative concepts
  • Strong eye for quality in static images, video ads, and performance creatives
  • Experience managing production workflows, timelines, feedback, and delivery
  • Excellent communication skills, especially with clients and internal teams
  • Strong feedback skills and the ability to help creatives improve their work
  • Solid understanding of P&L — cost, capacity, profitability, and running the department in a financially healthy way
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in a remote / hybrid environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile gaming creative production
  • Experience with playable ads
  • Experience working in an agency environment
  • Experience managing designers, video editors, motion designers, copywriters, or playable ad developers
  • Understanding of creative testing, hooks, angles, thumb-stopping visuals, and ad fatigue
  • Familiarity with Meta, TikTok, Google, Unity, AppLovin, or other performance ad platforms


Benefits

Why Join Udonis

At Udonis, you will have the opportunity to lead creative production across fast-moving performance marketing projects in gaming, lead generation, and ecommerce.

This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not just a title. You will have a direct impact on the quality of our creative output, the way our team works, the experience our clients have, and the business results of the department.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary: €3,000 – €4,000 gross/month (€36,000 – €48,000/year)
  • Performance bonus tied to the department's profitability and growth
  • Hybrid remote, starting with full remote
  • Full-time role with real ownership and decision-making authority

title: Technical Assistant
description:
Job Description

A Technical Assistant provides administrative, operational, and technical support to ensure the smooth execution of organizational projects, systems, and day-to-day activities.

Roles of a Technical Assistant
- Technical Support: Provide first-level technical assistance and resolve basic hardware, software, and system related issues.
- Project Coordination: Assist in planning, coordinating, and tracking technical projects to ensure timely completion.
- Documentation: Prepare, organize, and maintain technical documents, reports, manuals, and standard operating procedures.
- System Administration: Support the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of organizational systems, software, and digital platforms.
- Data Management: Collect, organize, update, and maintain accurate technical records, databases, and project documentation.
- Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and escalate technical issues where necessary while ensuring timely resolution.
- User Support & Training: Assist staff with system usage and provide basic training on software, tools, and digital platforms.
- Equipment Management: Monitor, maintain, and coordinate the servicing of IT equipment and other technical resources.
- Quality Assurance: Support system testing, quality checks, and implementation of improvements before deployment.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical, operations, product, and administrative teams to support organizational objectives.
- Compliance & Security: Ensure adherence to organizational IT policies, data security standards, and operational procedures.
- Continuous Improvement: Stay informed on new technologies and recommend process improvements that enhance productivity and operational efficiency.

title: Algorithmic Trader
description:
About Wintermute

Wintermute is one of the largest algorithmic trading companies in digital assets. We provide liquidity algorithmically across all major cryptocurrency exchanges and trading platforms, a broad range of OTC trading solutions as well as support high profile blockchain projects and traditional financial institutions moving into crypto.

Wintermute is not just a trading company, it is one the most prominent and influential players in the digital asset markets: we are connected and partnering with all major players in the industry, we actively participate in the development of the blockchain ecosystem through investments, partnerships, and incubation of projects. You can read more here.

Working at Wintermute

We are looking for an Algorithmic Trader with strong quantitative and Python skills, good trading instincts and a curiosity about algorithmic trading, high-frequency trading, liquidity provision and digital assets. You will take ownership of P&L-impacting trading projects from an early stage, working closely with experienced traders and developers across our global trading team. After an initial training period, you will be given significant independence and responsibility. You will analyse large amounts of trading and transaction data, identify opportunities, build and improve trading strategies and develop solutions based on your findings. There are no legacy systems, multiple layers of approvals or rigid boundaries between trading, analysis and development. You will be encouraged to identify opportunities, build solutions and make an immediate impact. This is primarily a trading and business role rather than a pure research role. We are looking for people who enjoy combining quantitative analysis, coding and commercial decision-making to drive P&L.

What will you work on:

  • Improving and optimising existing trading strategies.
  • Researching and developing new trading strategies and products.
  • Analysing large volumes of market, trading and transaction data to identify opportunities.
  • Building tools and solutions to improve trading performance and decision-making.
  • Improving the technology and infrastructure supporting our trading systems.
  • Monitoring trading performance and reacting quickly to changing market conditions.
  • Exploring new markets, products and trading opportunities.
  • Taking ownership of projects that have a direct impact on P&L.
  • You will work closely with experienced traders, quantitative developers and the wider management team while gradually taking increasing ownership of your own strategies and areas of the business.

Hard Skills Requirements:

  • Strong Python skills – typically 1–3 years of coding experience through professional work, internships, academic work or personal projects. We will test this during the interview process.
  • Excellent quantitative and analytical skills – we will test these.
  • Typically 1–3 years of relevant experience, although we also welcome exceptional recent graduates with relevant internships, particularly from HFT, quantitative trading or similar environments.
  • Trading experience is not essential, but you should have strong trading intuition and a genuine interest in learning about algorithmic trading, high-frequency trading, quantitative trading and liquidity provision.
  • Strong ability to analyse complex datasets, identify patterns and turn insights into practical solutions.
  • An interest in financial markets and technology. Experience or interest in crypto, blockchain and DeFi is beneficial but not required.

Other Requirements:

  • You have an owner mentality and focus on the ultimate outcome: generating sustainable P&L and helping grow the business over the long term.
  • You love solving problems and seeing the solutions you build work in practice.
  • You are comfortable moving between trading, coding, data analysis and collaboration depending on what is required.
  • You are determined, ambitious and humble, with a strong willingness to learn.
  • You enjoy working in a meritocratic environment where performance and impact matter.
  • You have an entrepreneurial mindset rather than a 9-to-5 mentality and are comfortable with the demands of fast-moving global markets.
  • You enjoy working collaboratively with traders, developers and other teams.
  • You are comfortable working primarily from the office while maintaining flexibility where appropriate.

Here is why you should join our dynamic team:

  • Opportunity to work at the world's leading algorithmic trading firm covering both digital assets and traditional finance.

  • Engaging projects offering accelerated responsibilities and ownership growth compared to traditional finance environments.

  • A vibrant working culture with team events, celebrations and company wide team building events.

  • For US applicants: a cool office in the heart of New York City which often hosts some of the leading industry events

  • For London applicants: a Wintermute-inspired office in central London, featuring an array of amenities such as table tennis and foosball, personalized desk configurations, a cozy team breakout area with games.

  • Great company culture: informal, non-hierarchical, ambitious, highly professional yet with a startup vibe, collaborative and entrepreneurial.

  • A performance-based compensation with a significant earning upside.

  • For US, the base salary range for this role is $210,000 - $240,000. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and medical insurance.

title: AI Lab Automation Scientist (1 year contract)
description:
About X:

X is Alphabet’s moonshot factory with a mission of inventing and launching moonshot technologies that could someday make the world a radically better place. We are a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup. As an innovation engine, X focuses on repeatedly turning breakthrough-technology ideas into the foundations for large, sustainable businesses.

About the Role:

We are seeking an extraordinary, multi-talented scientist/engineer to join a core effort in X’s BioDesign Kitchen to help accelerate moonshots in biology and chemistry. This is a hands-on role to help shape our interface of frontier models with the physical practice of the scientific discipline.

This isn't a traditional siloed role. You are a rare hybrid who understands scientific processes and the instruments that make them possible, while appreciating the messy complexity of biological systems. As a core member of our team, you will be the bridge between the digital, physical, and cellular worlds—owning the design and execution of intelligent closed-loop systems that automate, analyze, and accelerate biological discovery.

This role is in the BioDK and is core to its mission of rapidly prototyping moonshots in chemistry and biology. This position will directly serve existing and future moonshots in the BioDK, and help in the creation and co-creation of new moonshots, and advance our AI4Science efforts. The role will also involve efficient communication of results, concepts, and progress.

How you will make 10x impact:

  • Bridge the Domains: Act as the primary technical nexus between our Machine Learning, Hardware, Biology, and Chemistry teams, translating complex experimental constraints into algorithmic and hardware requirements.
  • Build Closed-Loop Systems: Design, build, and deploy end-to-end automated laboratory workflows where AI-driven models control physical hardware/robotics to execute and iterate on biological experiments.
  • Hardware-Software Integration: Develop custom firmware, APIs, or drivers to connect proprietary laboratory automation hardware with cloud-based AI infrastructure.
  • Data Pipeline & Protocol Design: Design robust data engineering pipelines to capture, clean, and structure messy, high-throughput biological data (e.g., genomic, proteomic, or imaging data) for ML training.
  • Own the Execution: Independently scope, prototype, and test high-risk technical features, moving rapidly from ambiguous ideas to concrete, working physical prototypes.

What you should have:

  • Education: Ph.D. in and strong research track record in Biophyisics, Chemistry, Biology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering.
  • Experience: 3+ years of professional or postdoc experience working directly at the intersection of biology, hardware, and software.
  • Hardware skills: Hands-on experience with hardware prototyping, sensor integration, microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi), and protocols (SPI, I2C, UART). You should be comfortable with the insides of a computer, and be able to tell SATA from serial connections.
  • Experimental: High level of proficiency in a wet lab environment; deep understanding of molecular biology, assay development, cell or tissue culture, synthetic biology. Protein engineering experience a plus.
  • Code: Strong proficiency in python, the use of agent harnesses, and github.
  • Communication: you will be astute at communicating deeply technical ideas in a straightforward way to non-expert colleagues.

It’d be great if you also have these:

  • Experience with laboratory automation standards and frameworks (e.g., pylabrobot or Hamilton, Tecan, Agilent Bravo).
  • An intense curiosity to learn new techniques and work with colleagues with complementary skill sets.
  • Protein engineering experience.
  • Mechanical aptitude
  • A thrive-in-chaos mentality: Comfort with extreme ambiguity, rapid pivoting, and a passion for tackling 10x problems rather than 10% improvements.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $132,000 - $195,000 + bonus + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, or benefits.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across Finance, Talent Management, Agents, and Operations;
  • Experience in a talent agency, entertainment, media, advertising, creative, or similar industry is an asset;

  • Your positive attitude, collaborative spirit, and the way you uplift those around you are contagious.
  • You thrive on new challenges, stay calm under pressure, and love the pace and excitement of a dynamic environment.
  • You’re a true self-starter - passionate, gritty, and goal-oriented, someone who loves having projects, challenges, and milestones to work toward.
  • In short, you’re driven, creative, and structured, someone who knows how to balance discipline, fun, and performance - 3 core pillars of Dulcedo’s culture.

Life at Dulcedo!

  • Freestyle Fridays : We wrap up at 2:00 PM ET every Friday. Long weekends, every week.

Compliance and Regulatory Support

  • Oversee compliance-related reporting and requirements, including REACH, RoHS, Conflict Minerals, Extended Minerals Reporting Template (EMRT), Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA), and rare earth minerals/elements.
  • Support Purchasing and Supplier Development with requirements related to rare earth magnets sourced from China.
  • Partner with IT on the implementation and approval of Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) requirements from the U.S. Department of Defense, with the goal of achieving Department of Defense Level 2 certification.

Systems and Administrative Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated Exostar administrator for customer portal access, including annual subscription renewals, administration of new hardware OTP token devices, and annual renewal of active OTP devices.
  • Serve as the designated Haystack Gold database administrator, supporting the Valcor Aftermarket team by reviewing and researching NSN numbers and responding to U.S. Government procurement requests.

  • Experience supporting compliance-related reporting and requirements, including REACH, RoHS, Conflict Minerals, EMRT, TSCA, and rare earth minerals/elements.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive contractual, customer, supplier, and government-related information with discretion.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate records, policies, procedures, and compliance documentation.

title: Tilkaldevikar til PostNord Danmark i Aalborg
description:
Vi har brug for dig til vores professionelle pakkeomdeling!

PostNord – den fortrukne leverandør i Norden

I PostNord forbinder vi e-handlerne med forbrugere over hele verden og gør hverdagen lettere for vores kunder. Vi er omkring 24.500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at forbinde virksomheder, myndigheder og privatpersoner i hele Norden.

Vi er førende inden for bæredygtig pakkelevering og med vores ekspertise og et veludviklet distributionsnetværk, skaber vi forudsætningerne for fremtidens e-handel og pakkedistribution i de nordiske lande.

Vi arbejder i et spændende marked, der hele tiden udvikler sig og vi ser kompetente og engagerede medarbejdere som vores vigtigste ressource til hurtigt at omstille os og gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

    Om jobbet

    • Pakke HUB Aalborg ligger på Postmestervej 1, 9000 Aalborg
    • Arbejdet består i pakning af bil og omdeling af pakker i det nordjyske
    • Du bliver tilkaldt på dagen; som tilkaldevikar er du ikke garanteret et fast timeantal, men du arbejder ved behov og sygdom
    • Ønsket startdato 15. september 2026
    • Vi går en travl tid i møde i forhold til julepeak i slutningen af november måned

    Færdigheder

    Vi lægger vægt på, at du trives med højt tempo, ansvar, forandring og nye opgaver. Du brænder for at give vores kunder den aftalte service og kvalitet og er en teamplayer, der værner om respekt og hjælpsomhed i samarbejdet. Det er vigtigt, at du læser, skriver og taler dansk, og har en tilfredsstillende straffeattest. Jobbet kræver et VUB bevis, så en fordel hvis du har og ellers skal det erhverves.

    Erfaring i kørsel i større bil vil helt sikkert være et plus.

    Det tilbyder vi dig

    • Du får ordnede arbejdsforhold og en grundig introduktion, så du kan udføre dit arbejde professionelt.
    • Mennesker med forskellige baggrunde arbejder hos os, så du bliver del af en mangfoldig arbejdsplads.
    • Din ansættelse sker efter Industriens Overenskomst og lokalaftaler med 3F for postarbejdere.
    • Timelønnen er 163,83 kr.
    • Pensionen er efter ca. 2 måneders ansættelse på 13 % (arbejdsgiverbetalt pension på 11 % og medarbejderbetalt på 2 %)

    Sådan søger du

    Udfyld ansøgningen nedenfor.

    Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt vores Rekrutteringscenter på tlf. 52 29 18 60. Du kan også læse mere om f.eks. det at arbejde hos PostNord på linket her.

    Vi ansætter løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.
